fdroid:com.bearinmind.equalizer314.name: Equalizer314
fdroid:com.bearinmind.equalizer314.summary: System-wide EQ with multiband compression, limiter, and audio-visual feedback.
fdroid:com.bearinmind.equalizer314.description:
To start off there is really no "free" and/or "open source" alternative to Wavelet and Poweramp EQ that pairs the full DynamicsProcessing API with real audio-visual feedback, and I felt like after using both of those apps among other various EQ apps that there were huge shortcomings in terms of the features & accessibilities they offered. When I started developing this app I wanted to have both a powerful parametric eq function with minimal permissions; this is why I choose to use both the DynamicsProcessing & Visualizer APIs as the framework for this app as you only need minimal permissions for both of them to work in tandem. There are shortcomings from both these APIs, but I'll discuss more of that later.
This app is built off of DynamicsProcessing API; this is the same API that Poweramp EQ & Wavelet both use but I felt in some aspects they weren't really being able really squeeze out the max potential that this API can offer.
As someone who comes from the audio production & IEM world I have a lot of experience understanding what both sides of those worlds want and wanted to be able to take advantage of both to create something that met my creative endeavors.
Using the Visualizer API I wanted to give users a way they can reliably cross reference visual data with audio data; this is both useful for the main EQ portion as you can visually reference audio changes you make, but this comes more into play with the Limiting & Multiband Compression sides of the app. While these features are for use in the DynamicsProcessing API; and many apps like Poweramp EQ & Wavelet (who premium locks these features); they just add knobs/sliders in and expect the user to understand exactly how these features work and without real audio-visual feedback, users aren't really able to take advantage of these features in their full potential. This is the reason why many DAWs and VST Plugins use audio-visual feedback with these functions specifically.
Using Visualizer API with these DynamicsProcessing features; you're really able to get an intimate audio-visual feedback loop that gives you complete control over your audio framework.
This app is free and open source software (FOSS) licensed under the GPL-3.0 License.

fdroid:io.github.luantak.fokuslauncher.name: Fokus Launcher
fdroid:io.github.luantak.fokuslauncher.summary: Minimal launcher with clock, weather, fast app search, and gesture navigation.
fdroid:io.github.luantak.fokuslauncher.description:
Fokus Launcher is an Android launcher for people who want a simpler, cleaner default experience. It focuses on fast access to time, weather, and core apps with minimal visual noise.
 Home Screen 
The home screen is intentionally minimal: a large clock and date, battery status, optional weather, configurable favorite app labels, and a configurable right-side shortcut rail. Tap the clock, date, or weather to open the apps you configure for each in settings. Primary interactions are gesture-based: swipe up to open the app drawer, swipe down to expand the notification shade, and swipe left or right to launch shortcut targets.
 App Drawer 
The drawer supports quick search, categories you define in settings, and optional alphabetical or most-opened app order. When only one app matches a search, Fokus can launch it directly. Optional category sidebar mode replaces the inline search bar with a vertical category rail; use the search icon when you need text search. Long-pressing an app offers add to home, rename, hide, and uninstall.
Dot search keeps you in that same field for web or in-app search. Type a period, a space, and your query, for example ". cats"; that searches in your browser by default until you change the default under Dot search in settings. For letter shortcuts, type a period, one lowercase letter, a space, and your query, for example ".a coffee" when you assigned the letter "a" there. Dot search settings also list search-capable apps and lets you add HTTPS or deep-link URL templates with a placeholder for the query.
 Customization 
Edit home apps, configure right-side shortcuts (including launcher shortcut actions), hide or rename apps, choose a custom font, and manage launcher data from the settings screen.
 Weather 
Weather is powered by Open-Meteo. No account or API key is required. Results are cached for 30 minutes. Location permission is optional and only used for local weather.
 Work Profile 
Work profile apps are shown alongside personal apps in the drawer when a work profile is active on the device.
 Private Space (Android 15+) 
On Android 15 and above (API 35+), Fokus supports Android's Private Space with lock/unlock controls and a separate section in the app drawer for private apps when the space is unlocked.
 Optional Device Controls 
These features only work if you turn on accessibility for Fokus in Android settings.
Double tap to lock can turn off the screen from empty home space. Return home after long lock can bring Fokus back to the foreground on unlock once the device stayed locked longer than a threshold you choose.
 First-Run Onboarding 
On first launch, Fokus walks you through welcome, optional location permission, default-launcher setup, home-screen customization, swipe-shortcut setup, and quick gesture tips.
 Permissions 
Fokus asks only for what it uses.
That covers uninstall flows from the launcher, internet access for weather and dot search, optional coarse location for local weather, and hidden-profile access for Private Space on supported versions. It also covers expanding the notification shade from swipe-down gestures, battery-optimization prompts for optional long-lock behavior, and applying wallpapers you choose in settings.

fdroid:org.secuso.privacyfriendlynotes.name: Notes (Privacy Friendly)
fdroid:org.secuso.privacyfriendlynotes.summary: (SECUSO) Notes App with minimal permissions and without advertising
fdroid:org.secuso.privacyfriendlynotes.description:
Privacy Friendly Notes allows you to take and manage notes on Android devices. It belongs to the Privacy Friendly Apps group developed by the research group SECUSO at Karlsruhe Institute of Technology. More information can be found an secuso.org/pfa
The following four types of notes are available:
1. Simple text notes
2. Checklist notes
3. Audio notes
4. Sketchnotes
Furthermore, the notes can be grouped into categories, reminders can be assigned to notes and the notes can be exported to the device storage.
How does Privacy Friendly Notes from other similar apps?
1. Minimal Permissions
The permission "RECORD_AUDIO" (Category "Mikrofon") is required to record audio notes. In case this permission is not granted by the user (in Android versions higher than 6) it will not be possible to record audio notes.
"WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" (Category "Speicher") is used to export notes to the device storage. In case this permission is not granted by the user (in Android versions higher than 6) it will not be possible to export notes.
Beside the permissions above the permission “RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED” (Category “Normal/non-critical”) is required to reschedule notifications after a reboot. This permission cannot be modified by the user.
For comparison: The Top Ten of similar apps from the Google Play Store require an average of 11,7 permissions (in December 2016). These are for instance the location permission or the permissions to access, modify or delete storage.
2. No advertisement
Moreover, Privacy Friendly Notes distinguishes from many other applications in the way that it completely relinquishes advertisements. Advertisement might track a user's actions. It could also shorten battery life or use mobile data.

Bluesky - @secusoresearch.bsky.social https://bsky.app/profile/secusoresearch.bsky.social
Mastodon - @SECUSO_Research@bawü.social https://xn--baw-joa.social/@SECUSO_Research/

apple-macos:6757445801.name: Yural: Fitness & Habits
apple-macos:6757445801.description:
Yural helps you understand your current state, improve workouts, build healthier routines, plan what matters, and get adapted feedback over time.
Yural is designed to feel personal from day one. With your permission, it can use the health and activity history already available through Apple Health to help you understand your context, see what is changing, and build a healthier lifestyle through better training, better sleep, more daily activity, and consistent routines.
Focus on what matters
Create a focused view of the health, activity, sleep, workout, goal, routine, challenge, and personal metrics that matter most to you. Yural is configurable by design, so it helps reduce noise instead of showing every possible data point at once.
Understand your key metrics
Use health and fitness scores, Physical Form, Physical Readiness, Cardio Fitness, Sleep insights, activity context, workout history, and personal metrics to better understand your current state and trends.
Plan healthier actions
Use day and week planning to organize workouts, routines, goals, challenges, reminders, and unscheduled activities around real life. Yural helps turn intentions into plans you can actually follow.
Build routines, goals, and challenges
Create routines for recurring habits, goals for measurable daily, weekly, or monthly progress, and challenges for fixed-period motivation or friendly competition with people you know.
Improve workouts and activity
Review workouts, sport progress, training patterns, and activity trends across running, cycling, strength training, swimming, walking, and other workout types. Yural helps connect workouts with readiness, sleep, activity, and consistency.
Learn and keep useful knowledge
Use the Library to discover relevant articles, save links, keep notes, organize topics, and build a personal knowledge base connected to your health, fitness, habits, and improvement areas.
Mac health and fitness continuity
When enabled, Yural can exchange selected health and fitness data between your own paired iPhone and Mac. The transfer is ephemeral, end-to-end encrypted, can only be read by your paired devices, and exchanged data is kept only as long as needed to complete delivery.
First-class Apple device experience
Use Yural on Apple Watch for at-a-glance insights and workout tracking, iPhone for daily clarity, iPad for a larger review and planning surface, and Mac for richer visual review, deeper planning, personal knowledge work, and visual AI chat where available.
Yural is not a medical or diagnostic tool. It is a fitness and habits app designed to help you understand your own context, plan better actions, and keep improving over time.

apple-macos:1542229474.description:
A clear and simple solution for accessing all your cloud storage and networked drives from a single app on your Mac. 
We’ve taken our best selling iOS FileBrowser Professional app (separate purchase) and made over 400 enhancements to bring you the best file browser app for your Mac, designed with the quality you expect from the Stratospherix team. 
Transferring files from one cloud to another has never been easier. Drag and drop files and folders between any type of storage.

Create backup tasks that copy from anywhere to anywhere, or sync cloud files to your Mac.
Make Custom Tasks to perform sequences of copying, moving and deleting with several selection filters and even actions for ZIP, PDF and image files like format conversion.
With QuickLook integration, pass files to third-party apps for viewing or editing.
Works with Finder - drag and drop files and folders between the two.
We would love to hear your feedback. We are committed to keep improving this app with your suggestions.

Thank you for supporting us and our apps.

Mac, Windows, NAS Drives, Linux, GoogleDrive, Dropbox, OneDrive, OneDrive for Business, Box, Microsoft Sharepoint, pCloud, Nextcloud, BackBlaze B2, Amazon S3, Wasabi, Digital Ocean, iDrive e2, Google Cloud S3, Filebase, Storj, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, FTPS, TimeCapsule and others.

Manuskript provides a rich environment to help writers create their first draft and then further

 With Manuskript you can:
 Grow your premise from one sentence, to a paragraph, to a full summary

flathub:com.github.gijsgoudzwaard.image-.name: Image Optimizer
flathub:com.github.gijsgoudzwaard.image-.description:
Image Optimizer makes PNG and JPEG files smaller without changing how they look. It rewrites the files you pick in place, so the file you selected is the one that gets smaller.
 The compression is lossless, which means the pixels come out identical and nothing is re-encoded at a lower quality. What comes off is whatever the encoder left on the table, so screenshots and interface images usually gain the most and photos straight out of a camera the least.
 Features:
 Compress PNG and JPEG images without losing quality
 Optimize a whole batch at once, several files at a time
 Works offline, with no account and nothing uploaded
 Keeps the colour profile and the orientation, so images still look the way they did
 Keeps modification times, so a library sorted by date stays in order
 Quit quickly by pressing Ctrl + Q

flathub:com.ktechpit.pixelfx.name: PixelFx
flathub:com.ktechpit.pixelfx.description:
PixelFx is a quick photo editor for the Linux desktop. Make a photo better while you watch it:
 one-click looks shown on your own photo, presets, every light and colour control you expect, and
 batch editing of many photos at once.
 31 looks in colour, film and black and white, such as Vivid, Warm, Film, Golden hour, Teal
 and orange and Noir, each tile showing your own photo, with a strength slider. Bring your own
 .cube LUTs, or make your own look from steps.
 Light, colour, curves, colour mixer, colour grading, detail, effects and optics, with a histogram
 and clipping warnings.
 Presets: save the whole edit or only parts of it, apply them with one click, and bring your
 Lightroom and Camera Raw presets (.xmp).
 Crop and rotate, straighten with a dial or a drawn line, fix leaning buildings, and square
 a page or a wall from its four corners.
 Heal blemishes, dust and small objects with a spot or a brush.
 Camera RAW, HEIC, AVIF and JPEG XL photos, with lens corrections from the Lensfun database.
 Batch: process whole folders with a preset, a size, a watermark and a format, in the background.
 Export to JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP and more, with sizes for the web and for print, and an optional
 watermark.
 Your edits are kept for every photo, and the original file is never changed.

flathub:com.squidservers.SquidServers.name: SquidServers
flathub:com.squidservers.SquidServers.description:
SquidServers makes creating, managing, and hosting local Minecraft servers effortless. Easily
 configure Vanilla, Paper, Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge servers with automated setup, performance
 metrics, and seamless world imports.
 Features include:
 One-click server creation with automatic Java runtime resolution
 Real-time server performance metrics and RAM allocation controls
 Automated player invite links and built-in network tunneling
 Complete world backups, imports, and modpack management

flathub:com.tutanota.Tutanota.name: Tuta (Experimental)
flathub:com.tutanota.Tutanota.description:
Tuta mail is an email client with a strong focus on security and privacy that lets you encrypt
 emails on all your devices.
 Important: Flatpak release is in a preview stage and there are known issues. When reporting
 bugs please always specify that you are using Flatpak version.
 Keep your messages private and safe from any tracking: Tutanota is the most secure email service
 - fast, encrypted & open source. Trusted by 10 million users and recommended by security &
 privacy experts, this is the go-to app to protect your private emails and calendars from prying
 eyes.
 Tuta's secure email app also has an encrypted calendar & encrypted contacts, all in one
 place. Tutanota enables you to use the benefits of the cloud - availability, flexibility, automatic
 back-up - without compromising on security or privacy. With Tutanota's built-in encryption you
 own your data, no one else can access your private emails, calendars or contacts.

Gqrx is an open source software defined radio receiver (SDR) powered by the GNU Radio and the
 Qt graphical toolkit.
 Gqrx supports many of the SDR hardware available, including Airspy, Funcube Dongles, rtl-sdr,

flathub:io.github.CyberTimon.RapidRAW.name: RapidRAW
flathub:io.github.CyberTimon.RapidRAW.summary: A non-destructive, and GPU-accelerated RAW image editor built with performance in mind
flathub:io.github.CyberTimon.RapidRAW.description:
RapidRAW is a modern, high-performance alternative to Adobe Lightroom®. It delivers a simple,
 beautiful editing experience in a lightweight package (under 20MB) for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
 I started developing this project as a personal challenge when I was 18. My goal was to create
 a high-performance tool for my own photography workflow while deepening my understanding of React,
 WGSL and Rust, with the support from Google Gemini.

flathub:io.github.b43NnUNF4vidFYFhpqaLWy.name: jumpdf
flathub:io.github.b43NnUNF4vidFYFhpqaLWy.description:
A common frustration when reading is the need to manually scroll back and forth between distant locations and references. With jumpdf, one can instead mark locations and jump between them. Unlike marks in similar PDF viewers like sioyek and zathura, however, marks in jumpdf move with the viewer instead of being a static record of some location, thus avoiding the need to manually reset them. In addition, marks are organized into groups, which can be switched between. Besides serving as an organizational tool to help with differentiating sets of related marks, groups can also be opened in separate windows.
 Please see the linked GitHub page for more information, including usage, keybindings and configuration.

flathub:io.github.celluloid_player.Cellu.name: Celluloid
flathub:io.github.celluloid_player.Cellu.description:
Celluloid is a simple media player that can play virtually all video and audio formats. It supports
 playlists and MPRIS2 media player controls. The design of Celluloid follows the GNOME Human Interface
 Guidelines, but can also be adapted for other systems that don't use client-side decorations (CSD).
 It is based on the mpv library and GTK.
 Features:
 Drag and drop playlist
 Loading external mpv configuration files
 MPRIS2 D-Bus interface

 Simple search for albums and tracks
 Support for powerful automatic playlist management
 Full desktop integration
 Visualisation of the playing track
 Collections for creating playlists

flathub:io.itch.domestique_baston.kinder.name: Kindergarten Massaker

A peaceful alien lands in a kindergarten. Kids are coming from everywhere. More and more. They surround the alien, and they want blood! The alien has to avoid kids in order to survive. Everything is seen through a surveillance cam that gets buggier and buggier until it shuts down completely. End of game?

flathub:io.jor.cromagrally.name: Cro-Mag Rally
flathub:io.jor.cromagrally.summary: The wildest racing game since man invented the wheel!
flathub:io.jor.cromagrally.description:
In Cro-Mag Rally you are a speed-hungry caveman named Brog who races through the Stone, Bronze, and Iron Ages in primitive vehicles such as the Geode Cruiser, Bone Buggy, Logmobile, Trojan Horse, and many others. Brog has at his disposal an arsenal of primitive weaponry ranging from Bone Bombs to Chinese Bottle Rockets and Heat Seeking Homing Pigeons.
 In addition to single-player racing where one player races against the computer, there are also several different multi-player modes including Tag, Quest for Fire, and Survival. Up to four players can play on a single computer in split-screen mode.
 About this port: CMR was released in 2000 by Pangea Software. It was a pack-in game on Macs that came out around that time. This is a port of the original OS 9 version of the game, made under permission from Pangea Software, Inc.

flathub:io.typora.Typora.name: Typora
flathub:io.typora.Typora.summary: A minimal Markdown reading & writing app
flathub:io.typora.Typora.description:
Typora gives you a seamless experience as both a reader and a writer. It removes the preview
 window, mode switcher, syntax symbols of markdown source code, and all other unnecessary distractions.
 Instead, it provides a real live preview feature to help you concentrate on the content itself.

flathub:org.claws_mail.Claws-Mail.name: Claws-Mail
flathub:org.claws_mail.Claws-Mail.summary: Claws Mail is an email client (and news reader), based on GTK+
flathub:org.claws_mail.Claws-Mail.description:
Claws Mail is an email client (and news reader), based on GTK+, featuring:
 Quick response
 Graceful, and sophisticated interface
 Easy configuration, intuitive operation
 Abundant features
 Extensibility
 Robustness and stability
 The appearance and interface are designed to be familiar to new users coming from other popular email clients, as well as experienced users. Almost all commands are accessible with the keyboard.
 The messages are managed in the standard MH format, which features fast access and data security. You'll be able to import your emails from almost any other email client, and export them just as easily.
 Lots of extra functionality, like an RSS aggregator, calendar, or laptop LED handling, are provided by extra plugins.
 This is an unofficial package. (See package metadata for details.)

flathub:org.gnome.Evince.name: Document Viewer
flathub:org.gnome.Evince.summary: Document viewer for popular document formats
flathub:org.gnome.Evince.description:

 different formats.
 Evince supports documents in: PDF, PS, EPS, XPS, DjVu, TIFF, DVI (with SyncTeX), and Comic Books
 archives (CBR, CBT, CBZ, CB7).

flathub:org.kde.calligra.name: Calligra
flathub:org.kde.calligra.description:
Calligra is an office and graphics suite. It contains applications for word processing, spreadsheets,
 presentation and vector graphics.
 Words is an intuitive word processor and desktop publisher application. With it, you can create
 informative and attractive documents with pleasure and ease.
 Calligra Sheets is a fully-featured calculation and spreadsheet tool. Use it to quickly create
 and calculate various business-related spreadsheets, such as income and expenditure, employee working
 hours, etc.
 Calligra Stage is an easy to use yet still flexible presentation application. You can easily
 create presentations containing a rich variety of elements, from graphics to text, from charts
 to images. Calligra Stage is extensible through a plugin system, so it is easy to add new effects,
 new content elements or even new ways of managing your presentation. Because of the integration
 with Calligra, all the power and flexibility of the Calligra content elements are available to
 Stage.
 Karbon is a vector drawing application with a user interface that is easy to use, highly customizable
 and extensible. That makes Karbon a great application for users starting to explore the world of
 vector graphics as well as for artists wanting to create breathtaking vector art.

flathub:org.kde.kalzium.name: Kalzium
flathub:org.kde.kalzium.description:
Kalzium is a program that shows you the Periodic Table of Elements. You can use Kalzium to search
 for information about the elements or to learn facts about the periodic table. It provides an overview
 of the important data (like melting points, electron affinity, electron negativity, electron configuration,
 radii, mass, ionisation energy), an isotope table, and different colored views of the periodic
 table (separation of the different blocks, year simulator, temperature simulator). It contains
 tools to visualize the spectral lines of each element, a molecular weight calculator, a 3D molecule
 editor, and an equation solver for stoichiometric problems.

flathub:org.signal.Signal.name: Signal Desktop
flathub:org.signal.Signal.description:
To use the Signal desktop app, Signal must first be installed on your phone.
 Millions of people use Signal every day for free and instantaneous communication anywhere in
 the world. Send and receive high-fidelity messages, participate in HD voice/video calls, and explore
 a growing set of new features that help you stay connected. Signal’s advanced privacy-preserving
 technology is always enabled, so you can focus on sharing the moments that matter with the people
 who matter to you.
 Signal is an independent 501c3 nonprofit. The complete source code for the Signal clients and
 the Signal server is available on GitHub.
 This flatpak is maintained by the Flathub community, and is not necessarily endorsed or officially
 maintained by the upstream developers.

flathub:org.speedynote.SpeedyNote.name: SpeedyNote
flathub:org.speedynote.SpeedyNote.description:
SpeedyNote is a fast, open-source note-taking application designed for
 stylus users who need iPad-quality annotation on budget hardware. Built
 with native C++ and Qt, it delivers 360Hz stylus input on hardware as
 modest as an Intel Celeron N4000 at 1.1GHz — with no Electron bloat.
 Annotate PDFs with pressure-sensitive inking tools including pen, marker,
 and highlighter, all rendered as vector strokes that zoom infinitely
 without pixelation. Organize your work with multi-layer editing, paged
 notebooks, or infinite edgeless canvases with lazy-loading tiles.
 Key features include:
 Instant PDF loading with clickable internal links and outline navigation
 Multi-layer editing with add, delete, reorder, and merge operations
 Touch gestures: two-finger pan, pinch-to-zoom, and palm rejection
 Cross-platform note sharing via .snbx notebook packages
 Powerful command-line interface for batch PDF export and notebook management
 Multi-tab editing to work on multiple documents simultaneously
 Auto-save so you never lose work

flathub:org.unofficialrevport.REVHubInte.name: REV Hub Interface - Community Edition
flathub:org.unofficialrevport.REVHubInte.summary: Directly control a REV Robotics Expansion Hub
flathub:org.unofficialrevport.REVHubInte.description:
The REV Hub Interface is a piece of software allowing for a direct connection from a REV Expansion
 Hub and its peripherals to a PC.
 This interface provides a method for teams to prototype with motors, servos, and sensors in
 a way that is faster and easier than setting up an entire robot control system. It is also a valuable
 troubleshooting tool that can help isolate the cause of an issue and determine if it is electrical
 or software related. The REV Hub Firmware can also be updated and recovered through this interface
 in addition to the Robot Controller Application.
 This is a community continuation of the software, updating to newer underlying technologies
 (e.g. porting from Python 2 to Python 3), adding features, and porting to more platforms (Linux
 and macOS, in addition to Windows). Though initially created by REV, this version of the software
 is not maintained by or affiliated with REV. Do not contact REV support about any issues you experience
 with this software.

firefox-addons:3044284.name: Smart Page Translator
firefox-addons:3044284.summary: Translate full web pages and PDFs with DeepSeek or OpenAI. Your own API key is required; the service may charge for requests.
firefox-addons:3044284.description:
Smart Page Translator translates complete web pages, text that appears after a page loads, selected text, text fields, and text-based PDF files.
Important: the extension is free and has no ads or subscription. Translation requires your own API key—an access code that you create on the DeepSeek or OpenAI website. These services may charge for translation requests. You pay the selected service directly. The extension developer does not collect payments or add fees.
It began as a personal tool for pages where other translators missed buttons, product descriptions, image labels, or text that appeared after the page loaded. It is now an open-source extension for public use.
What the extension can do:
 Translate a complete page, including new text that appears while you use it.
 Show only the translation or show the original and translation together.
 Save separate translation and display rules for different websites.
 Translate product descriptions while keeping brand names and personal names unchanged when possible.
 Translate selected text and text in the active field from the browser menu.
 Offer an optional compact button beside selected text. This button is off by default.
 Translate text-based PDF files and download a translated copy.
 Reuse saved translations to avoid paying for the same request again.
 Show the extension interface in English or Russian.
Your API key and saved translations stay in extension storage on your device. Text goes directly to DeepSeek or OpenAI only when translation runs. The extension developer does not receive your key or text. Text from private windows is not added to the persistent cache.
The source code, data flow, build instructions, and third-party notices are public.

bluejetty:00183840:ios.description:
Take Control of Your Finances with Monthly Expenses
Track your spending in seconds. Just speak your expense or tap a category to record it quickly — then use the calendar, budgets, graphs, and reports to understand where your money goes.
Key Features:
• Voice Input — Say your expense out loud and quickly record it without typing.
• Calendar View — Tap any date to add or review expenses and see your spending at a glance.
• Expense Tracking — Organize expenses by category and subcategory, so you always know where your money goes.
• Budgeting — Set monthly budgets for your categories and keep track of your spending progress.
• Graphs & Reports — Explore clear spending breakdowns and trends to better understand your finances.
• Spending Reminders — Set reminders for bills, planned expenses, and recurring spending.
• Custom Categories — Start with built-in categories or create your own to match the way you spend.
• iCloud Backup & Sync — Keep your expense data backed up and available across your devices.
Why Monthly Expenses?
• Tracking your spending shouldn't feel like work. Monthly Expenses makes it quick and simple to record everyday expenses, monitor your budgets, and understand your spending habits.
• Whether you're tracking household expenses, managing a monthly budget, or simply trying to spend more consciously, Monthly Expenses gives you a simple way to stay organized.
• Start tracking your expenses today and get a clearer picture of your finances.
Download Monthly Expenses now and take the first step toward financial clarity.
Subscription pricing and terms:
'Monthly Expenses Lite' app offers auto-renewing monthly, quarterly, half-yearly and yearly subscriptions at various respective prices to provide you with premium features of our app such as no ads and backup features while you maintain an active subscription.
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified.
You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase.
Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00130184:ios.description:
ADD AND TRACK YOUR ORDERS
Before and during your journey, you can add and track orders that you plan to pick up at one of D’Arrigo Bros. Co.’s locations. 
SCHEDULE APPOINTMENTS
Appointments can now be scheduled through the app prior to arriving at our facility.
AUTOMATIC CHECK-IN AND PICK UP WITH THE PRE-CHECK-IN FEATURE
As you get closer to your pick-up location, you can pre-check-in your order to let us know that you are close to arriving. When you arrive at your pick-up location, the app will automatically check in your order and you will receive a door number assignment. You will then be ready for us to load your order.
TIMELY STATUS UPDATES
During your journey and while you are waiting to load your order, the app will provide you with real-time status updates, including a door assignment.
D’ARRIGO SUPPORT CHAT
Should you need any assistance during your pickup journey, you can contact the D’Arrigo Bros. Co. team directly through the chat function in the app.
MULTIPLE LANGUAGES
The D’Arrigo Bros. Co. Check-in app is available in English, Spanish, and French.

bluejetty:00100226:ios.description:
MusiQ turns your ideas, memories, and emotions into fully original songs - no musical experience required.
Simply describe the kind of song you want, choose a style or theme, and let advanced AI compose high-quality music complete with lyrics, vocals, and instrumental arrangements.
► Instant Song Creation
From heartfelt ballads and upbeat pop tracks to cinematic scores and rap verses, MusiQ generates complete songs in seconds. Just enter your idea, pick the style, and watch your music come to life.
► Choose from Dozens of Creative Themes
Not sure where to start? Select one of MusiQ’s guided themes and let AI help you craft the perfect track:
• Love & Romantic Songs
• Friendship & Birthday Songs
• Travel & Adventure Songs
• Pet Tribute Songs
• Motivation & Feelings Songs
• Triumph & Achievement Anthems
• Special Moments & Celebrations
• Photo-Inspired Songs
Each theme gives you simple prompts to personalize the lyrics and mood.
► Wide Range of Music Styles
Customize your sound with genres and vibes that fit your story:
• Pop, rap, hip-hop, R&B
• Acoustic, indie, rock, EDM
• Nostalgic 80s, cinematic, lo-fi, emotional
• Upbeat, mellow, energetic, romantic
• Male vocals or female vocals
• And many more...
MusiQ adapts instantly to the mood you choose.
► AI Covers — Reimagine Any Song
Create AI-powered covers in seconds. Choose from a variety of vocal styles or use your own custom voice and upload your favorite song. MusiQ will perform a brand-new version using the voice you select. Record your natural voice to create a personalized AI voice, then hear yourself perform songs across different genres and moods. Whether you want a soulful acoustic cover, a powerful pop rendition, or a completely reimagined remix, MusiQ brings a fresh interpretation to the music you love.
► Lyric Writing Made Easy
Describe what you want the song to express a memory, emotion, message, or story and MusiQ generates unique, meaningful lyrics tailored to your prompt. You can even provide your own title or storyline for a fully personalized track.
► Save, Share & Listen
Save your songs, listen to them, and share them with friends, family, or followers. Whether it’s a gift, a surprise, or a creative project, your AI-generated music is always easy to access and enjoy.
► Who It’s For
• Anyone wanting to create a unique song for a loved one
• Content creators looking for custom music
• Musicians exploring new ideas
• People celebrating a special moment
• Anyone who wants to have fun making music with AI
No experience needed - just your imagination.
► Unlock the Full Experience
A MusiQ subscription unlocks all themes, styles, and unlimited song creation.
Download MusiQ today and turn your ideas into music with the speed and creativity of artificial intelligence.

bluejetty:00119013:ios.description:
This revamped version of FedMobile– Federal Bank’s highly popular mobile banking application - comes with more user-friendly and advanced features than its predecessor, ensuring a richer and more pleasant experience for its users. We have combined Mobile Banking, FedBook and BHIM UPI into a single application plus a whole host of new features and services to make it a one stop shop for all your banking needs. 
Enriched with new banking and payment features, this version of the app is a complete package, which enables users to access and manage their accounts from anywhere, anytime; it enables the user to undertake – banking as well as non-banking transactions. 
Specific features include :
Recharge & Bill Payments: Our recharge and bill payment sections allow you to do mobile/DTH/Fastag recharges and payment of a wide variety of bills including Mobile, Electricity, Water, Gas etc. 
Transfer funds online: Make payments and funds transfers online real-time, using payments methods like UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS etc. 
BHIM UPI: We have integrated all the UPI functionalities into the app so that allows you to enjoy the full bouquet of UPI services using this app. 
FedBook: Bank’s digital passbook app is now available as an exclusive feature in FedMobile. This allows you to access all your accounts and statements without having to download FedBook separately. 
Investments: Using the app, you can now invest in Gold and Bank’s various deposit schemes. The “Help Me decide” feature in the app will guide you to the most suitable investment option among all the options. 
Loans: A full-fledged loans module allows you to manage all your loan accounts, repay loan instalments, apply for loans, and avail loans instantly. 
Account Services: The account services menu in the side bar allows you manage features linked to your account like Transaction limits, PIN, VPA, Biometric Login, Profile, Email IDs, Nominee details, ON/OFF/Block/Unblock debit cards etc. 
Service Requests: You can make an array of service requests like Cheque Book, submission of 15G/H, Download TDS certificates, 
Merchant Services: Our new merchant services section allows you to make Cab, Bus, Flights and Hotel Bookings. 
To experience the ease and convenience of a truly world-class mobile banking app, download the FedMobile now. 
Our developers are still fine tuning the app to help you see your accounts listed in the payments page faster and complete UPI, send money/scan and pay transactions quicker. 
Terms and conditions: https://federalbank.co.in/tandc 
For any queries related to FedMobile, please write to us at contact@federalbank.co.in or call us at 1800-425-1199/1800-420-1199(National Toll Free Number) or +91-484-2630995/2630995(for NRI customers)

Sciences et Avenir - La Recherche, vous fournit une information complète et accessible sur toute l'actualité scientifique, des articles de synthèse dans toutes les disciplines: les sciences naturelles, l'environnement mais aussi les sciences humaines.
Cette application est un kiosque numérique. Elle reproduit l’intégralité du magazine papier publié chaque semaine.
Grâce à l’interface de consultation, vous pouvez ensuite :
- Lire le journal avec un grand confort et faites défiler les pages en une fraction de seconde ;
- Feuilleter le journal en mode portrait ou en mode paysage ;
- Lire les articles grâce au zoom haute définition .
Abonnez-vous directement depuis l'application.
Deux formules d'abonnement vous sont proposées : 1 mois pour 4,99€ et 1 an pour 44,99€.
Le montant de votre abonnement est débité sur votre compte iTunes automatiquement à la confirmation de votre achat.
L'abonnement est reconduit automatiquement sauf si vous désactivez cette option au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Aucune résiliation n'est possible pendant la période active en cours.
L'abonnement et son renouvellement peuvent être gérés à partir de votre compte dans l'App Store.
Mentions légales : https://www.sciencesetavenir.fr/page/mentions-legales

bluejetty:00007266:android.description:
APAS - Master Coding Interviews Anywhere, Anytime!
Your all-in-one coding interview preparation tool, built for software engineers aiming for success in the tech industry.
Struggling with Coding Interviews? APAS Has You Covered!
🚀 Are you preparing for a job in the tech industry but unsure how to tackle challenging coding interview questions?
🤔 Want to enhance your algorithm and data structure skills but have limited time?
⏳ Afraid of forgetting the solutions to problems you've already learned?
Say goodbye to stress! With APAS, you can master coding interview problems effortlessly and efficiently. Plus, enjoy the power of AI-driven coaching, all in the palm of your hand!
Why APAS Stands Out?
🔥All 3700 Leetcode Problems: Master algorithm, data structure, and system design problems sourced from real-world interviews.
🤖Smart AI Coaching: Use the latest AI to help you translate code into the programming language you like, analyze time and space complexity, and explain code line-by-line in English!
📚Spaced Repetition Review: Strengthen your long-term memory with adaptive review tracking.
⏱️Mock Interviews: Simulate real interview scenarios with timed quizzes.
🎨Syntax-Highlighted Code: Easy-to-read solutions with line numbers, full-screen expansion, and clear explanations.
✅Problem Marking & Notes: Mark problems as done or for later, and jot down quick notes.
🔍Advanced Search: Quickly locate problems by name or ID.
📂Categorization: Explore problems sorted by difficulty, topic, or company-specific interview questions.
🌙Night Mode: Reduce eye strain with a battery-friendly dark theme.
📶Offline Mode: Access all problems and solutions offline—anytime, anywhere.
🔔Regular Updates: Stay ahead with new Leetcode problems and instant notifications.
✨Clean UI: Dive into detailed problem descriptions with one-click access to Java-based solutions.
What is APAS?
APAS stands for Algorithm Problems and Solutions—your go-to coding interview app for offline learning and preparation. Whether you're a coding novice or a seasoned developer, APAS simplifies your preparation by focusing on the essential concepts of algorithms and data structures.
Explore Data Structures & Algorithms
Data Structures:
- String, Array, Stack, Queue, Hash Table, Map
- Linked List, Heap, Tree, Trie, Segment Tree
- Binary Search Tree, Union Find, Graph, Geometry
Algorithms:
- Binary Search, Divide and Conquer, Recursion
- Dynamic Programming, Memoization, Backtracking
- Greedy, Sorting, Sliding Window, Bit Manipulation
- Breadth-First Search, Depth-First Search, Topological Sort
Why You’ll Love APAS:
✔ Comprehensive coverage of interview topics.
✔ Perfect for quick, on-the-go learning.
✔ Suitable for all levels of expertise.
Join Hundreds of Thousands of Developers Today!
💡 Start your journey toward acing coding interviews now. With APAS, you'll have the confidence and skills to tackle even the toughest challenges.
📥 Download APAS today and turn your coding dreams into reality!
Need Help or Have Feedback?
We’re here for you! Share your thoughts via in-app feedback or email us at zhuzhubusi@gmail.com. Your input drives our improvements!

- Leetcode problems
- Coding interview preparation
- Algorithm learning app
- Data structures and algorithms
- Mock coding interviews
- AI for programming

BECOME
bluejetty:00002109:android.description:
Spider Hero Man Spider Game – an action-packed adventure for fans of superhero games!
Step into the shoes of a legendary spider hero man and explore a vast urban landscape filled with thrilling challenges and pulse-pounding action.
BECOME THE ULTIMATE SPIDER HERO Man – FIGHT CRIME IN VICE TOWN
Unleash your incredible spider fighting skills to take down gangster crime. Swing through the city, fight enemies, and restore peace to vice town. Your agility, strength, and rope skills will be the ultimate tools in your heroic journey.
MASTER THE ART OF SPIDER FIGHTING Man
As the spider hero man or iron hero man, you’ll face powerful foes and encounter escalating challenges. Upgrade your abilities, enhance combat skills, and unlock new powers to dominate your enemies and conquer the city.
EXPERIENCE THE MAJESTY OF VICE TOWN
Immerse yourself in stunning 3D graphics and dynamic gameplay. Navigate the skyscrapers, engage in epic air battles, and immerse yourself in a world brimming with action, adventure, and adrenaline-pumping battles.
Spider Hero Man Spider Game 
Soar through the skies and take on thrilling missions to defeat gangster crime.
Engage in stunningly animated combat with high-quality graphics and immersive sound effects.
Enjoy dynamic gameplay with multiple levels and challenges.
Utilize rope mechanics to swing, climb, and navigate the cityscape like a true spider hero.
Use strategic combat to defend vice town from destruction.
Showcase your climbing and fighting skills to outwit enemies and protect the city.
Join the fight, become the Spider Hero Man, and save Vice Town in this thrilling hero game. Are you ready to take on the challenge?

Femometer is a smart PM
bluejetty:00132069:ios.description:
Take control of your unique menstrual cycle with Femometer, the smartest ovulation & fertility tracker for those who need to track their periods or try to conceive. We believe to know your body, is to own your life.
Femometer is a smart PMS tracker, period and fertility calculator that records your unique cycle to accurately predict your ovulating days and menstruation, boosting your conception rate up to 150%. Femometer is a professional menstrual period and fertility tracker, providing data and insights for women controlling their health.
Record your pregnancy test results such as LH and HCG tests. Daily reminder for ovulation calendar and fertile window created by machine learning algorithms that learn from your data. All data can be exported into PDF files for professionals.
Record prenatal tests, BBT, weight for a mother-to-be, and your growing baby’s details so we can accompany you every step in your pregnancy journey. Let's get healthier & fitter!
Period Calendar, Ovulation Tracker
- Record your PMS, flow intensity, and current and past period dates, and ‘my menstrual cycle calendar’ will be generated automatically to predict your next period even if it’s irregular.
- Record BBT (basal body temperature), ovulation tests, and CM (cervical mucus). Ease-and-fast records for you to log your test results. 
- Log 200+ symptoms, from fertility to lifestyle and women’s health
- Set up cycle calendar reminders for your periods, PMS, ovulation, fertile days, and BBT.
Fertility Calendar & Graphs & Curves
- Check your fertility calendar, easily track your menstrual cycle phases and predict your ovulation, and manage your fertility window.
- Auto-generated BBT curves and LH curves based on your recorded data. Easily recognize the different phases of your cycle and spot subtle differences and capture your peak results to conceive or predict your next period.
- Optimize curves with machine-learned algorithms to complete missing data
Fertility Insights
- Current & Previous Menstrual Cycle Interpretation: Analysis of BBT curves, ovulation test, pregnancy test, PMS and ovulation symptoms. Track ovulation and reveal the conception rate to manage ovulation and fertility with precision.
- Conception & Pregnancy Prediction: Receive daily conception guidance and get pregnant easily and spot pregnancy early.
- Behavioral Scoring: Efficient tracking behavior leads to accurate ovulation prediction, increasing the chances of pregnancy, and effectively managing fertility
- Statistics Analysis: Reveals the patterns of your cycle symptoms, compares and analyzes data in multiple ways, gains better insights into your ovulation and fertility.
- Scientific and structured fertility courses: Courses and articles from professionals to help you raise your fertility awareness.
The medical information on the Femometer Period Tracker App is provided as an educational resource only and is not a substitute for professional advice, diagnosis, and treatment. The company does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or usefulness of any content, whether provided by us or by the third party. Always seek the advice of a physician before making any healthcare decisions.
Subscription Policy
- Plans: $9.99 Monthly, $19.99 Quarterly, $49.99 Yearly 
- Payment: Payment will be charged to your Apple account on confirmation of purchase
- Cancellation: Manage at your Apple Account Settings
- Renewal: The account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Femometer Period Tracker App Privacy: https://www.femometer.com/en/policy/appPrivacyPolicy
- Femometer Period Tracker App Service: https://s.femometer.com/miscs/femometer-app/en/service.html
The Femometer Period Tracker integrates with Apple Health App so you can sync your data (requires iOS 9 and above). Femometer supports Face ID for security.

bluejetty:00140982:ios.description:
Turn one selfie into a full movie starring you. Not another janky dance or fighting clip but real cinematic episodes with you as the lead, shot like a show you'd actually binge.
Here's the idea: send one photo, pick a genre, and Zingroll casts you as the main character of your own AI movie. 
Imagine, a teen drama where you're the new kid. A heist where you pull off the impossible. A slow-burn romance, a courtroom showdown, a zombie apocalypse where you're the last one standing. Your face, real scenes with an actual story.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
– Star in a movie about literally anything, pick a genre and we build the story around you.
– Roleplay any fantasy world — recap your D&D campaign, drop into a universe you love, or write yourself into a new one.
– Get fresh drops daily. New AI shorts and short-drama episodes, made for you.
Under the hood it's a serious movie maker that turns a single photo into cinematic, story-driven scenes, not the sloppy AI video you've scrolled past. We built the whole production so a full film about you takes one tap and a fraction of what real production costs. 
You've watched a thousand stories about other people. Time to be the main character. Send your selfie and roll episode one.
T&C: https://zingroll.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://zingroll.com/privacy

bluejetty:00187417:ios.description:
Enjoy seamless and secure mobile banking on the Nedbank Money app. Simplify your finances conveniently at your fingertips. Enjoy a wide range of features like the functionality to bank from anywhere at anytime, personalised investment solutions, free credit score reports and shopping deals on the Avo SuperShop. Download the Nedbank Money app today and choose the bank that’s best for your money.
Features:
1. Safe and secure banking 24/7: Access your Nedbank accounts at anywhere and anytime and stay on top of your finances.
2. Enhanced security with biometric login: Bank safer with biometric authentication, such as FaceID or TouchID. Bank with peace of mind knowing that your accounts are protected by world-class security features. 
3. Instant money transfers: Instantly transfer money between your accounts or make instant payments to other banks in just a few taps. 
4. Personalised investment solutions: Invest for the future you want with unique investment solutions using the investment calculator and get access to a range of investment accounts.
5. Free credit score reports: Make informed decisions about your financial health with free monthly credit score checks. Improve your score and make better money choices.
6. Loans and interest rates: Apply for a loan when you need it most in minutes. Stay on track of current interest rates and repayments on the app. 
7. Bill payments and prepaid services: Never miss a monthly payment again. Pay your bills and buy airtime, data, and electricity at your fingertips.
8. Shop deals on Avo by Nedbank: Shop deals from your favourite brands on Avo by Nedbank. Discover exciting deals, exclusive offers, and enjoy a hassle-free shopping experience.
9. Manage your cards: Switch to virtual cards for online payments or manage your physical cards on the app. Manage your card limits, view transaction history, block and freeze lost and stolen cards and access other card-related services.
10. Find an ATM or branch: Find nearby ATMs and Nedbank branches using the in-app map. 
11. Get real-time notifications: Stay on top of your money goals with real-time transaction notifications and account activity alerts. 
Enjoy convenient banking in the palm of your hand with the Nedbank Money app. Download it now and choose the bank that’s best for your money.

bluejetty:00071004:ios.description:
Dig into math, win rare cards! the exciting app that turns mental math practice into a treasure hunt for kids and families! 
Sharpen your brain with fun math games and earn rare cards as you solve problems. Whether you're cracking the tricky block puzzle or racing to solve the toughest to win big, every correct answer brings you closer to claiming your rewards!
Tailor your math journey with customized daily practice to focus on what you need most. Made a mistake? No worries! Our smart quiz learns from your errors to help you get better. Watch your progress grow as you check rewards in your chest and nurture your lucky plant with every success. With fun for the whole family, Math Mole makes math a blast for everyone!
Join the adventure, solve fast, and stack up your reward today!
A special thanks to my daughter, Anna(1st grade), for testing this update and inspiring delightful new features. Her creativity helped bring this update to life.
"Our whole family loves this app! This is so much fun and is getting my girls to really focus on math facts fluency and get motivated to answer the problems quickly. Cool multiplication games for kids and adults!"
- App Store Review
"Perfect! This is exactly what I was looking for. It runs well. I love writing the problem out, and it has a clean and professional look to it. I master all times tables! Thank you."
- App Store Review
"My kid love this math drills app, they now get a+ in math from this app they use to get b+! It's ready for students of all ages to practice!"
- App Store Review
Always, love to hear your thoughts: shrekdad@gmail.com

Math Mole is free to download. Everyone is welcome to a free 3-day trial period of the Pro Unlimited in-app purchase, Pro Unlimited gives you unlimited access to our premium features and contents.

- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and at the cost of the chosen package
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Links to Your Privacy Policy and Terms of Use at https://shrekdad.github.io/1498107670_tos.html
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication
- At the end of your subscription, you will be able to keep any content that your received while your subscription was active.

bluejetty:00007989:android.description:
Set birds songs as ringtone, alarm or sms notification. Best nature app with birds sounds! Help you relax after hard day!
Birds in the forest.
Bird vocalization includes both bird calls and bird songs. In non-technical use, bird songs are the bird sounds that are melodious to the human ear. In ornithology and birding, (relatively complex) songs are distinguished by function from (relatively simple) calls.
Biomusic is a form of experimental music which deals with sounds created or performed by non-humans. The definition is also sometimes extended to included sounds made by humans in a directly biological way. For instance, music that is created by the brain waves of the composer can also be called biomusic as can music created by the human body without the use of tools or instruments that are not part of the body (singing or vocalizing is usually excluded from this definition).
Biomusic can be divided into two basic categories: music that is created solely by the synthetic animal (or in some cases plant), and music which is based upon synthetic animal noises but which is arranged by a human composer. Some forms of music use recorded sounds of nature as part of the music, for example New Age music uses the nature sounds as backgrounds for various musical soundscapes, and ambient music sometimes uses nature sounds modified with reverbs and delay units to make spacey versions of the nature sounds as part of the ambience.
People use nature sounds relaxation techniques for the following reasons, among others.
Anger management (roar of the surf, sea, water flow, waves on a beach sounds, ocean, rain sounds)
Cardiac health (rain forest sounds, birds singing)
Depression therapy(birds sounds, yoga music,white noise app)
Bedtime songs and bedtime sounds (Australian bird sounds)
General well-being (waves on a beach, jungle sounds)
Headache therapy (birds singing, ocean waves sounds)
High blood pressure (roar of the surf, waterfall sounds, white noise)
Immune system support (sounds of brook, creek, stream let, river, white noise)
Insomnia therapy(all water sounds, rain sounds, sleep sounds, sounds of blackness)
Pain management (all birds songs, all water sounds)
Stress management (sounds of storm, lightning, thunder, rain sounds, white noise lite)

Compare two pictures and look for the differences between them. Spot the difference and tap on it. Find out all the differences in the time allowed!
Explore lots of different colorful pictures and have fun while you're trying to spot the differences within the limited time. Train your brain while enjoying the game!

- Useful features: zooming in and out will help you to spot the differences

bluejetty:00134320:ios.name: Train Manager - 2026
bluejetty:00134320:ios.summary:
Are you the next Cornelius Venderbilt and railway mogul? Can you achieve a monopoly? In Train Manager you create and manage your own railroad empire where you build it up from nothing to owning routes all over the world.
Compete to be at
bluejetty:00134320:ios.description:
Are you the next Cornelius Venderbilt and railway mogul? Can you achieve a monopoly? In Train Manager you create and manage your own railroad empire where you build it up from nothing to owning routes all over the world.
Compete to be at the top of the multiplayer leaderboards and challenge your friends and other real life train managers from all over the world.
REAL LIFE TRAINS AND STATIONS
Utilize the power of a train tycoon simulator to create a strategy where you can become as big as real rail companies like Deutsche Bahn, SNCF, BNSF, CSX, Union Pacific, Japan Railway Company or CNRC and claim monopoly. Create, schedule and explore international routes between train stations like Shinjuku, Hamburg, London Waterloo, Grand Central Terminal, Paris Gare Du Nord, Taipei, Roma Termini or Penn Station.
Track your trains live when they drive from town to city or when they are staying idle at stations.
CHOOSE REALISTIC GAMEPLAY
You can play on two difficulties: either EASY or REALISM. Go the easy way to lower prices and increase profits or challenge yourself with realism where you have to be the manager of the smallest things like the fuel prices and taxes.
ENVIRONMENT FRIENDLY
Not only is it more convenient and easy to travel the railroads, but it’s also better for the environment compared to a car, ship or plane. Be a green manager and help bring more focus on transport of passengers and cargo by train.
From steam engines to running on diesel to high-speed electric bullet trains - you are able to shape the future and set yourself up for success if you deploy the right tactics.
Features include
- Track your routes LIVE
- Manage your staff
- Invest in rival rail companies 
- Put your company on the stock market
- Create or join alliances with influential managers or friends
- All the most known real life locomotive types
- Buy and sell used cars and caravans

bluejetty:00186199:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00186199:ios.description:
Smart Diary is a complete student planner / school diary, with this application you can:
• add homework, tests and free notes on the Diary
• manage your absences
• use the Organizer, a tool that help you managing the time dedicated to tasks
Upgrading to the Premium version (through in-app purchase) you will be able to:
• manage your weekly timetable
• manage your grades, set goals
• customize the app appearance with themes
Here are all the functions.
1. Subjects and Timetable
• For every subject you can choose a color, add the Professor, and other notes
• Set the timetable selecting the subject and the lesson type. You can customize the timetable changing the maximum hours, the end of the week, set the hour in the 'hour:minute' format
• Multiple Timetables
• Print your weekly timetable
2. Tasks and Absences
• Mark a task as important or done, set the required time, set a reminder, associate an emoji
• View your tasks in different ways; classic diary with pages or list grouped by day
• Reorder the tasks to better organize the Diary, just tap and hold on a task
• Mark absences. Count absences by type and period
• Memos section
3. Time Management
• Organizer - a powerful but simple tool to schedule tasks, it allow you to specify the required time and schedule the task over 
multiple days. Calculation of the daily work, swipe and consult the days with the bar chart
• Time - a pure time management tool. Create work session with customized countdowns
4. Grades Management
• Multiple evaluation systems supported (numeric 0 - 10, alphabetical A - F, etc)
• Grades chart and filter by grade type / period
• Check your general average
5. Goals
• Set a grade as a goal, by subject and grade type
• Calculate the required grade to reach your goal or the sufficiency
6. Notes
• Dedicated editor to write notes
• Text formatting in bold, italic, highlighted
• History of the previous text reviews
7. General features and customization
• Set a reminder notification for tasks, you can select a rapid reminder or a specific date
• 3D Touch Shortcut by pressing deeply on the app icon
• Customize the appereance of the Diary section with themes
8. Widget and backup
• Widget with tasks overview for the following day, timetable widget
• Data and Preferences Backup on iCloud
9. Apple Watch
• Add new tasks dictating in natural language
• View tasks and timetable
• Mark a task as done
The app is free with limitations, you can unlock all the features through in-app purchase.

Our smart algorithm learns your preferences and curates recommendations just for you, ensuring you always discover new content you’ll love.

Enjoy crystal-clear HD visuals and seamless playback, designed to provide a smooth, uninterrupted experience that respects your time.

Every Moment Matters
MomeShort transforms your idle time into opportunities for emotion and discovery. Whether you’re looking for a quick burst of entertainment, a spark of inspiration, or just a brief escape into another world—MomeShort delivers, right when you need it.
Download MomeShort now and turn your moments into memorable entertainment!

bluejetty:00131447:ios.description:
The My BMW App is the ultimate vehicle companion. Check the status of your BMW, plan trips in advance, manage all your charging needs, or use one of the many remote features all from the convenience of your smartphone. In addition to daily mobility needs, the My BMW App supports you in many other ways, from booking your next service appointment to discovering more about your vehicle. You can start using the My BMW App as soon as you receive your VIN number in pre-delivery mode, so don’t wait.
CHECK YOUR VEHICLE STATUS
“All Good” – The My BMW App provides you with an overview of crucial status information like your BMW’s drive-ready state, enabling you to:
•View your vehicle's location
•Check your current fuel/energy level, tire pressure and vehicle alerts
•Get updated in case alarms are triggered or the vehicle is hit while parked
•Add widgets to your home screen for even quicker access
OPERATE YOUR VEHICLE REMOTELY
Control the functions of your BMW directly from your smartphone:
•Schedule and activate climatization
•Lock and unlock the doors, access the trunk, operate the horn and lights, and with later generation vehicles open and close windows.
•Record images from inside and outside the vehicle 
•Update your vehicle configuration remotely, including onboard apps
NEW: PASSENGER REMOTE CONTROLS (model dependent)
When joining a roadtrip, passengers can use the My BMW App to operate multiple onboard functions such as climate settings, media control, interior lights and navigation functions like sending destinations directly to the onboard navigation – by invitation of the driver and even without BMW ID. 
PLAN AND ORGANIZE YOUR TRIPS
Search for your destination, including fueling and charging stations, and car parks:
•Plan trips and keep an eye on the traffic situation including optional daily commute companion
•Interact with our live map with updated information on charging, fueling, and parking
•Send destinations directly to your vehicle, including from 3rd party apps
•Review your trip history and get monthly and annual trip summaries
MANAGE YOUR ELECTROMOBILITY NEEDS
Smart support of your electromobility for range planning and charging management:
•Find charging stations nearby or at your destination with tariff details and local amenities
•Simplify your electric journeys with BMW intelligent trip planning to optimize charging stops
•View detailed statistics and history for your charging sessions
•Use your car as a power source with bidirectional charging management (model dependent)
•Connect and manage your BMW Wallbox conveniently via the My BMW App
EXPLORE THE WORLD OF BMW
Stay up to date and find the right products for your BMW:
•Discover and manage BMW products, services and subscriptions
•Get instant answers to questions with our online BMW AI chat 
•Explore tutorial videos tailored specifically to your vehicle model
•Link your financial service account for easy access
MANAGE REQUIRED SERVICES
The My BMW App is your direct line to your retailer if service is needed:
•Keep an eye on required services
•Book service appointments via the app
•Chat with your service partner in case of any questions
•View maintenance and repair requirements by video
•Get roadside assistance when needed 
The My BMW App is optimised for vehicles built from 2014 onwards. The availability of individual app functions depends on your vehicle equipment and your BMW ConnectedDrive contract. The availability of app functions may vary between countries and vehicle models.

bluejetty:00014807:ios.description:
Money is the #1 source of complexity for tech employees, especially around RSUs, equity, and taxes. Titan is here to handle it.
OUR FIRM
Founded in 2017, Titan is a private wealth management firm built for high-performing tech professionals. By combining specialized Wealth Teams with AI-powered technology, we deliver the relationship intimacy of a boutique advisor with the scale, access and capabilities of a leading wealth firm. From equity compensation and tax strategy to major life decisions, we help clients navigate complexity with clarity, confidence and ease. With a dedicated advisory team hailing from JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, and UBS, we manage over $1.25 billion* in assets and have delivered over $302 million** in total growth to our clients since inception.
OUR CLIENTS
We serve emerging high net worth employees, both pre and post IPO, from leading technology companies throughout the United States, including OpenAI, SpaceX, Meta, Google, and NVIDIA.
OUR EDGE
Leveraging AI-powered technology, specialist advice and dedicated Wealth Teams, we deliver a smarter way to manage wealth - designed for the next generation of builders, founders and professionals, at a fraction of the traditional cost.
Competitive Fees:
0.4% annual fees, no commissions.
We win when you win.
Exceptional Service:
Dedicated wealth teams, fast response times and a beautiful client experience.
Proprietary Access:
Access to “Titan-only” products, such as Titan Flagship, Titan Direct Indexing, and Titan Diversify.
OFFERINGS
From RSU planning to tax optimization to estate coordination, our team handles the complexity so you don't have to. Our capabilities span investments, equity compensation, tax planning, retirement and financial planning, trust and estate planning coordination, and insurance coordination.
HERE'S WHAT YOU GET
- A dedicated Wealth Advisor as your primary relationship
- A Client Service Associate for account operations and transfers
- A professional Investment Team managing your portfolio
- Tax-aware strategies across Smart Sell, Direct Indexing, and Smart Treasury
- Active and passive investment management across equities, fixed income, and alternatives
- Trust, estate, and retirement planning coordination
- Market expertise through proprietary research, reports, and audio notes
Your wealth deserves a proper team. 
Disclosures
* AUM as of 6/2/2026
** Figure represents the total growth for all Titan clients from Titan’s first strategy launch on 2/20/2018 through 3/31/2026, net of fees (where applicable). Includes both realized and unrealized gains of all offerings made available over time, accounting for the reinvestment of dividends. The 5-year figure is $230M from 4/01/2021, and the 1-year figure is $86M from 4/01/2025. Figures are before tax and do not account for individual client tax liability. Some clients experienced losses individually that are netted against gains in this aggregate. Not representative of any individual client's experience.
Titan Global Capital Management USA LLC ("Titan") is an SEC-registered investment adviser. Titan's affiliate, Titan Global Technologies LLC, is an SEC-registered broker-dealer. All investments carry risk, including the potential loss of principal. Past performance is not indicative of future results, and investment growth is not guaranteed. Certain investments are not suitable for all investors. Keep in mind that while diversification may help spread risk, it does not assure a profit or protect against loss. Investors should consider their investment objectives and risks carefully before investing. Please visit www.titan.com/disclosures for additional disclosures. Not an offer to buy or sell securities. Not tax advice.

bluejetty:00062163:ios.description:
Learn Guitar, Piano, Drums, Bass, and Singing with Step-by-Step Music Lessons
Musora is a music lessons app that helps you learn guitar, piano, drums, bass, or singing through guided, follow-along lessons. It’s the easiest way to learn an instrument, because you always know what to practice, when to move on, and when to reinforce skills as you go, so they stick.
Perfect for beginners and self-taught musicians, all the way to experienced musicians who need to refine their skills.
Learn at your own pace with structured lessons designed to help you play real music and make progress you can feel.
LEARN FROM THE BEST
Your teachers are GRAMMY winners, touring professionals, and lifelong educators. Learn from instructors like:
- Chad Smith of the Red Hot Chili Peppers
- Drum legend Kenny Aronoff (John Mellencamp, Bob Seger, The Rolling Stones)
- Dream Theater’s keyboard virtuoso, Jordan Rudess
- Jazz prodigy Jesús Molina
- Jason Richardson, known for his blazing-fast guitar work (Born of Osiris, Chelsea Grin, All That Remains)
- GRAMMY-nominated artist Josh Ramsay (Marianas Trench)
- And many more.
5 INSTRUMENTS. ONE APP.
Drum Lessons (Drumeo)
Learn drums through guided lessons, songs, and workouts. From the basics of setting up your kit all the way through to limb independence, chops, double bass, odd time, and much more. 
Piano Lessons (Pianote)
Build piano skills with guided lessons, songs, and workouts. Everything you need to play your first melody and chords to countless genres, improvisation, and more! 
Guitar Lessons (Guitareo)
Learn guitar with step-by-step lessons, songs, and workouts covering chords, strumming, faster picking, riffs and solos, new genres, and more across the acoustic and electric guitar.
Bass Lessons (PlayBass)
Learn bass with our all-new bass lessons focused on groove, timing, technique, and real bass lines. Start with core courses and keep progressing as new bass lessons are added regularly.
Singing Lessons (Singeo)
Improve your voice with structured vocal lessons, songs, and workouts on pitch, tone, range, vocal control, and more. Follow along step-by-step, and you’ll become a confident vocalist.
ALWAYS KNOW WHAT TO PRACTICE NEXT
Musora removes the guesswork from learning music.
1. Open your learning path
2. Follow your daily lessons
3. Practice without second-guessing
Each lesson builds on the last, reinforcing skills while methodically adding new ones so your learning actually sticks.
LEARN YOUR FAVORITE SONGS
Choose from a library of 5000+ professionally transcribed songs and learn them with tools designed to make progress faster and less frustrating.
- Professionally transcribed songs you can trust
- Sheet music, drum charts, chord charts, and tabs so you can learn on any instrument
- Loop sections to focus on the parts that need the most work
- Adjust tempo to slow songs down or push your limits
- Remove any instrument from the mix so you can play that part yourself
Everything is built to help you learn songs completely, not just get through them once.
TRACK PROGRESS. STAY MOTIVATED.
- Auto-track every lesson you complete
- Add offline practice sessions
- Track your personal stats and progress over time
You’ll always know where you are, what you’ve learned, and what to work on next.
WHO MUSORA IS FOR
- Beginners starting from zero
- Self-taught musicians who want structure
- Hobbyists who want to play for fun
- Players who want consistent progress without overthinking practice
No prior experience required.
START YOUR FREE TRIAL
Start a 7-day free trial and get full access to guitar, piano, drums, bass, and singing lessons — all in one app.
Join a global community of over 100,000 musicians learning with Musora and following clear lesson paths built to keep you progressing.
Try it risk-free. If Musora isn’t right for you, you’re covered by our 90-day money-back guarantee.
Privacy Policy: https://www.musora.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.musora.com/terms

bluejetty:00084114:ios.summary: Dive into "Unsolved Case: Ash and Secrets", the ultimate experience for fans of hidden object games, where every shadow holds a clue. Step into a gripping world of intrigue and suspense, where your skills in seek and find hidden objects are
bluejetty:00084114:ios.description:
Dive into "Unsolved Case: Ash and Secrets", the ultimate experience for fans of hidden object games, where every shadow holds a clue. Step into a gripping world of intrigue and suspense, where your skills in seek and find hidden objects are the key to unraveling a deadly crime investigation. This installment of the acclaimed series delivers an unparalleled thrill for lovers of detective games, challenging your instincts and intelligence. Are you ready to face the secrets lurking in the Great Green Reserve? Follow a trail of clues, from a cursed amulet to a village torn apart by corruption, betrayal, and greed.
Your reputation sends shivers down the spines of criminals, but new foes are emerging — calculating and ruthless. Investigate the murder of truck driver Harry Wright in the dangerous Great Green Reserve. A mysterious amulet at the crime scene reveals a web of corruption, leading you to a village furious over a highway project threatening their burial grounds. Confront Chad Simmons, the businessman behind the highway, and Wabano Folsom, the desperate village elder. Navigate betrayals, uncover a missing diary, and solve the mystery of who benefits from Harry's death. With your trusty partner Paul by your side, chase down leads and confront the true killer behind these chilling crimes. 
Dynamic Storyline!
Interrogate suspects, seek and find hidden objects, and solve mystery games. With the help of your partner Paul, navigate a tense narrative that connects personal vendettas, corruption, and redemption in our detective games!
High-Stakes Choices!
Your decisions impact the fate of the innocent and guilty alike. In this crime investigation, every action you take shapes the story, balancing justice and mercy as you face dilemmas that only detective games can deliver!
Hidden Object Games!
Investigate beautifully crafted crime scenes that blend suspense and discovery. Each location challenges your observation skills, offering puzzles and clues that set an intriguing crime investigation in hidden object games.
Test Your Skills!
Each crime scene is packed with challenging sequences that combine traditional seek and find hidden objects gameplay with innovative mini-games and story-driven tasks. Use your sharp eye to uncover the secrets behind every shadow!
Take the unsolved case, detective — justice awaits in the free trial of "Unsolved Case: Ash and Secrets"!

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/

bluejetty:00077978:ios.name: GliderVerb
bluejetty:00077978:ios.summary:
GliderVerb is a “Reverberator with Glissandos” simulating a room gradually changing its shape. It is an expanded version of an algorithm created by James McCartney for his Supercollider 2 programming language.
The original algorithm had no
bluejetty:00077978:ios.description:
GliderVerb is a “Reverberator with Glissandos” simulating a room gradually changing its shape. It is an expanded version of an algorithm created by James McCartney for his Supercollider 2 programming language.
The original algorithm had no user-variable parameters: this device adds a series of parameters to create a wide palette of effects; from evolving reverberations to granular disintegration to smooth resonances.
Main Features:
- Audiobus and Inter-App Audio support (sender and FX)
- Continually Modulated Reverb Algorithm
- Pitch Resonator
- Ribbon Resonance Player
- Pad impulse generator
- Built In Stereo Sampler with varispeed
- Control Manager LFO for Parameters
- Midibus, Virtual Midi and Network: 14 bit NRPN controllers
- File Manager, sharing common audio files via iTunes, Dropbox and AudioCopy
- Snapshots Presets Morphing Pad
- Post Fx Chain: Low-shelf Filter, High-shelf and Compressor
New Version! We removed the "annoying voice" and now you can use all the Gliderverb features, even the Pad and the Ribbon. The only limitation is you can't save new presets; but you still can load the old ones you made, using the two arrows you find on the left and right side of the preset name (top side of the main window).
With the in-App purchase you can access the Preset Manager, Control Manager and MIDI enable the Pad.
