bluejetty:00116057:ios.name: Cube Solver - 3D Cube Timer
bluejetty:00116057:ios.summary: Every day, thousands of users rely on our app to transform their jumbled rubik's cubes into perfectly aligned masterpieces. Our Rubiks Cube Solver app has amassed a vast user base, with enthusiasts from all corners of the globe flocking to
bluejetty:00116057:ios.description:
Every day, thousands of users rely on our app to transform their jumbled rubik's cubes into perfectly aligned masterpieces. Our Rubiks Cube Solver app has amassed a vast user base, with enthusiasts from all corners of the globe flocking to experience its unparalleled rubiks cube solving capabilities.
Do you envy those who can effortlessly twist and turn the cube, transforming a jumbled mess into a perfectly aligned masterpiece in mere seconds? No more cube stress—toss the tangle and solve easy with Rubiks Cube Solver! This app’s your go-to buddy, mixing AI tech with a no-fuss design that’s as easy as swiping. Whether you’re a total newbie or a cubing whiz, it’s like having a pro friend who turns messy cubes into wins—fast and fun.
HOW IT WORKS
Using Rubiks Cube Solver is incredibly simple. Just follow these easy steps:
- Open the app: Launch Rubiks Cube Solver on your mobile device and tap the "Scan Cube" button.
- Scan your cube: Hold your device's camera over the Rubik's Cube and rotate it slowly to capture all six sides. Our app will automatically detect the colors and positions of each cubelet, analyzing the cube's state in real-time.
- Get your solution: Once the scan is complete, Rubiks Cube Solver will generate a detailed step-by-step solution tailored to your cube's specific configuration. You can choose to view the solution as a series of text instructions, a 3D animation, or a combination of both.
- Solve your cube: Follow the instructions provided by the app, turning the cube according to the suggested moves. Our app will guide you through each step of the process, providing helpful hints and tips along the way.
Key Features and Benefits
- Advanced Computer Vision Technology: Rubiks Cube Solver uses state-of-the-art computer vision algorithms to accurately detect the colors and positions of each cubelet, ensuring a precise and reliable solution every time.
- Step-by-Step Instructions: Our app provides detailed, easy-to-follow instructions that are tailored to your skill level and learning style. Whether you prefer text, images, or 3D animations, Rubiks Cube Solver has you covered.
- Real-Time Feedback: As you solve your cube, Rubiks Cube Solver provides real-time feedback, highlighting the moves you've made and the ones you still need to complete.
- Progress Tracking: Our app keeps track of your cube-solving progress, allowing you to monitor your improvement over time. You can view your solve times, move counts, and other statistics, and compare your results with other users around the world.
- User-Friendly Interface: Our app features a clean, intuitive interface that is easy to navigate and use.
Why Choose Rubiks Cube Solver?
- Accuracy: Our app uses advanced computer vision technology to ensure a precise and reliable solution every time. You can trust Rubiks Cube Solver to guide you to a successful cube solve, no matter how complex the cube's configuration.
- Speed: Rubiks Cube Solver generates solutions in seconds, allowing you to solve your cube quickly and efficiently.
- Ease of Use: Our app is designed with the user in mind, featuring a simple, intuitive interface that is easy to navigate and use. You don't need to be a computer expert or a cube-solving master to use Rubiks Cube Solver – just download the app, scan your cube, and let the magic happen.
- Versatility: Rubiks Cube Solver supports a variety of Rubik's Cube sizes and types, including the classic 3x3x3 cube, the 2x2x2 cube, the 4x4x4 cube, the 5x5x5 cube, the 6x6x6 cube, the 7x7x7 cube, the 8x8x8 cube, the 9x9x9 cube, the 10x10x10 cube, the 11x11x11 cube, and more.
Email: macflamedev@outlook.com
Privacy Policy: https://gocubesolver.com/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://gocubesolver.com/Service_Terms

For true Fortnite fans, here’s the ultimate way to bring your favorite skins, outfits, and Battle Pass characters to life! Pixelnite combines the excitement of Fortnite with the relaxing fun of color by number pixel art. Relive your favorite Fortnite seasons while painting characters, emotes, and outfits in a unique, creative style.
Why Fortnite Fans Love Pixelnite
- Hundreds of Fortnite characters and skins: From the latest Battle Pass to legendary outfits.
- Daily updates: Fresh pixel art of Fortnite characters added regularly.
- Color by number simplicity: Just follow the numbers for easy, stress-free coloring.
- Fortnite themed pixel art: Outfits, heroes, emotes, and weapons ready to color.
- Fun coloring tools: Brush, bucket, or bomb tool for quick filling.
- Repaint anytime: Color your favorite Fortnite skins again and again.
- Save & share: Keep your Fortnite art or share it instantly with friends.

- Smooth and vibrant 2D pixel art experience.
- Stress-relieving color-by-number system.
- Regular updates to keep Fortnite content fresh.

bluejetty:00036917:ios.summary: Screwdom is a challenging and brain-teasing screw master 3D game that will put your problem-solving skills to the ultimate test. This exciting game combines the thrill of sorting with the fun of screw master 3D, offering a perfect balance o
bluejetty:00036917:ios.description:
Screwdom is a challenging and brain-teasing screw master 3D game that will put your problem-solving skills to the ultimate test. This exciting game combines the thrill of sorting with the fun of screw master 3D, offering a perfect balance of relaxation and brain-teasing action.
Why Choose Screwdom?
• Perfect for All Ages: Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore screw puzzle solver, this screw puzzle offers a perfect challenge and fun for everyone.
• Sharpen Your Brain: This screwdom puzzle will enhance your logical thinking, problem-solving, and strategy-making skills as you work your way through increasingly tricky levels.
• No Time Limits: Play at your own pace! There's no rush, so you can take your time to solve each screwdom puzzle and enjoy the process.
How to Play:
• Look at the screwdom stacked on different pins.
• Identify the color of screw master 3D that matches and move them to the correct box.
• Be mindful of the order in which you move the screwdom – one wrong move can block your progress.
• Keep sorting the screwdom until each color is placed in the corresponding box.
• Unlock more levels and enjoy endless screw puzzle.
Screwdom puzzle is not only about playing a game, it's about unlocking the world of screw puzzle. Each level is a challenge so that you can enhance your problem solving.
 Stunning models: Screwdom offers hundreds level of models from house, duck, cube, etc. You can freely discover new levels and train your mind with different unscrew strategies to be a screw master 3D.
 Continuous update: We are continuously updating new levels, 3D models and improvements to serve your best experience.
 ASMR and colorful gameplay: Click sounds from screwdom puzzle and colorful models will help you relieve stress and keep you entertained after a long working day.
Ready to dive into the world of screw, colors, and puzzles? Enjoy hours of satisfying gameplay with Screwdom.
Developed by iKame Games

bluejetty:00186528:ios.description:
***** Developed by an award-winning education studio, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling Abby Basic Skills app, in cooperation with educational specialists. 
***** A title from our extremely successful Abby series -- all TEN (!) RANKED #1 APP FOR KIDS on APP Store in many countries. 
Become a firefighter! Drive and play with the fire truck! Save the world from fire!
Interactive 3D Fire truck by 22learn is an app filled with activities that encourage young children's imagination, play, and exploration. In four games, children drive a fire truck, explore it, extinguish fire, and learn to locate hidden tools and truck parts. This will become every child's favorite toy!
 ================================ 
Interactive 3D Fire truck is an educational app that will help your toddlers and preschoolers develop problem solving skills, knowledge about fire trucks, and attention control. 
================================ 
* DRIVE THE FIRE TRUCK: 
Start the fire truck's engine, rotate the steering wheel and run around the room as the camera of your device projects the surrounding environment onto the truck's windows! It will look like you are actually driving around your house! Really, it is so much fun! You have to experience this yourself! 
* EXPLORE THE FIRE TRUCK: 
Rotate fire truck and observe it from various angles. Play with the lights, start the engine, draw the ladder, honk the horn, turn on the fire truck siren, open doors, press all the funny little buttons, discover fire truck's tools and more! 
* EXTINGUISH FIRE: 
Be a hero. Be a firefighter. The world needs your help! Tap on the fires to extinguish them with your powerful fire hose! 
* LOCATE PARTS OF THE FIRE TRUCK: 
Wanna be a firefighter? First, you need to educate yourself! Familiarize yourself with tools and fire truck parts and locate them as quickly as possible! A funny twist on a classical seek-and-find game! 
************************** 
With four engaging activities, tons of realistic animations and sound effects, child-friendly interface, and a colorful, fire truck-themed design, Fire truck is going to be every child's dream come true toy. Plunge into the world of little superheroes and open doors to your imagination with this amazing app brought to you by 22learn!

Novellair is an online reading platform that is home to a wide range of stories.
Hide away with endless stories in Novellair, a book nook just for you!
Take your pick from an extensive range of genres. Whether it's a captivating romance or a heartstopping thriller you're craving, Novellair can satisfy you. Tickle your reading fancies with something new or stick to your favourite themes - whichever you choose, we have what you need.

If you're passionate about storytelling, you can even apply to join Letterlux through the link: https://letterlux.tech/ and see your book featured on Novellair.
Fill your library with all the stories you love and escape into the world of books with Novellair.

1. Period：monthly(auto-renewable subscriptions)
2. Price：$19.99/month

4. Renewal: The Apple iTunes account will automatically deduct fees within 24 hours before the subscription expires. After successful deduction, the subscription will be postponed for one cycle.
5. Cancel：You can cancel your subscription at any time 24 hours before the subscription expires.
6. Manage subscriptions: You can view and manage your renewals.
7. Award：After subscribing, the coins and vouchers received each month are limited. If you need more coins, please make an additional recharge.
8. Privacy:https://fqnewapi.novellairs.com/privacy_policy
9. Term of Service:https://fqnewapi.novellairs.com/user_agreement

bluejetty:00164989:ios.description:
Design the perfect gallery wall or poster arrangement without putting unnecessary holes in your walls!
GalleryWall is the ultimate planning tool for homeowners and interior design enthusiasts. Whether you are arranging family photos, art prints, or a modern poster collection, creating a cohesive layout can be a challenge. GalleryWall removes the guesswork, helping you visualize, measure, and perfect your design before you ever pick up a hammer.
Stop turning your walls into Swiss cheese. Plan your layout virtually and hang your frames perfectly on the first try.
Key Features:
* Precise Planning & Measurements: Define the exact dimensions of your walls, frames, and posters. Calculate the perfect spacing and margins to ensure everything fits flawlessly.
* Visual Mockups: Upload your own images and photos into virtual frames to see exactly how your art will look in your space.
* Exact Hook Locations: The app calculates the exact coordinates for your nails or hooks, ensuring your frames hang perfectly level on the first try.
* Compare Layouts: Create multiple wall designs, organize them in folders, and easily swipe through them to compare different arrangements and styles.
* Custom Framing & Cropping: Adjust frame styles and crop your images perfectly to fit any medium.
* Share Your Vision: Export your completed walls as high-resolution images to share your layout ideas with family, roommates, or clients.
* Creating a beautiful, cohesive gallery wall that reflects your personality has never been easier.
Feedback & Support: If you have ideas on how to improve the app or need assistance, please email me at info@gallerywall.app. Thank you!

bluejetty:00179838:ios.description:
Build your portfolio and grow your Total Worth as high as you can!
Earn money and raise the capital to start your own company, invest in high risk areas or stay safe with a savings account.
Investment options:
- Savings account
- Mini lottery
- Bond
- Stocks !!NEW!! - With the all new stocks section, you can choose which companies to invest in, keep safe with slow growing reliable companies or risk it with newer, high risk options!
- Crypto
Pick a strategy or try a combination of them all!
Manage your investments as the world transitions through different periods.
Holding more stocks in growth periods will give you better returns, but watch out for occasional recessions where some companies will lose large amounts of value.
Control different aspects of your company.
- Expand it by investing in bigger office space.
- Select how much to pay your employees.
- Negotiate with other company owners who may want to buy yours.
Employ staff to help manage accounts, security and receive investment advice!
Don't forget to leave enough money to pay your taxes at the end of the year.
Face difficult financial decisions, win awards and choose how generous to be with charity donations. All of your decisions will impact how well you build your wealth.
EARN
This section allows you to earn money in different ways.
Once you have enough money, you can choose to start your own company. 
You will then be faced with many difficult decisions:
What wage to pay your employees, too little and they won't be happy, too much and you won't make a profit.
Whether to invest in larger office space to expand your company.
Whether to employ an Accountant to avoid any financial errors.
And many more!
INVEST
Choose from a variety of ways to invest your money:
Savings Account, pays you a set interest rate every week, a safe investment with guaranteed small returns.
Mini Lottery, your investment is placed in a prize draw every week, prizes range from $50-$1million.
Bond, your investment is locked away for a set term, all returns are then tax free.
Stocks, choose to invest in individual companies or a combination through ETFs, don't forget stock values can go down.
Crypto, extremely high risk investment, for a price you can employ a Crypto Advisor to give you pointers on when to increase your investment.
STATEMENT:
Keep an eye on your yearly statement, as you make money you will be required to pay more and more tax.
Make sure you have enough available money cover your tax at the end of the year.
REPORTS:
Look back at every week you play to keep track of your historic transactions.
Save reports from you history to look back at key events, big investment gains or lottery wins.
LOAN:
In case of emergencies you can always borrow some money, with varying interest rates.
NEWS:
Keep track of the latest news around companies and growth/recession periods.
Compete with players around the world with Game Centre.
For support, please contact us at: portfoliotycoon@gmail.com

There’s just one thing keeping you from treasure and riches beyond your wildest dreams: an infestation of deadly dragons.
But these aren’t just any old fire breathing dragons, oh no. Each one you encounter is more challenging than the last, wielding fiery, fearsome powers that no-one could tackle alone.

bluejetty:00015084:ios.description:
The Cessna Flight Training Companion App enables you to download and complete the lessons from your online Cessna Sport/Private Pilot or Instrument Rating courses -- anywhere, anytime! 
To use this app, you must have already purchased and enrolled in a Cessna online course. The Companion then allows you to download and complete labs from your Cessna course by studying the lesson content and taking the quizzes that follow each lesson right on your iPad--and your progress is automatically synced with your online course. You can also download and view each of your Video Flight Previews offline, so that you will be fully prepared for each flight lesson.
The Cessna Training System is specifically designed to work best when studying at a Cessna Pilot Center and will efficiently give you the vital flying knowledge you'll use for the rest of your flying career. 
Cessna Flight Training Courses are Born from a Passion for Flying
These innovative courses, developed in partnership with Cessna, are complete online training courses that integrate ground and flight training to take you from zero time to your new certificate or rating. Since the ground and flight lessons are paired, these courses work best if your flight instructor uses the Cessna Flight Training Syllabus, as is done at Cessna Pilot Centers and select flight schools around the world. You'll learn faster, retain more, stay ahead of your training, and achieve your goal quicker than through more traditional approaches.

bluejetty:00119688:ios.name: Track My Mileage
bluejetty:00119688:ios.summary: Do you need to keep track of mileage for business, charitable, medical/moving or personal reasons but find paper logs are difficult to maintain? Well, Track My Mileage will make that process extremely easy. Do you want an app that allows yo
bluejetty:00119688:ios.description:
Do you need to keep track of mileage for business, charitable, medical/moving or personal reasons but find paper logs are difficult to maintain? Well, Track My Mileage will make that process extremely easy. Do you want an app that allows you to pick the fields you currently need but allows for future additions? Well, Track My Mileage is extremely flexible and allows you all customizability you need now and in the future. You can even customize the text style and size.
Features: 
Pay once and use purchases across iPhone/iPad and Mac versions.
Supports AirDrop and AirPrint of total mileage reports
Share your trips with Macs, iPhones, iPads and iPod Touches while keeping a backup of your data for safe keeping. 
Supports tracking your mileage using GPS. Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Supports receipt tracking
Supports round trips and reimbursement amount doubling
Supports multiple business tracking including trip sorting and total mileage reporting by business
Supports work number field with trip sorting
Supports job numbers field with trip sorting
Supports the recording of arrival, departure, pick up time, drop off, lunch start and/or end times and includes trip sorting 
Get reports in CSV format that is compatible with Numbers or Excel
Choose from 21 different reports, which are convertible to PDF format which can be password protected
Supports filtering of trips which allows you to archive previous mileage and start fresh without losing your current trips. Trips can be filtered by a combination of trip date range, origin, destination, vehicle, driver, client, mileage type, purpose, notes, status and/or business columns. For the date range you can select a start and/or end date or choose from these shortcuts: This Week, Last Week, This Month, Last Month, Month To Date, Year To Date, Last 2 Months, Last 3 Months, Last 6 Months, Last 9 Months, Last 12 Months, This Year or Last Year.
Supports multiple client tracking which includes trip sorting and total mileage reporting for each client
Supports tracking these expenses: general, parking, tolls, meals, lodging, business center, conference, telephone, incidentals, other, gas and per diem. You can even provide notes specific to expenses and you can sort your trips by any of the expense columns.
Supports multiple driver tracking and includes trip sorting and total mileage reporting for each driver. Additionally, for all drivers easily export a report of total trips, total miles, average miles per trip and total vehicles driven.
Supports mileage type categorizing and includes trip sorting and total mileage reporting for each mileage type. For convenience, business, charitable, medical/moving and personal mileage types are automatically created but you can customize the list. Additionally, for all mileage types easily export a report of total trips, total miles, average miles per trip, total drivers and total vehicles driven. 
Supports multiple vehicle tracking and includes trip sorting and total mileage reporting for each vehicle. Additionally, for all vehicles easily export a report of total trips, total miles, average miles per trip and total drivers. You can also setup your own vehicle safety checklist and be prompted once per day to perform the checks.

Download now and become a part of the Crypto Elite!

bluejetty:00084709:ios.description:

Shoppe das komplette POCO Sortiment direkt auf deinem Smartphone – wann und wo du willst. Möbel fürs Wohnzimmer, Deko für alle Räume, Lampen, Teppiche, Elektrogeräte und mehr – einfach in den Warenkorb legen und nach Hause liefern lassen oder zur Abholung in deinen POCO-Markt bestellen. Finde jede Woche neue Aktionsartikel und Online-Deals in der App. Blättere durch die aktuellen POCO Prospekte und entdecke die besten Angebote aus den Bereichen Möbel, Küchen, Lampen, Deko und vieles mehr – bevor sie ausverkauft sind.

Rubbellose: Freirubbeln & Gewinnen
Mit den POCO ‘Jubellosen’ kannst du in der App jeden Monat fantastische Preise gewinnen, von Einkaufsgutscheinen bis Elektronik.. Einfach freirubbeln und mit etwas Glück absahnen!
Digitale Kundenkarte & Treuepunkte
Jetzt Treuepunkte sammeln und für Rabatte auf den nächsten Einkauf erhalten. Registriere dich kostenlos für das ‘Mein POCO’ Treueprogramm, um deine digitale Kundenkarte freizuschalten. Erhalte neben einem Willkommensgeschenk Treuepunkte für alle Einkäufe in unserem Möbelhaus oder durch 24/7 Shopping im Onlineshop (1 EUR = 1 Treuepunkt - außer auf Dienstleistungen und Pfand). Gesammelte und aktive Treuepunkte kannst du durch Vorlage der digitalen Kundenkarte an den Kassen unserer Möbelhäuser einlösen. (1 Treuepunkt = 1 Cent). Um es dir noch einfacher zu machen, kannst du deine digitale Kundenkarte nun auch zum Wallet hinzufügen.
Scan & Go: Entspannter Einkaufen im Möbelhaus

Neue Küche? Jetzt Beratungstermin vereinbaren
Du träumst von einer neuen Küche? In der POCO App kannst du ganz einfach und unverbindlich einen Planungstermin in einem POCO Einrichtungsmarkt deiner Wahl vereinbaren. Lass dich von unserem Sortiment inspirieren und finde die Küche, die zu dir passt.
Inspiration & Home Design
Entdecke jede Woche frische Einrichtungsideen, DIY-Tipps und die neuesten Home-Design-Trends – von Skandi-Look über Industrial Chic bis hin zu modernen Hochglanzmöbeln. Die passenden Produkte findest du direkt im Online Shop oder in deinem POCO Markt.
POCO Markt in deiner Nähe finden
Mit dem integrierten Marktfinder findest du schnell den nächsten POCO Einrichtungsmarkt – inklusive Öffnungszeiten, aktuellen Angeboten und direkter Navigation. Über 125 Märkte in ganz Deutschland warten auf dich.
Jetzt App downloaden & kein Angebot mehr verpassen
Mit der POCO App verpasst du keine Schnäppchen mehr! Sichere dir jede Woche neue Sonderangebote, exklusive App-Coupons und dauerhaft günstige Preise – ideal für alle, die ihr Zuhause stilvoll und günstig einrichten möchten.

The Dunkin’ UAE Rewards App is available exclusively for customers across the United Arab Emirates.

bluejetty:00077926:android.summary:
Tap Away is a unique and addictive 3D casual puzzle game that will keep you hooked. Hey, get ready to use your wit and sharp eyes to climb to the top of the global leaderboard. 
Unlock the clustered blocks and become the top player in Tap
bluejetty:00077926:android.description:
Tap Away is a unique and addictive 3D casual puzzle game that will keep you hooked. Hey, get ready to use your wit and sharp eyes to climb to the top of the global leaderboard. 
Unlock the clustered blocks and become the top player in Tap Away game. With increasing difficulty, whether you are a casual player looking to kill time or a hardcore gamer looking for a challenge, we welcome you.
Hey, we are a group of serious game developers who take pride in our work. 
Here are some of the features that set Tap Away apart from other games: 
- Stage-based challenges. Each area presents a new challenge. 
- Light social environment, compete with friends or strangers on the leaderboard. Join a guild with like-minded players to become the best. 
- Seemingly chaotic but logically connected blocks that give you a sense of accomplishment when solved. 
- Magical props to assist you, but timing is everything. 
- Excellent graphics and diverse art styles. 
How to play: 
Based on the direction indicated on the blocks, touch the 3D blocks on the screen to make them detach from the others. Since the blocks can only fly in one direction, you need to avoid colliding with other blocks that are still attached. You can rotate the entire screen 360° and think from various angles to achieve victory. Perhaps the props can give you a helping hand, but it's up to your intelligence when you run out of options. 
Why choose us? 
- Challenge different difficulty levels and showcase your achievements to the world. It will prove your worth. 
- Nothing beats playing this game to relieve stress. 
- Expand your problem-solving skills and practice logical thinking. 
- Excellent 3D graphics and sound effects. 
- Suitable for all ages. - Hey, this game is super cool!
What you and we both want:
A vast number of levels combined with a plethora of art styles are concentrated in a small phone, and among the carefully designed variety of art styles, there is definitely one you like the most. Multiple sets of cards, different art styles, there is always one set that you want to collect the most. We do not make the majority, and we also hope that players do not make the majority. I hope you can experience not only playing a game, but also the unique experience that this game brings.
Let's go to solving the puzzle now!

Flight Simulator 2025 - Fre
bluejetty:00063374:ios.description:
Flight Simulator 2025 - Free Flying is a realistic flight simulation game with a number of amazing airplanes to choose from. 
You can fly single piston planes, water planes, cargo planes and even military planes!
Flight Simulator 2025 - Free Flying will make you feel like a real life pilot! 
Just drag the throttle bar all the way up to accelerate and then tilt the phone up to take off! Drive around, complete your missions and then guide your plane towards the runway, slow down and reduce your altitude and smoothly land on the runway. Be careful not to crash!
Play thrilling missions or just fly your favourite plane over the big beautiful open world in Flight Simulator 2025 - Free Flying.
FLYING MISSIONS
Complete challenging flying missions like water transportation, refueling, smooth landing, competing in races and many more. 
FREE FLIGHT
Explore Choose your favourite airplane and fly it all over the beautiful big open world. Fly over the shimmering water and the majestic mountains.
MULTIPLAYER MODE
The highly anticipated Multiplayer Mode is now LIVE. Create private rooms for a personalized flying experience with friends, or join random rooms to embark on exciting adventures with fellow aviators.
FEATURES of Flight Simulator 2025 - Free Flying:
- Challenging missions
- Realistic open world environment
- Fleet of awesome airplanes to choose from
- Realistic Cockpit interiors
- Beautiful airports for take off and landing your flights
- Stunning 3D graphics
- Realistic game sound effects with take off, flight landing and airplane parking
Experience the ultimate flight ride with this realistic flight simulator.
Get Flight Simulator 2025 - Free Flying now and fly like a real pilot!
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. After your purchase you can manage your subscription options and turn off the auto-renew feature from your iTunes user account settings.
Please note that any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription before the end of the free trial period.
If the Auto-Renew feature is turned off when your current subscription ends, you will be unsubscribed

bluejetty:00139116:ios.description:
Build credit fast with Arro, the credit builder app that helps you grow your credit score while earning cash back. Start with up to $300 credit limit and build credit history with no deposit required. Whether you're new to credit or rebuilding your score, Arro makes it easy to build credit, track your progress, and grow your credit limit up to $2,500.
Why Choose Arro to Build Credit?
Arro gives you instant access to a real Mastercard that builds credit while rewarding your everyday spending with 1% cash back on gas and groceries. Most credit builder programs require security deposits or lengthy waiting periods. With Arro, you can start building credit immediately and grow your credit score fast.
No Deposit Required – Get up to $300 credit limit instantly, then grow your credit line up to $2,500 in the Arro app.
Proven Results – Our credit builder program has helped thousands of members improve their credit scores by an average of 40 points within 2 months. Members who follow Arro recommendations often see 100+ point increases, with some reaching 715+ credit scores from having no credit history.
Instant Access – Use your virtual Arro Card immediately while building credit. Add to Apple Pay and start earning rewards today.
Build Credit While Earning Cash Back
Arro rewards you for building credit. Earn 1% cash back on gas and groceries anywhere, including at major retailers like Walmart and Target. Every purchase helps build your credit score while putting money back in your pocket.
1% cash back on gas and groceries
Cash back rewards at Walmart, Target, and thousands of retailers
Build credit history with every purchase
AI Financial Coach – Meet Artie, your AI financial coach. Artie is the first AI financial chatbot designed specifically for credit building. Artie actively helps you build credit faster through personalized credit score guidance and real-time advice. Artie acts as your personal credit card concierge and financial coach, nudging you to take actions that build your credit. 
Personalized Financial Education – Artie tailors your financial education journey, adapting to your knowledge level and financial goals to help you build credit more effectively.
Real-Time Financial Guidance – Get immediate, accurate answers to credit and financial questions. Artie makes financial literacy accessible whether you're just starting to build credit or working to improve your score.
Track Your Credit Score & Build Credit History
Monitor your credit score in real-time and see how your credit building efforts pay off. Arro reports to all three major credit bureaus – TransUnion, Experian, and Equifax – ensuring your credit building progress is reflected across your entire credit profile.
Free credit score tracking and monitoring
Real-time updates on credit building progress
Credit score insights and improvement recommendations
Reports to all three major credit bureaus
Financial Education That Builds Credit
Build credit while building financial knowledge. With Arro's financial education, you:
Build credit and improve your credit score
Master budgeting and money management
Understand debt and credit utilization
Save for future goals and emergencies
Make smart financial decisions that build wealth
Earn Rewards for Building Credit
Arro rewards healthy financial habits that build credit. Complete financial education lessons, set up AutoPay, and make consistent payments to unlock credit line increases and exclusive rewards.
Credit line increases for responsible credit building
Rewards for completing financial education
AutoPay setup to build consistent payment history
Exclusive offers and financial benefits
Start Building Credit Today
Join thousands of members who've improved their credit scores with Arro. Whether you're building credit for the first time or rebuilding your credit score, Arro gives you the tools, rewards, and AI-powered guidance to succeed.
Download Arro now and start building better credit today.

bluejetty:00178881:ios.description:
Turn your favorite memories into beautiful Home Screen widgets! Photo Widget lets you enjoy your favorite photos directly on your iPhone and iPad Home Screen.
Designed to be photo-first and easy to use, Photo Widget helps you turn meaningful moments into widgets in just a few taps. No complex customization, no visual clutter - just the photos that matter most to you, always in view.
Whether it’s family, friends, travels, or everyday memories, Photo Widget keeps them close throughout your day.
With Photo Widget, you can:
• Create photo widgets in just 3 simple steps
• Choose from multiple widget sizes
• Add photos directly from your camera roll
• Display your selected memories on iPhone and iPad Home Screens
• Set how often photos refresh, at your own pace
• Optionally show today’s date for a subtle, useful touch
• Photo Widget is built for clarity, ease, and emotional connection so your Home Screen feels more personal!
NEW: Shared Albums
Create shared photo albums and let the people closest to you enjoy the same memories on their Home Screen. Whether it’s family moments, trips, celebrations, or everyday snapshots, sharing albums makes it easy to keep everyone connected through the photos that matter most.
Photo Widget is built for clarity, ease, and emotional connection, so your Home Screen feels more personal.
Have any questions?
Please check if the answers are available in the Frequently Asked Questions in the app Settings.
Have suggestions or unable to find the answers to your questions? Our support team is ready and happy to help at support@impalastudios.com!

Prices are shown in the app.

bluejetty:00016134:ios.description:
Solve the mystery of Nautilus in the hidden object adventure game!
A game based on "20,000 Leagues under the Sea", a famous novel by Jules Vernes. 
The game is TRULY FREE: you can download the full version for free and unlock every scene with no in-game purchases.
It tells the story of the incredible journey of mysterious Captain Nemo and three friends, who have inadvertently found themselves on board his underwater vessel, the Nautilus.
Frigate Abraham Lincoln sets out to search for an undiscovered sea monster. The expedition, in which Pierre Aronnax, his loyal servant Conseil, and Canadian harpooner Ned Land take part, finds the monster and starts a chase. Unexpectedly, the monster turns out to be a unique underwater vessel. Professor Aronnax and his two companions are taken prisoner by the captain of the Nautilus. Despite the fascinating beauty of the undersea realm, the three friends yearn to break free and return to normal life on dry land...
 This game has the following special features:
- Vibrant interiors of a character vessel, magical underwater views, and tropical islands.
- Complex and diverse locations: experience regular landscapes alongside 360-degree panoramas and 3D views!
- Build your collection of rewards! Go through scenes again to try new quests and get new rewards!
Jules Verne was an author who always surprised the world. His stories are so realistic that, even today, readers are convinced that the journeys he described were real.
We'll be happy to stay in touch with you at www.facebook.com/CrispApp : leave comments, ask questions and get news about coming games!

bluejetty:00018855:ios.name: iHorse™ GO: Rival Horse Racing
bluejetty:00018855:ios.summary:
Race real-time as the jockey and ride your horse to victory in iHorse™ GO: Rival Horse Racing! Up to 12 players can participate in a real-time player versus player (PvP) horse racing in each race! 
From the maker of the iHorse Racing serie
bluejetty:00018855:ios.description:
Race real-time as the jockey and ride your horse to victory in iHorse™ GO: Rival Horse Racing! Up to 12 players can participate in a real-time player versus player (PvP) horse racing in each race! 
From the maker of the iHorse Racing series, Hong Kong indie developer Gamemiracle brings out their latest star horse racing simulator game iHorse™ GO: Rival Horse Racing! Featuring realistic 3D horse racing gameplays, race against intense competition with online friends and players worldwide real-time! Become the best jockey in the world in different game modes including the Seasonal Fixtures and the GO Online Championship! Players can also hone up their jockey skills and ride on top ranked horses in some of the most memorable horse races in recent history in the Campaign mode! Recruit past and current champion horses from a huge list into your stable! You can also watch horse race replays from the Seasonal Fixture and Campaign mode to form race strategies and learn riding skills from other players. Players can also bet on horse races that are running in the Seasonal Fixture. 
A stable network connection is required during gameplay! iHorse™ GO: Rival Horse Racing is free to download and play. However, some in-game currency and items can also be purchased with real money. This game is intended for use by those 21 or older for amusement purposes only. Practice or success in this game does not imply future success at real money gambling. iHorse™ GO: Rival Horse Racing does not manipulate or otherwise interfere with tournament outcomes in any way. Results are based on skills and the choices made by players in the tournaments.
======== FEATURES ========
▶ Clash against up to 12 online competitors in the horse race season fixture! 60 races in a 4 hour cycle!
▶ Create a race club of up to 12 players and participate in jockey club competitions for a pool of prizes!
▶ Add friends to race and compete to become the world's top jockey!
▶ Global leaderboards to compete with your friends and online competitors!
▶ Watch and learn from top players' world record replays to become the best jockey in the world!
▶ Recruit legendary horses from USA, United Kingdom, Hong Kong, Japan, France and more, and build a stable to race in more tournaments and competitions! Train, equip and ride your own horses! 
▶ Breed your own race horses! Lineage and pedigree matters! Recruit stallions and mares including Frankel, Black Caviar, Northern Dancer, Beholder, American Pharaoh; and create the ultimate derby thoroughbred!
▶ Chat rooms to organize races, trade horses, talk about horse racing techniques and jockey skills.
▶ Bet and ride your race to win! Wager on the Seasonal Fixture races with multiple types of betting choices available: win, place, quinella, quinella place, and trio. 
▶ Players can choose to jockey any of the 12 horses in the Campaign mode horse races!
▶ Multiple missions in Campaign mode horse races for you to challenge!
▶ Seamlessly sync your game account between devices when connected to Facebook!
▶ The most realistic 3D track models include track turns, weather effects and elevations from Hong Kong racecourses!
Find us on Facebook for the latest updates and horses recruits at:
www.facebook.com/iHorseGoENG
Chat and discuss skills and tips on our official Facebook group - 
iHorse Go Discussion Group at: www.facebook.com/groups/144249359560853
iHorse Go YouTube channel: 
www.youtube.com/channel/UC5rf1SJQ9gLcRQu_-EZJZFQ

bluejetty:00023207:ios.summary: Easily and securely access and manage your 1st MidAmerica cards anytime, anywhere from your phone. For the 1st MidAmerica Cards app, you will create a new username and password. Use this app in addition to the 1st MidAmerica Credit Union ap
bluejetty:00023207:ios.description:
Easily and securely access and manage your 1st MidAmerica cards anytime, anywhere from your phone. For the 1st MidAmerica Cards app, you will create a new username and password. Use this app in addition to the 1st MidAmerica Credit Union app to get the most benefit out of your card.
Once you have created a new username and secure passcode for logging on, you will be able to manage how, when and where your cards are used:
• Set up transaction alerts to notify you when your card is used, when a transactions exceeds your limits, or when a transaction is declined via email, text or push notifications.
• Turn card on/off with Card Controls. When turned off, all purchases and ATM transactions will be declined until you turn on your card again. 
• Set spending limits by dollar amount, merchant, categories, and more. 
• Use Travel Notices for making purchases easier when you’re traveling.
Your security is our priority. Mobile data transmissions and account information are protected by 256-bit SSL encryption, similar to banking online. 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life. This pertains to the use of the Location Match feature.

bluejetty:00066035:ios.description:
Get your daily fix of Agent 47 with this elegant, strategy-based Hitman game!
5/5 Slide to Play: "…this is one to check out." 
4/5 Joystiq: "Hitman GO is an impressive debut for Square Enix Montreal.” 
4/5 Pocket Gamer - SILVER AWARD: "Hitman GO is a clever and refreshingly original puzzle game" 
4/5 Polygon: "Hitman GO is a great minimalist take on the series' big ideas" 
5/5 Pocket-lint: "Hitman GO is a clever and intelligent way of bringing a much-loved franchise to a mobile platform" 
BEST GAME DESIGN - 2014 Canadian Videogame Awards
BEST IOS GAME - 2014 Canadian Videogame Awards
Hitman GO is an award-winning turn-based strategy game with beautifully rendered diorama-style set pieces. You will strategically navigate fixed spaces on a grid to avoid enemies and take out your target or infiltrate well-guarded locations. You really have to think about each move and all the Hitman tools of the trade you would expect are included; disguises, distractions, sniper rifles and even 47’s iconic Silverballers.
With Hitman GO, you’ll experience:
• Challenging puzzles that put your assassination skills to the test
• Beautiful scale model-style visuals
• Environments with secret passageways and off-limit areas
• Agent 47’s tools of the trade: Distractions, disguises, hiding spots, sniper rifles and even the iconic Silverballers
• Different enemy types with unique and deadly behaviours
• Different ways of completing each level, silently or forcefully
Please note: 
** THIS GAME IS INCOMPATIBLE WITH THE iPod Touch 4th GENERATION ** 
Hitman GO minimum requirements: iPad 2 and above, iPad Mini, iPhone 4 and above, iPod Touch 5th generation and above.

bluejetty:00026733:ios.description:

bluejetty:00082146:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00082146:ios.description:
Sudoku & Variants by Logic Wiz – Relaxing Brain Training Puzzle Game.
Discover the ultimate Sudoku experience with Sudoku & Variants by Logic Wiz – a fun, relaxing, and brain-boosting number puzzle game. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned puzzle master, this app will challenge your logic and sharpen your mind.
Enjoy classic Sudoku and explore over 35 unique Sudoku variants, each introducing fresh logic twists — like Killer Sudoku, Diagonal Sudoku, Sandwich Sudoku, Arrow Sudoku, and many more.
Take on our Themed Weekly Challenges, where handcrafted puzzle sets revolve around fun, creative topics to keep things fresh and engaging every week.
Key Features:
• A wide variety of handcrafted puzzles
• Classic Sudoku for all skill levels
• Over 35 unique Sudoku variants to explore
• Fresh logic mechanics with each variant
• Weekly Challenges built around fun themes
• Smart hints and strategy explanations — no guessing required
• Beautiful minimal design for focused play
• Six difficulty levels, from Beginner to Master
• A perfect mix of relaxation and brain training
• Regular updates with new puzzles and variants
Popular Variants Include:
Killer, Sandwich, Thermo, Diagonal, Jigsaw (Irregular), Arrow, Windoku, Skyscraper, X-Sum, Kropki, German Whisper, Renban, XV, Lockout, Between Lines, Universal, Couples, Twisted Consecutive, and many more.
Additional Features:
• Multiple variants on a single board
• Unique logical solution for every puzzle
• Track progress, stats, and accomplishments
• Light and Dark modes
• Multiple pencil mark styles and notations
• Error-checking and solving aids
• Cloud sync across devices
• Optimized for iPhone and iPad
Inspired by puzzle communities like Cracking the Cryptic, Sudoku & Variants by Logic Wiz is ideal for solvers who love clever twists and deep logic — without the need to guess.

bluejetty:00016469:ios.description:
GMA News Online, compatible with tablets and smartphones, continues to deliver breaking news in the Philippines and around the world.
The app's regular features include news content from the various sections of GMA News Online: News, Sports, Money, SciTech, Showbiz, and Lifestyle. Get alerts and notifications on your device when a breaking news story is published. It also showcases videos from GMA and GTV. Aside from this, you will also be able to listen to DZBB and Barangay LS radio streaming 24 hours a day.
Experience optimum browsing and get all the information you need at the palm of your hand. The action bar lets you go directly to your preferred section and manage customization settings. Customize your GMA News Online app by choosing your favorite sections and the number of articles that will be displayed.
When an Internet connection is detected, news stories, photos, and videos are automatically updated with the latest content. You can then browse the news at your leisure. For easier reading, you can adjust the font of the text to a size that suits you. A link on each article gives you the option to view it on the GMA News Online mobile site. When browsing offline, the application loads the most recently downloaded news content.
Enjoy smooth scrolling within the articles, and just swipe to move from one section to another or from one story to the next in the same section. You may also share content to Facebook, X, and email from within the GMA News Online app.
To improve your experience, we bring regular updates with bug fixes and optimizations. Thank you for using GMA News Online.
You may also share the news article via Facebook, X, and email.

bluejetty:00083874:ios.summary:

30 Day Ab Workout Challenge gives you one clear plan for strong abs at home. Each day shows you the moves, the reps and th
bluejetty:00083874:ios.description:
Thirty days. A few minutes a day. A core that feels stronger every time you sit up, stand tall or pick something up.
30 Day Ab Workout Challenge gives you one clear plan for strong abs at home. Each day shows you the moves, the reps and the rest. You just follow along.
It starts easy. Then it gets harder a few reps at a time, so by week three you're doing things that felt impossible on day one.
HOW IT WORKS
Pick your level: beginner, intermediate or advanced. Each day mixes crunches, planks, leg raises, mountain climbers and twists that work your upper abs, lower abs, obliques and deep core. Rest days are built in.
AN HONEST NOTE ON BELLY FAT
No ab exercise burns fat from one spot. What works is a strong core plus a little less body fat overall. That's why the challenge comes with meal plans, so the work you put in actually shows.
WHAT'S INSIDE
Daily ab and core workouts for every level
A demo for every exercise so your form stays right
Workout calendar and daily reminders
Weight tracking and before and after photos
5 meal plans: vegetarian, vegan, Mediterranean, keto and Atkins
Water reminders and Apple Health sync
No equipment, just a bit of floor space
FOR WOMEN AND MEN
Whether you want a flat stomach or a visible six pack, the plan is the same: show up daily, keep good form, eat well. The app takes care of the first two.
BEFORE YOU START
Please check with your doctor before starting any new exercise program, especially if you are pregnant, injured or new to training.
SUBSCRIPTION
Your first workouts are free. To unlock every level, the full 30 day plan, meal plans and the progress tracker, choose a plan:
Weekly: $1.99 per week
Yearly: $29.99 per year (about $0.58 a week)
Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://www.lauruss.com/app/policy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00185081:ios.description:
Mynet Haber uygulaması ile güncel, spor, magazin, gazeteler, siyaset ve tüm son dakika haberleri ÜCRETSİZ olarak takip edebilirsiniz.
Gündem ile ilgili en son haberler ve gelişmeler için özel olarak tasarlanan Mynet Haber'i bedava indirin, Türkiye ve dünyadan en son haberler hemen ve hızlı bir şekilde telefonunuza gelsin.
Mynet Haber uygulaması yenilendi! Sana özel bölümüyle günlük ihtiyaçlarınızı karşılayan tüm araçlar tek bir uygulamada.
Mynet, yenilenen haber uygulaması ile en güncel ve son dakika haberler anında, 7/24 telefonunuzda.
- Sesli okuma özelliği ile haberleri kolayca dinleme,
- İster gece modu, ister gündüz modu kullanımı,
- Mail hesabı ile kolayca erişim,
- İlgi alanına göre kategoriler ile kişiye göre özelleştirme,
- Kolay kullanım, parmak hareketi ile haberler ve kategoriler arasında geçiş,
- İçeriklere yorum yapabilme, yapılan yorumlara cevap verebilme,
- Sudoku, Bilen Kazanır, Kelime Savaşı, Okey gibi en eğlenceli oyunları ücretsiz oynayabilme,
- Widget özelliği ile haberlere hızlı erişim imkanı,
- Kadın, cilt bakımı, yemek tarifleri, tatlı tarifleri ve içerikleri,
- Politika, yaşam, dünya, gündem, teknoloji, seyahat ile ilgili en son haberler,
- Son dakika spor haberleri, transfer gelişmeleri, canlı maç sonuçları, canlı maç anlatımı, maç özetleri ve maç videoları,
- Fenerbahçe, Galatasaray, Beşiktaş, Trabzonspor ve tüm büyük takımlar hakkında spor gelişmeleri,
- Magazin dünyasındaki gelişmeler, ünlülerden merak edilen gelişmeler, fotoğraflar,
- Anlık borsa, hisse, finans bilgilerine erişim ve piyasalarla ilgili en güncel bilgiler,
- Altın, döviz bilgileri ve dünyada yaşanan ekonomik gelişmeler,
- Finansal Çevirici ile döviz, altın, kripto çevirilerinizi yapma, isterseniz tüm varlıklar için fiyat değerlerine anlık bakabilme,
- Anlık trafik durumunu öğrenebilme,
- Tüm şehirlerin anlık, günlük ve aylık hava durumu tahminleri,
- Astroloji, burç, doğum haritası ile ilgili içerikler,
- Sinemalar ile ilgili haberler, vizyona girecek en yeni filmler, son çıkan müzikler ve tüm sanatsal faaliyetler ile ilgili bilgiler,
- Namaz vakitlerini ve ezan saatlerini konuma göre takip edebilme,
- Mobil bildirimler ile dilediğiniz Namaz Vakti için telefonunuza bildirim kurma, namaz vakti yaklaşırken haberdar olabilme imkanı,
- Günün özeti, analizi, raporlar, galeriler ve videolara erişim,
- Tüm haberleri ve içerikleri anlık bildirimler (push) ile takip edebilme ve gündemden geri kalmama imkanı.
Mynet Haber uygulaması ile ilgili tüm eleştiri ve önerilerinizi uygulama içerisindeki “Görüş bildir” üzerinden ya da direkt olarak mobil@mynet.com adresine yazabilirsiniz.

bluejetty:00128389:ios.summary: My Spiritual Toolkit is the original AA app helping over 100,000 members of Alcoholics Anonymous get their daily reprieve from alcoholism and maintain their spiritual condition. Built by a fellow member of the fellowship in recovery since 1
bluejetty:00128389:ios.description:
My Spiritual Toolkit is the original AA app helping over 100,000 members of Alcoholics Anonymous get their daily reprieve from alcoholism and maintain their spiritual condition. Built by a fellow member of the fellowship in recovery since 1996.
We are not cured of alcoholism. What we really have is a daily reprieve contingent on the maintenance of our spiritual condition. This app helps us maintain that spiritual condition.
MY SPIRITUAL TOOLKIT CONTAINS NO ADS AND NEVER WILL.
100% hardship discounts available to anyone who can't afford premium. No questions asked. Email nathan@myspiritualtoolkit.com.
SPOT CHECK INVENTORY - YOUR ON-THE-GO MINI 4TH STEP
Resentment is the number one offender. The Spot Check Inventory lets you quickly work through resentments, fears, personal conduct, and harms done - right from your phone. Based on the personal inventory process in Step 10 (the tenth step) of the Twelve Steps and Twelve Traditions, this tool helps with daily ups and downs when people or events throw you off balance. A portable mini fourth step you can use anytime, anywhere.
NIGHTLY INVENTORY - STEP 11 MADE EASY
Do you do a nightly inventory before retiring each night as suggested in Step 11 (the eleventh step) of the Big Book? Now it's easy. Answer 10 simple questions straight from the Big Book and you're done. Track your answers over time to spot patterns in your recovery and spiritual growth.
RECOVERY JOURNAL
Write about your recovery journey, step work, sober living, or whatever is on your mind. Journaling is a powerful tool for self-reflection and working a strong program. Keep a record of your thoughts and spiritual progress in one private, secure place.
GRATITUDE LIST
Practicing gratitude is one of the most effective spiritual practices in recovery from alcoholism. Build your gratitude list to remind yourself of the good things in your life, even on the hard days. An attitude of gratitude keeps you grounded in sobriety.
SOBRIETY CALCULATOR & SOBRIETY DATE TRACKER
Set your sobriety date or clean date and the counter automatically calculates days sober, months sober, years sober, even hours. Share milestones with your sponsor or trusted friends in the fellowship.
SHARE WITH YOUR SPONSOR
We are only as sick as our secrets. Text or email your journals, inventories, and gratitude lists directly to your sponsor or trusted adviser.

Transform your iPhone and iPad into a sophisticated editing suite with Darkroom, the highly acclaimed photo and video editor designed to empower both amateur photographers and professional creators. With desktop-quality tools at your fingertips, Darkroom competes with industry giants such as Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop, delivering unparalleled editing experiences right on your mobile device.
Award-Winning App Recognitions:
Winner of the Apple Design Award in 2020
Apple’s Editor’s Choice since 2018
Best New App Winner in 2015
Why Choose Darkroom?
Advanced AI-Powered Editing: Leverage cutting-edge AI tools for precise, depth-based edits and intelligent object detection. Enhance specific elements like skies, skin tones, and landscapes with unmatched accuracy.
Versatile Editing Capabilities: From high-resolution video playback and professional 8K color grading to batch photo editing, Darkroom addresses all your creative needs with efficiency. Its comprehensive toolset includes support for RAW and ProRAW files, making it perfect for high-quality photo projects.
Professional Tools for Every Creator:
All-Inclusive Format Support: Whether managing RAW files or crafting the perfect JPEG, Darkroom provides powerful editing tools that ensure top-tier output for all photo formats.
Tailored for iPhone Photographers: With iPhone-specific enhancements, Darkroom stands out as the premier editing tool for mobile photographers, offering intuitive interfaces and seamless integration with iOS features.
Praise from Experts:
"I can't say enough good things about Darkroom. It's fast, beautiful, powerful, and easy to understand and explore. And the team behind it keep improving the app
on a regular basis." - John Gruber, Daringfireball

"Its iPhone-specific features make Darkroom the leading editing app for iPhone photographers." – The Sweet Setup
Seamless Organization and Sharing:
Organize your photos and videos with Darkroom's advanced management tools. Create stunning collages, manage hashtags effortlessly, and share your creations with ease. Streamline your workflow and keep your collections meticulously organized, whether for personal enjoyment or professional display.
Join Our Community and Enhance Your Creative Skills:
Become a Darkroom member to access exclusive features and regular updates that keep your tools cutting-edge. Our community is a hub for sharing tips, inspiration, and creative techniques.
Get Started with Darkroom Today:
Download Darkroom and elevate your photo and video editing to professional levels. With ongoing enhancements and a focus on user-friendly design, Darkroom is dedicated to enriching your creative journey.
Subscription and Membership Details:
Manage your Darkroom+ membership in the iTunes & App Store settings. Remember, subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

bluejetty:00165802:ios.description:
Welcome to "Math Club" — a unique blend of cross math and brain puzzles! Get ready for a challenging adventure where math puzzles and logic meet. If you enjoy solving crossmath and quick math challenges, this game is perfect for you!
Features:
- Crossmath puzzles: Solve brain puzzles that require logic and arithmetic. Every math puzzle is designed to challenge your mind.
- Quick math: Solve rapid-fire math puzzles and improve your arithmetic skills with fun math games.
- Math crossword: Combine maths and logic to complete math crosswords, perfect for those who love solving brain puzzles.
- Fun math games: Whether you’re a beginner or a math master, these math puzzle games will improve your skills while keeping you entertained.
Why Play "Math Club"?
1. Math puzzles for adults: Our math games for adults are designed to test your arithmetic and logic skills through cross math and quick math challenges.
2. Math riddles: Solve tricky math puzzles that will push your brain to its limits and keep you engaged.
3. Picture math: Enjoy a visually pleasing interface that makes math crosswords and brain puzzles more fun.
4. Math brain booster games: Improve your maths and arithmetic skills while having fun solving challenging math puzzles.
Who is "Math Club" For?
If you love solving math puzzles and enjoy testing your skills with math games for adults, "Math Club" is for you. It's designed for math enthusiasts of all levels, offering a range of math quiz challenges, from simple arithmetic to complex crossmath brain puzzles.
- Math games for adults: Perfect for anyone who loves maths and is looking for a brain puzzle challenge.
- Math riddles and fun math games: If you love solving tricky math puzzles, you’ll enjoy the variety of brain puzzles and crossmath challenges.
- Quick math and math quiz challenges: Test your math skills with time-limited math crossword and brain puzzle games.
- Math brain booster games: Designed to enhance your maths and logic skills through a series of fun math games.
Game Modes:
- Quick math mode: Solve arithmetic puzzles quickly to boost your speed and accuracy.
- Crossmath mode: Complete rows and columns in a math crossword using your math puzzle-solving skills.
- Math puzzles: Start with simple brain puzzles and progress to more complex math quizzes as you advance.
Sharpen Your Math Skills!
Whether you're a math master or just love fun math games, "Math Club" will help you improve your arithmetic and problem-solving abilities. With each math crossword, cross math puzzle, and quick math quiz, you’ll sharpen your maths skills while having fun.
Ready for the Challenge?
Download "Math Club" today and dive into the world of crossmath, math brain booster games, and fun math games. Solve challenging math riddles and become a true math master. Whether you’re looking for a casual math puzzle experience or a tough brain puzzle challenge, "Math Club" has something for everyone.
Join the club and start solving math puzzles now!

bluejetty:00157584:ios.description:
Stay No Contact when the urge to text your ex hits.
No Contact helps you track your streak, resist impulses, and move on after a breakup with an AI breakup coach, daily check-ins, private reminders, and Lock Screen widgets that keep your progress visible.
Whether you are getting over a breakup, moving on after a divorce, or trying to leave a toxic relationship, the No Contact Rule is easier to follow when you have structure, accountability, and support in the moments willpower is not enough.
STAY NO CONTACT
Track your No Contact streak in days, hours, minutes, and seconds.
- See your streak grow in real time
- Add No Contact widgets to your Lock Screen and Home Screen
- Celebrate milestones like 24 hours, 7 days, and 30 days
- Reset without shame and understand what triggered the slip
- Keep your progress visible when you need the reminder most
RESIST THE URGE TO TEXT YOUR EX
When you feel like reaching out, open the app first.
- Use quick calming tools before you send a message
- Read your reminders, red flags, and reasons to stay away
- Write the text in your private Unsent Letters vault
- Let your AI coach help you get through the moment
- Turn a weak moment into another day of progress
AI BREAKUP COACH
Get support when your friends are asleep or tired of hearing the story.
- Talk through cravings, second thoughts, anger, or confusion
- Choose gentle support or tough love
- Get advice based on your breakup and No Contact progress
- Ask what to do before you reply, check their profile, or reopen the conversation
- Build a plan for getting through today without breaking No Contact
DAILY CHECK-INS & PROGRESS LOG
Stay honest with yourself and see how far you have come.
- Log your day in a few seconds
- Track hard moments, wins, setbacks, and triggers
- Notice patterns that make you want to reach out
- Look back at your progress when you feel like starting over
- Build consistency one check-in at a time
BREAKUP RECOVERY TOOLS
Turn the No Contact Rule into a daily recovery system.
- Guided exercises for breakups, attachment, grief, anger, and letting go
- Daily reminders to help you stay away and move forward
- Red Flags list to remember why it ended
- Unsent Letters vault for the messages you should not send
- Milestones and streak history to keep you accountable
THIS APP IS FOR YOU IF:
- You feel tempted to text your ex
- You keep checking their social media
- You are stuck in an on-and-off cycle
- You need help staying No Contact
- You want a private place to vent before you do something you regret
- You want structure, reminders, and accountability after a breakup
- You are ready to stop reopening the conversation and start moving on
WHY IT WORKS
- It catches you in the moment before temptation becomes a mistake
- It keeps your No Contact streak visible every day
- It gives you something to do instead of texting your ex
- It helps you remember why you started
- It turns breakup recovery into small daily actions
- It gives you support when willpower is not enough
No Contact is not just about silence.
It is about choosing yourself every time the urge comes back.
Start your No Contact streak today and take back control one day at a time.
Free to try No Contact now.
Complete the onboarding to access basic features. Full access requires a subscription (weekly, monthly, or yearly - auto-renewing).
Disclaimer
No Contact is a self-help journaling and habit tracking app. It does not provide medical, therapeutic, or emergency support. If you need professional help or urgent support, please contact a qualified professional or local emergency services.
Terms of Use: https://nocontactai.app/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://nocontactai.app/en/privacy

bluejetty:00062056:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00062056:ios.description:
Improve mental organization skills. Practice categories in a versatile speech therapy app.
When you struggle with categories due to stroke, brain injury, or autism, simple tasks can be impossible. But there’s a way to heal the broken networks of meaning.
TRY CATEGORY THERAPY, an app designed for both speech therapists and home users to help restructure the brain and let the ideas flow. This free Lite version gives you a sample of what you’ll get in the full version.
- Take control with evidence-based exercises designed by experts
- Improve word-finding and sorting skills with 4 engaging activities and unlimited practice
- Get an app that works in both home and clinical settings
- Interact with clear photos and a simple interface that's easy for everyone to use
- Adjust settings to target your goals and suit your needs
- Use reports and customization to seamlessly fit the app into your therapy program
When you lose the ability to group items and identify what they have in common, it gets in the way of your ability to understand, learn, and communicate. But with the right kind of practice, it’s possible to strengthen the connections between words and concepts and navigate your world more easily.
“It will be a LONG time before you run out of content to use with one patient, and the app’s fantastic settings options will allow you to use it with a variety of individuals, regardless of cognitive abilities.”
- Aubrey Klingensmith, MS, CCC-SLP, Speechie Apps
GET THE RIGHT ACTIVITY - FOR EVERY BRAIN.
No two people are the same. With 4 activities ranging from simple to complex, there's something in Category Therapy to match your needs. Work through them gradually or focus on the activity that best suits your needs.
1) FIND: Start with the basics. You'll hear and see a photo of a category (let's say "Fruit"). Tap the item that matches (for example, a banana).
2) CLASSIFY: Switch it up. Now you start with an item and choose the category that matches. This tests your ability to apply categories to what you see.
3) ADD ONE: Train yourself to recognize common features of items – to categorize them – and then choose one item that fits the category you’ve identified.
4) EXCLUDE: Challenge yourself. By choosing an item that doesn't belong, you learn how to independently identify categories. As things get harder, you can always tap Hint for some help.
ALL DONE? Share your progress. The app makes it easy to quickly view, share, or e-mail detailed reports to a therapist or loved one.
GET EVERY FEATURE YOU NEED IN ONE EASY APP.
• 70 categories and nearly 700 words in the full version
• 3 difficulty levels ranging from simple objects to more abstract concepts
• Great for aphasia, brain injury, autism, and other cognitive & language impairments
• Switch to Pictures Only to practice naming or Words Only to practice reading
• Customize the number of trials, choices, and more – the full version gives you total control
• Designed with adults in mind but easy enough for children to use 
• No subscriptions, no monthly bills, no Wi-Fi needed
THERE’S HOPE. With Category Therapy in your corner, you can build stronger connections between words – and learn to speak and think more easily.
What’s the difference between the Lite and full versions? 
- Full has nearly 700 words in 70 categories; Lite has 21 target words and 15 categories.
- Full lets you control all the settings; Lite limits the number of choices and number of trials
- Full has enough variety to practice and improve; Lite gives you a taste to know if this app is right for you – it’s not meant to be used for long as the sample exercises are easily mastered.
Looking for something different in a speech therapy app? We offer a wide range to choose from. Find the right one for you at https://tactustherapy.com/find

bluejetty:00060813:ios.name: rmAppSuite Pro
bluejetty:00060813:ios.summary: Rent Manager’s rmAppSuite Pro provides the speed, efficiency, and maximum productivity you need to keep your property management operation on the go. Sleek, intuitive navigation guides you through the app quickly and easily from one task to
bluejetty:00060813:ios.description:
Rent Manager’s rmAppSuite Pro provides the speed, efficiency, and maximum productivity you need to keep your property management operation on the go. Sleek, intuitive navigation guides you through the app quickly and easily from one task to the next. rmAppSuite Pro is completely integrated with your Rent Manager database so you never miss a beat, wherever and whenever you’re logging in.
Features:
• Connect to your Rent Manager database while in the field
• Review and update prospect, tenant, owner, and vendor information
• Track and process tenant payments
• Add new violations and escalate existing violations
• Complete maintenance inspections, services issues, and metered utility readings, including photos and notes
• Communicate with contacts via rmVoIP or text messaging within the app
Easily find the contact you’re looking for with access to tenants, prospects, owners, or vendors—all searchable via a wide variety of search items, including address, email, license plate number, etc. Once selected, you can view complete profile information including: User Defined Fields, ownerships, transaction history, and contact information. Add History/Note items directly from the field; submit maintenance tickets; accept and apply payments via credit card, ACH, cash, or ePay; and so much more. You can also utilize the voice-to-text capabilities of your smart phone to take notes.
Your favorite Rent Manager apps received a complete overhaul to best fit your needs. Conduct inspections on-the-spot, from beginning to end; take pictures and set statuses from the field; create new service issues and send reports to owners and tenants right from your device. Never miss a beat and add violations the moment you come across them at your properties—your actions are reflected instantly in RM12 with the push of a button, making sure that every detail is logged along the way. You can also attach photos to History/Notes, contact images, bills, and more, with one simple step.
Entering utility meter readings has never been easier. Simplify billing tenants for their utility usage by using rmAppSuite Pro to record meter readings for utility consumption while in the field. If your meters have a barcode, you can use your device’s camera to scan and identify the meter. When you enter usage data for each meter, the app displays previous readings, allowing you to easily spot irregularities. 
New! Take advantage of Rent Manager’s extensive Violations feature while working at your properties. Easily add new violations to a tenant’s account, along with supporting photos and notes directly from the app. You can also access existing violations, escalate them as needed, and calculate the associated charges. 
Technicians can quickly document all maintenance work completed on-site via their device and automatically make the appropriate updates to your RM12 database. Create parts/labor records for items that need to be charged back to the tenant or take pictures to document work completed.
Creating and receiving text messages to and from your clients using the app is intuitive. Service technicians can contact tenants to let them know they are on their way, or quickly text an owner the result of an inspection. All text messages are saved directly to the Text Messaging Center for maximum security.
rmAppSuite Pro is integrated with rmVoIP!* Make and receive phone calls as if you're in the office. Service technicians and inspectors can call tenants without sharing personal phone numbers and all phone calls are logged and tracked within RM12. *rmVoIP contract is required.
NOTE: To use any of the rmAppSuite Pro apps, you must be a current Rent Manager Online customer.

Transform the way you capture, organize, and present your clinical results. PhotoDoc is the ultimate clinical photography and visual management solution
bluejetty:00131739:ios.description:
Are your patient photos still mixed up with your personal photos in your camera roll?
Transform the way you capture, organize, and present your clinical results. PhotoDoc is the ultimate clinical photography and visual management solution for healthcare professionals seeking standardization, security, and efficiency in their daily practice.
Save hours of work, free up space on your phone, and elevate your consultations with high-standard presentations.
WHY CHOOSE PHOTODOC?
ALWAYS STANDARDIZED CLINICAL PHOTOS
No more inconsistent angles that compromise patient follow-up comparisons:
• Ghost Photo (Overlay): Use a transparent overlay of the previous photo on your screen as a guide to capture the new shot in the exact same position.
• Smart Guides: Exclusive facial and body framing templates with smart assistance that prevent camera distortion.
• Leveling Sensor: Control the exact angle and tilt of your device in real time for 100% accurate photos and short videos.
BEFORE & AFTER IN SECONDS (WITH SMART ZOOM)
Present clinical progress clearly, professionally, and ethically:
• Create comparative collages directly in the app, choosing from different layouts, border sizes, and colors.
• Exclusive Smart Zoom: Automatically zoom in on key facial areas while maintaining alignment, making detailed comparisons effortless.
• Highlight Your Brand: Automatically apply your clinic or practice logo to shared photos.
AI FACIAL PROPORTIONS & VISUAL ANALYSIS
Elevate your clinical planning and help patients visualize their treatment:
• Automatic calculation of Golden Ratio, Facial Thirds, and Fifths powered by Artificial Intelligence (Pro Plan Exclusive).
• Advanced markup tools: highlight areas of interest with drawings and measurements directly on the photo.
COMPLETE CLINICAL HISTORY & RECORDS IN ONE PLACE
Much more than clinical photography. Log consultations, procedures, and diagnoses, import PDF documents, and track each patient's complete evolution seamlessly.
PRIVACY, SECURE CLOUD & FULL SYNCHRONIZATION
Keep your personal life separate from your daily practice with total data security:
• Zero Photos in Your Personal Gallery: Records are stored securely in the PhotoDoc cloud and take up no space on your device.
• Multi-Device Sync: Take photos on your phone and access them instantly across your other devices, such as tablets and computers, using the same account.
• Smart Organization: Find any patient in seconds by searching their name. Add notes, categories, and apply filters to locate specific photos quickly.
TRY IT FOR FREE
Start with the free Trial version to experience PhotoDoc in your practice. Whenever you need more storage space and access to all advanced features, simply choose one of our monthly subscription plans directly in the app.
Terms and Conditions:
https://photodoc.app/en/terms_and_conditions.html
Privacy Policy:
https://photodoc.app/en/privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00074166:ios.name: NV Charts GPS Navigation AIS
bluejetty:00074166:ios.summary:
Enhance your navigation experience with a seamless navigation solution that provides up-to-date digital nautical charts, comprehensive harbour information, and a full suite of navigation features. 
The charts can be downloaded for offline
bluejetty:00074166:ios.description:
Enhance your navigation experience with a seamless navigation solution that provides up-to-date digital nautical charts, comprehensive harbour information, and a full suite of navigation features. 
The charts can be downloaded for offline use and offer exceptional compatibility with the NV Charts paper charts with a similar chart design. 
All currently valid editions of the NV Verlag / NV Charts nautical charts or inland charts | North Sea | Baltic Sea | Netherlands | Wadden Sea | Ijsselmeer | Sweden | Denmark | Germany | Norway | France | USA | Caribbean | Bahamas areas are compatible with the NV Charts App.
Enjoy the best of both worlds - paper and digital: A perfect match is our popular combination package of high-quality digital charts and cleverly designed paper charts. Alternatively, you can also purchase digital nautical charts directly via the app with a convenient annual subscription that renews automatically. The integrated update service keeps the charts up to date. 
If it is not yet clear where the journey should go or no offline charts are activated, free online charts can be displayed for all NV Charts chart areas, even without a currently valid chart licence. 
Detailed and relevant information is essential for navigating safely on the water. With the NV Charts App, you are part of the BoatView community yourself. You can mark harbours, anchorages and navigation warnings on the digital nautical chart and also add pictures of interesting places that go beyond navigation, such as restaurants or popular attractions, and share them with the community. Others can respond directly with comments. The continuously edited content can be downloaded directly to be available offline. To make all the information easily accessible, the app offers a search function. You can explore the surroundings and search directly for place names as well as anchorages, harbours, ramps, waypoints, cranes, fuel stations or tide stations. The app also offers fast and flexible auto-routing, allowing you to navigate directly to your destination and edit a route manually.
Navigation on board is even more fun together! You can share your tracks with friends or use the data outside the app and export it as a GPX file. You can easily share your favourite harbours and anchorages from the app via a link and coordinate your trip planning even better with everyone.
The AIS function in the NV Charts App allows you to keep an eye on AIS signals in real time. A WiFi AIS receiver can be connected to the NV Charts App for this purpose. The AIS Class A and B targets and aids to navigation (ATON), as well as MOB AIS SART transponder emergency transmitters, are displayed, and the traffic situation can be better assessed. 
The NV Charts App can be installed and synchronized on multiple devices.
NV Charts App - Features: 
+ Search function
+ Autorouting for all distances and regions
+ Velocity Made Good (VMG)
+ Community Layer / Points of Interest(POI)
+ Free online boating charts preview for planning
+ In App Purchases of digital offline charts
+ Community Layer / Points of Interest(POI)
+ Reads all NV Chart chart areas 
+ Easy download of the maps
+ Always the latest data 
+ Seamless zoom and panning functions
+ Tide Forecast
+ Online weather
+ AIS Wifi Support
+ AIS Sart Beacon 
+ AIS CPA function 
+ Night mode
+ Anchor alarm
+ Position with GPS 
+ Intuitive route planning
+ Course markings, markings, bearing ruler 
+ Port information 
+ Display of instruments
+ Synchronizing devices
+ Live Position Sharing
+ Social sharing of routes, tracks, positions
Note:
Continued use of GPS in the background can significantly reduce battery life.
