bluejetty:00175019:ios.description:
Stakeout notifies you when reservations at your favorite Disney park restaurants and experiences become available.
Popular restaurants at Disney parks are booked fast. But when plans change, reservations open up. With Stakeout, set alerts for specific restaurants, dates, and times and we will notify you when we find availability. Whether you're planning months ahead or looking for a same-day reservation, Stakeout has your back.
Features:
• Instant Start: Download and start your Stakeout right away! A simple login is recommended, but not required.
• Immediate Alerts: Get push notifications as soon as availability is found.
• Quick Booking: Tap the notification or link in the message to reserve through the Disney parks app or website.
• Basic & Premium: Use the free version for one Stakeout at a time. Upgrade for multiple active Stakeouts and more.
Stakeout supports all reservable dining and bookable experiences at Disney World and Disneyland parks and resorts.
Facing any issues? Reach out at stakeout@wildcardsoftware.net.
By downloading and installing, you agree to the End User License Agreement (https://www.wildcardsoftware.net/eula) and Privacy Policy (https://www.wildcardsoftware.net/privacy)

bluejetty:00070421:ios.description:
Unlock thousands of nursing school exam practice questions and mock exams for the HESI A2, ATI TEAS, NCSBN NCLEX-RN, NCSBN NCLEX-PN, NLN PAX, and more with Pocket Prep, the largest provider of mobile test prep for professional certifications.
Whether at home or on the go, reinforce key concepts and improve retention to pass your exam confidently on the first try.
Since 2011, thousands of nursing students have trusted Pocket Prep to help them succeed on their certification exams. Our questions are crafted by experts and aligned with official exam blueprints, ensuring you're always studying the most relevant, up-to-date content.
Prep for 7 Nursing School entrance and exit exams, including:
- 2,300 ATI® TEAS practice questions
- 500 College Biology practice questions
- 500 College Chemistry practice questions
- 1,475 HESI A2 practice questions
- 1,250 NCSBN NCLEX-PN® practice questions
- 1,550 NCSBN NCLEX-RN® practice questions
- 1,495 NLN® PAX practice questions
Pocket Prep will help you feel confident and prepared for exam day.
- 10,000+ Practice Questions: Expert-authored, exam-like questions with detailed explanations, including textbook references used by nursing educators.
- Mock Exams: Simulate the test day experience with full-length mock exams to help build your confidence and readiness.
- A Variety of Study Modes: Tailor your study sessions with quiz modes like Quick 10, Level Up, and Weakest Subject.
- Performance Analytics: Track your progress, identify weak areas, and compare your scores with other nursing school students.
Earn a high score on your nursing school exam!
Get started with free access to 30–80* free practice questions across 3 study modes – Question of the Day, Quick 10, and Timed Quiz.
Upgrade to Premium for:
- Full access to all 7 Nursing School exams, featuring thousands of practice questions
- All advanced study modes, including Build Your Own Quiz, Missed Question Quiz, and Level Up
- Full-length mock exams to ensure exam-day success
- Our Pass Guarantee 
Choose the plan that fits your goals:
- 1 Month: $15.99 billed monthly
- 3 Months: $39.99 billed every 3 months
- 12 Months: $95.99 billed annually
Trusted by thousands of nursing students. Here's what our members say:
"This app allowed me to identify where I needed to focus while also refreshing what I learned before. The explanations are thorough and concise, worth the money."
"I passed! I used this app as my only study tool for Reading, Biology, Vocabulary, and A&P and passed on my first try. I love this app!"
"I almost exclusively used Pocket Prep to study and passed my HESI with a cumulative of 87%. This app made studying on the go convenient, and I'd say the premium plan was well worth it."

So, you’re with your buddies, maybe before the party, maybe after. Maybe right in the middle of your night out…

bluejetty:00067938:ios.name: Lily City: Building metropolis
bluejetty:00067938:ios.summary: Welcome to Lily City! Here, you will become a mayor and you can build your own city in full accordance with your heart. Of course, it is not easy to be a qualified mayor. You must build the facilities they need for the citizens and help sol
bluejetty:00067938:ios.description:
Welcome to Lily City! Here, you will become a mayor and you can build your own city in full accordance with your heart. Of course, it is not easy to be a qualified mayor. You must build the facilities they need for the citizens and help solve a variety of problems.
As the building grows, more features will be unlocked.
There are hundreds of buildings in Lily City waiting for you to unlock, police stations, museums, fire stations, water parks... The novel design of each building will make you feel special. By rationally arranging these buildings, building and upgrading them, your city will continue to evolve and eventually become a stunning metropolis. Every building has its own role, they are not unique, but they are indispensable in the city.
The variety of production lines makes your city more attractive.
You can grow fruits and vegetables in person and pick them, manufacture of materials such as clothing parts,which will have a strong sense of satisfaction. Store them well, and one day they may be able to make a big contribution to your city construction!
There are not only agricultural industrial development but also foreign trade ports in the city. If you manage well, you will certainly gain more wealth!
The city contains a rich storyline.
What kind of mission will mystery friends living in a hot air balloon release?
The number of residents is constantly growing, and what romantic stories will happen to them?
Maybe you will also find a magical treasure hidden in the color park!
Expand your sim city here and enjoy the Sims of you. Visit your neighbors and share your unique city views!
Game features:
· Lily City is a city building game. Have a rich and interesting story to make the game no longer monotonous;
· Unlock various buildings and urban decorations, attracting a large number of citizens to settle down;
· Planting crops yourself and experience the feeling of a blue sky, white clouds and farms;
· High-degree-of-freedom city maps to build your favorite city;
· Achieve city achievements and receive rewards;
· Perfect friend system, visit friends' cities and help each other.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/LilyCityHD/

bluejetty:00165836:ios.name: Spot the Dog: Hidden Objects!
bluejetty:00165836:ios.summary:
Find It Out - Catch em All!
Embark on an amazing adventure of casual games in the wonderful hidden object puzzle game Spot the Dog: Hidden Objects, in which you will have to test your skills in finding lost puppies. Look behind every crack
bluejetty:00165836:ios.description:
Find It Out - Catch em All!
Embark on an amazing adventure of casual games in the wonderful hidden object puzzle game Spot the Dog: Hidden Objects, in which you will have to test your skills in finding lost puppies. Look behind every crack, these agile dogs love to hide, your task to pass the level is catch em all. Complete puzzles and Brainteasers in various themed locations and collect a fascinating collection of dogs, endless content and many hidden objects await you.
Fun Features
Find it Out: feel like a real animal detective in Spot the Dog: Puzzle Game, we have added a very large number of hidden objects - dogs, puppies and other animals, spot it all to continue the journey. In your difficult journey through the levels, you will have to find cute puppies of various breeds - let your eyes be sharp. 
Lovely Levels: In our game, we tried to create a huge number of different levels with themes that everyone will like: dark forests, beautiful gardens, monumental mountains, big cities. In Spot the Dog: Find it Out you will immerse yourself in cultures from all corners of the world and all this in combination with a puzzle game about finding hidden objects.
Find a Cute Collection: for completing the puzzle you get a reward - a small professional puppy that is stored in your collection, collecting them all is not an easy task as the challenges become more difficult with each level, but to see the full collection of little helpers it is worth it!
Getting Stuck is not a Problem: in our casual puzzle game there are always hints that will be useful to you in solving any of the Brainteasers. Zooming and dragging will also be useful on your way, these hidden objects are, well, very hidden. 
An Offline Casual Game for All Age Groups: Dog Puzzle: Catch em All can be played anywhere and by anyone, it is perfect for long trips or for developing various useful skills in children.
Fun for All Adventure Seekers!
Prove that you have developed observation skills and enjoy an unforgettable journey into the world of puzzles and puppies! Spot the Object: Scavenger Hunt is the perfect "find it out" game to improve your hunting and detective skills! Take a good look at the location, detect all the dogs and catch em all!

bluejetty:00131611:ios.summary:
Welcome to Dragon & Elfs — a relaxing merge game filled with adorable Elves, magical treasures, and endless discoveries.
Start with a small piece of land and a few simple items. Merge, collect, explore, and gradually turn it into a vast ma
bluejetty:00131611:ios.description:
Welcome to Dragon & Elfs — a relaxing merge game filled with adorable Elves, magical treasures, and endless discoveries.
Start with a small piece of land and a few simple items. Merge, collect, explore, and gradually turn it into a vast magical home of your own.
◆ MERGE, DISCOVER & KEEP GROWING
Merge 5 identical items to create 2 upgraded items and discover what comes next.
Plants grow into rarer forms. Eggs hatch into Elves. Simple objects evolve through long merge chains into valuable treasures and spectacular Wonders.
With thousands of items to discover and 96 Wonders to create, there is always another merge chain to complete and another surprise waiting at the end.
◆ LIGHT UP 4,000+ ILLUSTRATIONS
Every discovery becomes part of your Elfsdex.
Discover new items, Elves, Wonders, and treasures to light up more than 4,000 beautiful illustrations in your collection.
Watch empty spaces gradually fill, find what you are still missing, and see just how much of Elfland you have discovered.
Can you light them all up?
◆ COLLECT & EVOLVE 140+ ELVES
Find Elf Eggs, hatch new companions, and merge them into stronger and more beautiful forms.
Discover and collect more than 140 unique Elves.
Raise your Elves, increase your Elf Power, and fill your Home with companions you've watched grow.
◆ BUILD A HUGE WORLD OF YOUR OWN
Heal Dark Land and gradually unlock a massive Home map with plenty of room to collect, build, decorate, organize, and grow.
Explore more than 1,600 stages, complete quests, join special events, discover new treasures, and bring your rewards back Home.
There is always something new to work toward — but you can enjoy everything at your own pace.
◆ POWERFUL TOOLS FOR A HUGE MERGE WORLD
The bigger your collection becomes, the harder it can be to keep everything organized.
That is why Dragon & Elfs gives you dedicated tools to keep even the largest collections organized.
Black Hole — Quickly gather matching items.
Wormhole — Organize an entire merge chain and make large collections easier to manage.
Spend less time searching through a crowded map and more time enjoying what makes the game satisfying: merging, organizing, collecting, and watching your world grow.
Whether you love completing merge chains, filling your Elfsdex, collecting every Elf, creating Wonders, organizing your Home, or simply relaxing as your world slowly grows, you will always find something new waiting in Elfland.
Start small. Keep merging. Light up your collection and build a magical world of your own.

bluejetty:00024215:ios.description:
The Best Metal Detector is an application intended for entertainment purposes only.
It detects the presence of metal nearby by measuring the magnetic field value. This useful instrument uses the magnetic sensor built-in your mobile device and shows magnetic field level in μT (microtesla). The Best Metal Detector allows to identify metal object in close area, because all metals generate magnetic field which strength can be measured with this tool.
Usage is quite simple: launch this application on your mobile device and move it around. You will see that the magnetic field level shown on screen is constantly fluctuating. Colorful lines represent the three dimensions and the numbers on top shows the value of magnetic field level (EMF). The chart will increase and the device will vibrate and makes sounds announcing that metal is close. In settings you can change the sensitivity of vibration and sound effects.
Privacy Policy: https://netigen.eu/privacy/
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00073948:ios.description:

 for them on TV during our local news.

bluejetty:00061124:ios.description:
Send fax from iPhone or iPad with Fax Zap scanner app. The fax app scan documents and send your faxes from iPhone or iPad on the go. With Fax Zap & Scanner on your Phone, you can scan and produce PDF documents on the go and send fax to over 80+ international countries from your iPhone & iPad. You can also choose from 20+ international fax numbers to receive fax as well. 
No need to walk to a fax office and pay a huge price just to fax a few sheets of document. No need to buy a fax machine and get a landline to fax. Fax Phone app is your go to app for scanning and faxing documents whenever you need and where ever you need at a low costs. Finally, you can free yourself from your fax and scanner machine.
Features
=========
+ Send and receive faxes from iPhone and iPad
+ Scan documents and convert to PDF file
+ Includes QR Code Reader to scan QR Code and store it in history
+ Scan and transform to a flat sheet of document
+ OCR support to convert your scan documents to text with multiple language support
+ Choose from 20+ international countries fax number to receive fax
+ Get status update on your faxing
+ Store and share your scan PDF and fax documents.
+ Change your receiving fax number as often as you like.
+ Customize your own fax number.
+ Burner Phone numbers for faxing
Fax Zap app offers a subscription plan for your premium numbers.
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription.
- Your account will be charged for a renewed subscription within 24 hours prior to the end of current subscription.
- Your account will auto renew once a month or yearly depending on the package you choose and provide you access to premium phone numbers and recording services.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- You can manage your subscription and switch off the auto-renewal by accessing your account settings after purchase. 
- You cannot cancel the current subscription during the active subscription period.
- Unused portion of free trial will be forfeited when user cancels subscription.
The following subscription plans are available:
- Fax Yearly Plan that includes 3 Days Trial - US$99.99
- Fax Monthly Plan that includes 3 Days Trial - US$14.99
- Fax Monthly Plan - US$9.99/month
- Fax Phone numbers for receiving fax from $6.99/month - $14.99/month depending on country
Privacy Policy: http://www.appverse.com/Privacy
Terms of Use: http://www.appsverse.com/Terms

bluejetty:00175289:ios.summary:
A UNIQUE WEATHER FORECAST VISUALISATION
While most weather forecasting apps rely solely on free global models, Windy has gone a step further by investing heavily in the most accurate weather models available, always at the highest possible
bluejetty:00175289:ios.description:
A UNIQUE WEATHER FORECAST VISUALISATION
While most weather forecasting apps rely solely on free global models, Windy has gone a step further by investing heavily in the most accurate weather models available, always at the highest possible resolution, to deliver you the most accurate forecasts in the world.
LIVE WEATHER APP - WEATHER RADAR & SATELLITE
(Now with Precipitation Type & Lightning tracker)
Radar is a highly valued tool for weather forecasting. To provide you with the most accurate radar imagery, we constantly expand our resources so that rain, snow, and storms don't catch you by surprise.
Trusted radar sources include NOAA, Met Office, Météo France, DWD, JMA, IMD, BoM & more.
The global satellite composite is created from NOAA, EUMETSAT & Himawari data.
MORE THAN 50 WEATHER MAPS
- Rain radar, Satellite and a unique combined layer of Radar & Satellite images (blue, infrared, visible)
- Hurricane tracker, Weather warnings & Extreme forecast
- Wind forecast: Wind speed, Wind gusts & Accumulation, models comparison, data from live Weather stations
- Temperature: Humidity, Pressure, Dew point, live data from Weather stations
- Rain: Thunder & storms, Rain accumulation, Thunderstorms, Precipitation type, CAPE-index
- Aviation: Clouds, Cloud tops, Cloud base, Visibility (LIFR, IFR, MVFR, VFR), Fog, Icing, Clear air turbulence, Thermals, Freezing altitude
- Marine Forecast: Waves, Swell, Wave power, Tide forecast, Currents, Sea temperature
- Solar activity: Solar power, UV index, Wet-bulb temperature
- Snow: Snow depth, New snow, Snow density
- Air Quality: Air Quality Index (AQI) with Pollen (CAMS), NO2, PM 2.5, Aerosol, SO2, Ozone layer, Surface ozone, CO concentration, Dust mass
- Soil moisture, Moisture anomaly, Drought intensity, Fire Danger, Fuel moisture
MORE THAN 15 WEATHER MODELS
Global weather models:
- meteoblue - AI forecast
- ECMWF
- GFS by NOAA
- ICON by DWD
Local weather models:
- HRRR by NOAA
- NAM by NOAA
- HRDPS by MSC
- ICON-EU by DWD
- ICON-D2 by DWD
- UKV by Met Office
- AROME-HD by Météo France
- ALADIN by CHMI
- NEMS by meteoblue
- MSM by JMA
- ACCESS-C by BoM
LIVE RAIN, STORM ALERTS & CUSTOM WEATHER ALERTS
Want to know before the storm hits near you while you hike, bike or spend time outdoors? You can now access live weather alerts or set up your custom weather alert for wind, sunshine, or new snow.
HURRICANE TRACKER FOR STORM TRACKING
With Windy's hurricane tracker, you can track the past and projected path of a hurricane or a storm. Windy doesn't rely on just one hurricane model, but will give you all the forecasts available for a storm or hurricane.
WINDY MADE FOR PILOTS
- 16 altitude levels from the surface to 13.5km/FL450
- 50k+ Airports searchable by ICAO and IATA, including runway info, decoded & raw METAR, TAF & NOTAMs
- Detailed Airgram and Meteogram: temperature and dew point, wind speed and wind gusts, pressure, precipitation, altitude cloud cover, freezing altitude
- Thermals forecast
- Route planner
WINDY MADE FOR OUTDOOR SPORTS, SURF & BOATING
- 67K+ global webcams
- Summer & winter outdoor topographic maps by Mapy.com
- 4.5K+ Surfing spots
- 12.1K+ Paragliding spots
- 4.3K+ Kiting spots
- Boating tide forecast
- Sun & Moon tracker
- Plugins with buoy data
WINDY AS A WEATHER WIDGET ON YOUR DEVICE
Get the weather now on your iPhone, MacOS, iPad, CarPlay & Apple Watch, from forecast, Radar, METAR, Weather stations & Wind, ready for your travels and outdoor sports.
WINDY PREMIUM — FORECAST LIKE A PRO
- 1-hour & 15-day outlook with 4–6× daily updates
- Radar/Satellite 24h loops & 1-year archives
- More maps (Tide Forecast)
- Model comparison to find the best model
Terms of Use: https://account.windy.com/agreements/windy-terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://account.windy.com/agreements/windy-privacy-policy
GET IN TOUCH
Join us on social media or at community.windy.com to discuss weather-related topics, report bugs, or suggest a new feature. Contact us directly at info@windy.com.

Reviews
bluejetty:00023597:ios.description:
With over 7 million downloads, Simple Transfer is the easiest way of transferring your photos and large videos to computer using WiFi or USB. It can also convert HEIC photos to JPG, HEVC videos to MOV/MP4 and Live Photos to videos.
Reviews:
●●●●● "Have never looked back since finding this app! Couldn't live without it now."
●●●●● "Works beautifully: I wish this was easier to find. It’s amazing how much time you can waste trying to transfer things from iPhone/iPad to PC, and all along this app was here, making it so easy."
Main Features:
◉ View all your photo albums and videos on your computer and download them by a single click via WiFi or USB cable.
◉ Save photos and videos from your computer to your iPhone/iPad
◉ Export photos as JPG (Windows compatible) or HEIC 
◉ Convert videos as MOV or MP4 (Windows compatible H.264 format)
◉ Export Live Photos to video or photo+video
◉ Photo Cleaner: clear space on your device by deleting large or duplicate photos and videos (premium feature).
◉ Photo Organizer: easily select and filter photos to delete, favorite or unfavorite them
◉ Free up space by automatically deleting transferred photos/videos (optional)
◉ Support for the new Apple's ProRaw and other RAW formats
◉ Safest way to transfer your photos and videos in your local WiFi network. They never go on the Internet or stored on any external server.
◉ Transfer photos and videos between iOS devices (iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch), select an album and tap on "Select All" to transfer all your photos/videos*
◉ Photos are transferred with full resolution including metadata and videos transferred with the highest quality available
◉ Works on Windows, Mac and Linux and it's fast!
Simple Transfer does not use or transfer your files to any external server. It provides a completely private website to be accessed by only computers that are directly connected to your local WiFi network. Your photos and videos cannot be accessed from the Internet.

Please contact our support directly at support@rambax.com or send an email from inside the app regarding any questions, suggestions or concerns.

Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.

Life is crushing! Youth is crushing! Life Crush Story!
* What was your dream? *
Let me introduce you to 'Life Crush Story: Lost Dreams'.
It tells the story of young people who live a 'life without hopes and dreams'.
'Why' did your dreams disappear? What happened to them?
* Life Crush Story is a life simulation game based on a match 3 puzzle.
You can grow and dream through simple puzzles and mini games in Life Crush Story.
You will work hard to make your dreams come true.
* From baby to student to job seeker,
the various life situations that we face in the passing of time
make the game more interesting.
* Numerous jobs with self portraits of sad young people are waiting for you.
Of course, getting a good job is just as hard as it is in reality.
* Destiny cards represent various aspects of joy and sorrow,
and make the game more exciting and unpredictable.
* You live only once! Your youth has passed already, but you can live as many times as you want in Life Crush Story!
Maybe you will have a realization of life after many repetitions?
-----------------------------------------------

bluejetty:00100343:ios.description:
Reverse Image Search App : AI Visual Search & Finder
Reverse Image Search lets you search using a photo instead of words. Upload any picture or paste one from your gallery, and run a quick reverse image search to find matching images, visually similar results, and detailed context about the photo in seconds. It’s the simplest way to do image search when you only have a picture.
You can also learn what’s inside the image. The app detects objects like products, animals, plants, places, faces, and logos, so your image search gives meaning, not just matches. If the photo contains text, you can translate text from photos with built-in OCR and instantly copy or understand what it says.
Key Features
 -Reverse image search from Camera, Gallery, Files, or Clipboard
 -AI Visual Finder to recognize objects, products, plants, animals, places, and more
 -Translate text from photos with built-in OCR for quick, accurate extraction
 -High-resolution finder to locate clearer or original versions
 -Search history to revisit past reverse image search results anytime
 -Save & download results to your device with one tap
 -Fast, lightweight experience designed for quick searches
 -Privacy controls — clear your image search history whenever you want
Use cases
 -Verify social media photos, memes, and news screenshots with reverse image search
 -Check dating profile pictures to avoid catfishing using image search
-Find the name of a plant, pet, or landmark by running reverse image search
 -Shop smarter: do an image search on a product photo to compare prices
 -Locate wallpapers or high-res versions with reverse image search
 -Discover similar styles, outfits, or home décor through image search
 -Track down reused or stolen content with reverse image search
Payment & Subscription Terms:
Choose between the following subscription options for unlimited access to all features:
• Weekly Subscription
• Yearly Subscription
Auto-Renewal: Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Manage Subscriptions: You can manage your subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
Payment: Payment is charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
Renewal Charges: Your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period, based on the selected plan.
Privacy Policy: https://heyos.co/privacy
Terms of Use: https://heyos.co/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00169194:ios.description:
Have you ever wished for a tool that would help you distinguish between edible and poisonous mushrooms? With Mushroom ID - mushroom identifier by picture, your dreams have come true! Say hello to your new best friend and mushroom guide into the exciting world of foraging.
What can you do with Mushroom ID at your side?
Identify mushrooms and learn all about them
Puzzled by a strange-looking mushroom? Unsure if you should pick it? Let our mushroom identifier by picture solve that mystery for you! Just snap a picture of the mushroom in question and let our smart AI algorithms do their magic. Benefit from instant mushroom identification with Mushroom ID!
Know exactly what you’re picking
Stay safe and check if the mushroom you want to take home is edible. Apart from mushroom identification, our fungi field guide offers an extensive profile on each mushroom in the database, including its appearance, edibility, season of fruiting, occurrence, and even interesting facts.
Keep track of your finds in the Mushroom ID app
Unsure if you’ve already seen that mushroom? Don’t worry; our mushroom identification app has you covered! Access all your recent finds and mushroom pictures through Snap History at any time.
Build and manage your personal collections in our mushroom identification app
Arrange your custom collections of mushrooms and navigate them with ease thanks to our mycology app’s smooth interface. Build up your fungus collections, access them instantly, and keep essential information at hand anytime, anywhere.
Deepen your mushroom knowledge
Dive into the enchanting realm of mushrooms via our Popular Sets and Mushroom ID Must-Reads. Tailored for mushroom enthusiasts and seasoned foragers, these sections offer an ever-expanding library of must-read articles and profiles of popular mushrooms.
Have all the tools you need in one place
Improve your mushroom hunting experience with the help of Mushroom ID Tools. The Compass, Ruler, and Flashlight will be your trusty companions and digital helpers, no matter where you go. The Compass will help you identify where you are and where you need to go while the Flashlight will light up your way. Once you detect an interesting mushroom, our Ruler will tell you its exact measurements. And in case of an emergency, you can use Help Signal to make yourself visible to others.
Elevate your foraging experience and expand your fungus knowledge with our mushroom identifier by picture!

All-in-one Poker Tracker • Hand Replayer • Odds & Deal Calculator • Tournament Calendar

With many filter options you can find leaks in your game and see a lot of statistics. You can also connect with your friends and watch their sessions live! • Track your live sessions and visualize your chip graph and many more statistics.
• Track hands with the hand replayer and share them with friends to discuss your strategy. You can record regular hands as well as bomb pots, double boards, straddles or run it twice.
• Track hands to get player statistics like PFR, VPIP, 3BetPF, etc.
• Variance calculator.
• Calculate Holdem & Omaha odds with the odds calculator.
• Calculate final table deals using the ICM & Chip-Chop calculator.
• Calculate tournament payouts with the payout calculator.
• Keep an eye on your additional costs like hotels or tippings.
• Write notes about players.
• A lot of filters such as Type of Game, Limit, Buyin, Blinds, Location and many more.
• Public tournament calendar.
• More than 40 currencies like Dollar, Euro, Pound, Bitcoin or USDT with daily exchange rates for traveling poker players.
• Import CSV data that has been exported from other common tracker apps.
• You can use the Poker Bankroll Tracker offline without registering an account.

TOTAL IMMERSION

Perito Moreno glacier in Argentine Patagonia
Ubud Monkey T
bluejetty:00022663:ios.description:
The world, from your cardio machine! Explore hundreds of breathtaking workouts with interactive pacing, stunning clarity and crisp audio.
TOTAL IMMERSION
--------------------------
Perito Moreno glacier in Argentine Patagonia
Ubud Monkey Temple in Bali
The Eiffel Tower in Paris
Oahu's Lulumahu And Ruins
...and over 300+ immersive global workouts, with new ones each month!
HASSLE FREE
--------------------------
Real time workout sensing on *any* treadmill, bike, elliptical or rowing machine thanks to our camera based tracking. Or, connect a bluetooth enabled cardio machine or sensor. More details below.
BEST IN CLASS
--------------------------
For over a decade we’ve taken pride in crafting immersive exercise videos for treadmill, bike, elliptical and rowing machines. Always smooth, with audio, speed interactivity, and location specific facts.
COACHING
--------------------------
Optionally bring an instructor along for motivation, a playlist, and information about each location. Unlike other apps, they will not be in frame so you can stay focused on the path ahead.
SEE IT BIG
--------------------------
If you have a television in front of your cardio machine, you can project from it via HDMI or AirPlay. Or use BitGym on your AppleTV or Vision Pro!
STAY FIT ANYWHERE
--------------------------
Download any immersive video for offline use and get the cardio motivation to workout from home, gym or your hotel.
NEW: ROWING WORKOUTS
--------------------------
Our team has filmed dozens of lakes, rivers and canal workouts, and are working on more. Or you can row through our land based workouts as many of our members love to do.
“I used to use ifit… but this is so much better for graphics and speed”.
- Becky
“4 ways to get more out of your treadmill workout”.
- Huffington Post
“Takes the boredom out of gym exercise by giving you a virtual view to look at”.
- Stephen Fry
“I have to say I LOVE IT - the scenery is beautiful, the coaching is fantastic… I love the sprints!”.
- Darshan
SUBSCRIBE FOR FULL ACCESS
-------------------------
Some workouts are available for free, however to get access to all workouts, including new releases, we ask you to support us by becoming a paying member. Membership starts with a zero obligation free trial. Your membership subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renew may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
-------------------------
iPhone users can save each workout to their Health app. Once you are logged into your BitGym account, tap Profile and scroll down to find and enable this option. 
DEVICE COMPATIBILITY
-------------------------
BitGym supports all treadmills, bikes, ellipticals and ergs. By default, exercise speed will be determined by utilizing the front-facing camera on phones & tablets. Alternatively, you manually enter your pace. Bluetooth connections are supported for those treadmills, bikes, ellipticals and rowers with bluetooth. If your cardio machine works with other apps such as Rouvy, Kinomap or Zwift, it should work with BitGym as well. BitGym also supports lost cost Bluetooth sensors which you can add to your cardio machine, learn more at: https://support.bitgym.com/hc/en-us/articles/4411969914772-Connect-a-Bluetooth-cardio-sensor-or-FiTness-Machine-Service-FTMS-cardio-machine
The complete terms of service can be viewed here: https://www.bitgym.com/terms

ReeceNichols is Kansas City's #1 real estate resource, and now you can access the power of cutting edge technology on your iPad, iPhone or iPod Touch. The ReeceNichols Home Search app provides you with instant access all MLS listings in the Kansas City area. Our inventory is updated every 15 minutes, and each property has up to 25 photos and full property details. Quickly locate properties using our exclusive Home Scan feature to view homes for sale right where you are, or search for homes by city, zip code, address or by using our mapping feature. Found a home you love? Save it to your personal Home Match account, making it easy to find that property from the app or ReeceNichols.com. We also provide you with instant access to any one of our nearly 2,000 market experts to help you take the next step.
Features:
• Search all MLS listings in the Kansas City area.
• Inventory is updated every 15 minutes, ensuring you the most accurate information possible.
• Use our exclusive Home Scan feature to literally scan your surroundings for homes for sale.
• You can also search using our mapping feature or by city, zip code or address.
• View up to 25 photos and full property details on each listing.
• Save your favorites to your ReeceNichols Home Match account to access them from with the app or on ReeceNichols.com. You will receive email alerts of any changes that occur, too.

Download Peacock, NBCUniversal’s streaming service. Peacock has all your favorite culturedefining entertainment, all in one place.
With Peacock, stream exclusive Originals, fan-favorite movie franchises, thousands of TV shows,
and current programming from Bravo and NBC.
Stay up to date with the news and stream all your favorite live sports and events including
Sunday Night Baseball, WNBA games, golf, La Copa Mundial de la FIFA™ 2026, and so much
more.
With PEACOCK PREMIUM, stream the full library of movies, episodes, and seasons — plus live
sports and events.
• Stream new movies from theaters, including films from Universal Pictures,
Illumination, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features.
• Exclusive Peacock Originals, including Love Island USA, The Five Star Weekend,
Married at First Sight, The Traitors, and more.
• Live sports, including MLB, golf, WNBA games, Tour de France 2026, and more.
• The streaming home for your Bravo faves, including Below Deck, The Real
Housewives, and Summer House.
• Current-season NBC hits like America’s Got Talent, Law & Order, One Chicago,
and American Ninja Warrior.
• Peacock Channels – playing your favorite entertainment and news. Scroll less
and watch more with SNL Vault, Dateline, NBC Sports on Peacock, NBC News
NOW, TODAY All Day, and True Crime.
• Hit Spanish-language TV shows and news from Telemundo.
• Full library of Kids and Family entertainment.
With PEACOCK PREMIUM PLUS, get everything included in Peacock Premium as well as:
• No ads (limited exclusions)*
• Stream your local NBC channel, 24/7.
• Some titles available to watch offline.
*Certain pages are sponsored, and some programming will still contain ads (channels, live
sports and events, and a few shows and movies).
With PEACOCK SELECT, you get:
• Next-day TV from NBC and Bravo.
• A selection of full seasons (excludes Peacock Originals) and 24/7 streaming
channels of TV shows.
Content availability may vary over time.
Please note: Use of the Peacock app is limited to the United States and its territories. Video is
accessible via 3G, 4G, 5G, LTE and Wi-Fi networks. Data charges may apply.

Premium/Peacock Premium Plus concludes. You will be charged on a recurring basis as
described above, minus applied offers plus applicable taxes. Your subscription will auto-renew
until you cancel. Cancel at any time by visiting your account in the Peacock App. By subscribing,
you agree to the preceding subscription terms and our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy below.

bluejetty:00139990:ios.description:
LogicPuz is a puzzle game which will bring you endless fun by getting the right answer based on logical reasoning.
The puzzle is composed of cells with different difficulties corresponding to different cells. The goal of the game is to fill the cells with black and white dots and meet the following three requirements:
* Each row or column must contain an equal number of black and white dots.
* No more than two dots of the same color can be adjacent.
* Each row and column must be unique, they can't be the same.
The rules of the game are simple but full of challenges, let’s enjoy it and have fun.
We're constantly working to make the best puzzle game for you! In this update we've made some subtle changes for the app to run more smoothly.Should you have any feedback or issues - we're always ready to assist!

bluejetty:00063388:ios.description:
Catch up with your favorite Food Network shows anytime, anywhere with the all-new Food Network GO app - and now get access to up to 14 additional networks including TLC, Discovery, HGTV, Science Channel and more - all in one app. It’s FREE with your pay TV subscription. 
Link your pay TV provider (cable, satellite, telco, live TV streaming service) to access Food Network favorites like Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives, Guy's Grocery Games, Worst Cooks in America, Beat Bobby Flay, Restaurant: Impossible, Kids Baking Championship, The Pioneer Woman and many more - plus top shows from other networks including Home Town (HGTV), Deadliest Catch (Discovery), Evil Lives Here (ID), Sister Wives (TLC), Ghost Adventures (Travel Channel) and more. New episodes are available the same day as they premiere on TV. 
With Food Network GO You Can:
• Stream Food Network and more networks LIVE anytime, anywhere on all your favorite devices
• Find shows to watch with the live schedule guide
• Access thousands of episodes on demand - from current hits to classic favorites
• See new episodes of shows on the app the same day and time they premiere on TV
• Binge your favorite Food Network series and specials including Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives, Guy's Grocery Games, Worst Cooks in America, Beat Bobby Flay, Restaurant: Impossible, Kids Baking Championship, The Pioneer Woman - and many more! 
• Get unlimited access to everything the Discovery family of networks has to offer - free with your pay TV subscription
Features:
• Stream live TV when you link your pay TV provider
• Watch select episodes and entire seasons of your favorite shows from up to 15 networks!
• Browse by genre - from Natural History, Science and Tech to Food, Home and more - to find your favorite shows and discover new ones
• Continue watching episodes where you left off across all of your devices
• Save shows and episodes to watch later with My List
• Compatible with tvOS and Chromecast
• Closed-captioning support
Requirements:
• Available in the U.S. only
• Wi-Fi connection recommended
• iOS 12 or higher

This game focuses on stories, room escape, and horror.
It's not cruel or Gore-style.

-Run away or hide so she can't find it.

Please turn down the Cellphone's volume properly.

◆ Story
"Six years ago, there was an old Marrow Hospital that was not well known to people.
There was a big lake near the hospital, so it was often foggy.
So people even called the hospital a fog hospital."
"The hospital was experimenting with a variety of people it shouldn't.
The head nurse who was helping with her work had suffered a lot of guilt.
In the end, there was an incident in which he went crazy and killed everyone in the hospital, and himself committed suicide."
"And now six years later, a rumor has started circulating on the Internet that the head nurse is still alive.
The reporter goes to the fog hospital to dig up the fact."

An addicting mobile game that will help you relax and get the time to fly by.
 ⁃ Step into a world of cunning enemies and tricky traps! 
 ⁃ Put your skills and logic to the test in a fun puzzle strategy action. 
 ⁃ Outsmart your enemies and find the way out. 
 ⁃ Take your shot to cut down the rope - just aim and swipe in the right direction! 
 ⁃ Use your quick reflexes and strategic thinking to save as many characters as possible.
What are you waiting for? Download the game and get hours of thrilling gameplay.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Subscription options
In our game we have the following subscription options:
Weekly Premium offers a weekly subscription for $5.99 after a 3-day free trial. It removes all banner ads and pop-ups. Moreover, we will grant you everyday 20 gems and 1k gold bonus, premium decorations pack and premium skin for your better game experience.
End of trial and subscription renewal
This price is established for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Canceling trial or subscription
You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription whenever you want to through iTunes. Check https://support.apple.com/HT202039. When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period can not be canceled. After your subscription expires, you will no longer be able to use elements included in the Subscription option. If you have any questions or comments, feel free to contact us at support@playgendary.com
Privacy Policy: https://playgendary.com/en/playgendary-limited-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00097159:ios.description:
Welcome to Jackpot Winning, a casual spin-based game that brings together multiple play styles and themes, offering a variety of engaging experiences in one place. Enjoy the excitement of spinning, tapping, and discovering surprises at your own pace.
In Jackpot Winning, you can explore different slot machine styles. The game features Classic-style slots that deliver a familiar and straightforward reel experience, as well as Zombie-themed slots with distinctive visuals and atmosphere for a more unique twist on traditional gameplay.
Beyond slots, the game also includes additional casual modes. Both the Fruit Machine and the Miner game are designed with a festive Christmas theme, featuring snowy visuals, seasonal decorations, and cheerful effects that create a relaxed and enjoyable mood.
The gameplay is smooth and easy to pick up, with stable performance and polished animations across devices. To add an extra layer of excitement, Jackpot Winning includes a Lucky Wheel feature—simply tap to spin and receive random rewards that enhance each play session.
Whether you prefer classic reels, themed slots, or lighthearted holiday mini-games, Jackpot Winning offers a balanced and entertaining experience. Jump in anytime, spin the wheel, and enjoy the thrill of chance and variety.
Game Features:
Classic-style slot machines with traditional reel gameplay
Zombie-themed slots with unique visuals and atmosphere
Christmas-themed Fruit Machine mode for casual fun
Christmas-themed Miner game with engaging, light gameplay
Lucky Wheel feature for random surprise rewards
Smooth controls and optimized performance across devices
Spin, tap, and explore different ways to play—your next lucky moment awaits in Jackpot Winning!

bluejetty:00033938:ios.name: FCC Mobile Speed Test
bluejetty:00033938:ios.summary:
About this app 
You can use the FCC Mobile Speed Test app to take mobile speed tests that will help improve the Federal Communication Commissions (FCC) National Broadband Map. The app can also test the speed of your wireless broadband c
bluejetty:00033938:ios.description:
About this app 
You can use the FCC Mobile Speed Test app to take mobile speed tests that will help improve the Federal Communication Commissions (FCC) National Broadband Map. The app can also test the speed of your wireless broadband connection! 
The ad-free FCC Mobile Speed Test app offers three speed test options: Challenge, Crowdsource,and QuickCheck. 
Challenge speed tests enable you to dispute, or “challenge,” your provider’s mobile coverage shown on the National Broadband Map. Once enough negative challenges are filed with the FCC, the provider must respond or correct their coverage maps. 
Crowdsource speed tests help the FCC evaluate mobile coverage across the United States and verify the accuracy of the National Broadband Map. 
QuickCheck speed tests let you test the speed of your wireless network connection without submitting a challenge or sharing your contact information with the FCC. 
To learn more about the FCC’s National Broadband Map, go to www.fcc.gov/BroadbandData. 
App Features: 
• Use the “Repeated Test” option to perform back-to-back Challenge, Crowdsource, or Quick Check tests for up to 4 hours without having to initiate a new test each time. 
• Run scheduled Crowdsource tests seamlessly in the background at your desired frequency. 
• Set a data cap to limit the amount of data the app can use for tests over a one-month period. 
• View test results in the History section. 
• Export and save results as a CSV on your device or email yourself a ZIP file with test results. 
This is the official mobile speed test app of the Federal Communications Commission (FCC). Consistent with the FCC’s rules, users taking Challenge or Crowdsource test must enter certain personal contact information: name, phone number, and email address. 
Privacy: 
We protect your privacy, and you can choose to share data with specific parties. Refer to the Privacy Notice for more details or get the App for more information. 
The FCC may share your contact info with your mobile broadband provider if you choose to run a Challenge test so that the provider can use your data plan and other technical information to fully evaluate the test result.

bluejetty:00080308:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00080308:ios.description:
Welcome to the captivating world of Tile Dynasty, where the art of matching tiles takes center stage in this exciting puzzle adventure!
Immerse yourself in a rich tapestry of colorful tiles, each waiting for your strategic touch. Your objective? Match three tiles of the same color to clear the board and ascend to puzzle mastery. With every level presenting a fresh array of obstacles and opportunities, the excitement never wanes.
Features:
Exciting Gameplay: Dive into a puzzle game experience that's easy to learn but hard to master, keeping you coming back for more.
Strategic Challenges: Plan your moves carefully to outsmart obstacles, match three tiles, and claim victory over each level.
Stunning Visuals: Lose yourself in a world of vibrant colors and enchanting landscapes, each more beautiful than the last.
Power-Ups and Bonuses: Unlock special abilities and boosts to help you overcome even the toughest challenges and puzzle games.
But what sets Tile Dynasty apart is not just its gameplay—it's the journey. As you match tiles and progress through each level, you'll encounter new landscapes, unlock power-ups, and unravel the mysteries of the ancient tile dynasties. From tranquil gardens to bustling marketplaces, every setting offers a new backdrop for your tile-matching prowess.
But beware, for the path to victory is not without its trials. Cunning obstacles and devious puzzles stand between you and triumph, testing your strategic acumen with every match three move. Will you rise to the challenge and claim your place among the tile-matching elite?
Yet, Tile Dynasty is more than just a game. With regular updates and new challenges added frequently, the adventure never ends. Match tiles today and discover your new favorite puzzle game.
Tile Dynasty is an homage to the timeless classic, Mahjong. Delve into a world where tradition meets innovation as you match iconic Mahjong tiles amidst the modern puzzle landscape. Each tile carries with it a rich history and symbolism, adding depth and intrigue to every match. Whether you're a seasoned Mahjong player or a newcomer to matching games, Tile Dynasty offers a fresh and exciting take on this beloved tradition. Prepare to immerse yourself in the captivating fusion of old and new, where the spirit of Mahjong reigns supreme in every move.
Join the Tile Dynasty today, match tiles, and unleash your inner puzzle master!

bluejetty:00088549:ios.name: Luma: Events & Invites
bluejetty:00088549:ios.summary:
DISCOVER EVENTS NEAR YOU
Find popular upcoming tech, crypto, wellness, and social events around you. After registering for an event, you can easily share it with your friends or on your socials. At the event, pull up your event ticket or A
bluejetty:00088549:ios.description:
DISCOVER EVENTS NEAR YOU
Find popular upcoming tech, crypto, wellness, and social events around you. After registering for an event, you can easily share it with your friends or on your socials. At the event, pull up your event ticket or Apple Wallet pass for seamless entry.
CHAT WITH (NEW) FRIENDS
Don’t be that "Ugh, want to add me on IG / LinkedIn?" person. If you attend an event with someone, you can easily look them up and chat with them right from within Luma.
HOST AN EVENT
Host delightful events with ease. Create a beautiful event page, send email and SMS invites, collect registrations, and chat with your guests. With Luma taking care of reminders, ticketing, checking in and more, you can focus your full attention on the event itself.
BEAUTIFUL EVENT PAGES
You can create a beautiful event page in just a few seconds. Just choose a cover image, name, location and time for your event. We’ll take care of the rest.
For cover images, you can choose from our fun gallery of party posters, bbq invites, happy hour photos and many more.
SELL TICKETS
You can create a new event, start selling tickets, and market your event all within Luma. It takes just a few minutes to connect your bank account and then you’ll receive next day payment as guests buy tickets.
SMS AND EMAIL INVITES
Now you’ve created your event — who is going to come? You can sync your contacts and easily send a mass SMS invite message.
In addition, Luma makes it incredibly easy to invite past guests again and to send email invites.
CHECK IN GUESTS
If you want to track attendance, you can check in guests with our built in QR code scanner and check in system. Guests will be able to show their QR code to scan in — or you can look them up by their name or email.
You can add cohosts to your event who can also check in guests and manage the event together.
SUBSCRIBE TO LOCAL CALENDARS
From running clubs to AI calendars, discover fun events and clubs around you. Keep up with their events and make new friends.

bluejetty:00115589:ios.description:
Feel better in your body. Every day.
Stiff hips? Tight shoulders? Can't touch your toes?
Limber is NOT another cookie-cutter routine. Limber is your PERSONAL mobility coach — giving you daily stretching routines tailored to your body, goals, and stiffness. Designed to reduce pain, increase flexibility, and help you move freely for life.
Whether you’re an athlete, office worker, parent, or just feeling stiff — Limber helps you unlock your body’s potential through smart mobility programming.
WHAT MAKES LIMBER DIFFERENT?
⊕ Personalized mobility test
⊕ Clear & easy to follow instructional videos
⊕ Smart daily flows that adapt as you improve
⊕ Expert-designed routines for pain relief, flexibility, performance enhancement and injury prevention
⊕ Fast progress with only 10-15 minutes a day
⊕ Minimal equipment, maximum benefit
REAL RESULTS. ON AND OFF THE MAT.
Whether you're lifting, running, climbing, working at a desk, or just waking up stiff, Limber helps you move better and feel better, every day. Use Limber to:
⊕ Loosen tight hips, shoulders, and hamstrings
⊕ Relieve back pain and neck tension
⊕ Improve posture and joint mobility
⊕ Build deeper squats, stronger lifts, and faster runs
⊕ Boost flexibility, recovery, and athletic performance
⊕ Move with ease and confidence as you age
⊕ Reduce stress and feel better in your body
⊕ Build a stretching habit that actually sticks
YOUR BODY, YOUR PLAN
Limber starts by assessing your flexibility and range of motion. Based on your results, it builds a routine just for you — and evolves it as you grow. Stretch smarter, not longer.
SIMPLE. EFFECTIVE. SCIENCE BACKED. 
Limber combines physical therapy, sports science, and mindful movement to give you the perfect stretch every day — no guesswork, no burnout.
INCLUSIVE FOR EVERYONE
Limber is built for all ages, body types, and fitness levels. Whether you’re a total beginner or a pro athlete, Limber meets you where you are.
DOWNLOAD LIMBER TODAY
Start your personalized mobility journey now — and feel the difference in days. Try Limber FREE for 7 days.

bluejetty:00074030:ios.description:
Evaluate your risk of Autism Spectrum Disorder with a validated screening questionnaire. 
Autism Spectrum Disorder is a range of conditions all characterized by difficulties with social, restricted interests, and repetitive patterns of behavior. While it is typically diagnosed in childhood, a diagnosis could be delayed until adulthood - especially for those with high functioning autism. 
If you have had lifelong difficulties understanding other people's feelings, maintain peculiar hobbies, difficulty with social interaction, stick to a rigid schedule, or are really good at specific subjects - you may have undiagnosed Autism Spectrum Disorder. 
Disclaimer: This test is NOT a diagnostic test. A diagnosis can only be provided by a qualified healthcare professional. Please consult a physician or mental health professional if you are concerned about your mental health.
Eriksson, J. M., Andersen, L. M., & Bejerot, S. (2013). RAADS-14 Screen: validity of a screening tool for autism spectrum disorder in an adult psychiatric population. Molecular Autism, 4(1), 49.
Privacy Policy: https://inquiryhealth.com/testappprivacypolicy

bluejetty:00078415:ios.description:
Apple Health backed net calorie + macro counter - track your calories in and out. Track your macros, protein / kg, splits, and set targets. No accounts, no login, ever. Track what you eat, what you burn, and your net for the day on iPhone and Apple Watch. Any app that writes to Apple Health works as a data source, so you're never locked in.
Features:
- 7-Day Net Calories graph, comparing target against actuals
- Net calorie targets (now free!): set a daily goal and let CaliCalo help you hit it
- Net calories on your Apple Watch with a glanceable calorie meter
- Watch complications for every face to keep your status in view all day
- Log dietary calories in the app and sync them straight to Apple Health
- Macro tracking: log and view daily protein, carbs, and fat, or pull them in from any Apple Health source
- Weigh-in logging: record your weight in Settings and review history, synced with Apple Health
- Home screen + lock screen widgets for at-a-glance progress
- Quick daily stats + weekly averages
- [Premium] Trends with much longer timelines, more data points, and weight comparison overlaid on net calories
- [Premium] Macro trends and daily macro targets
- [Premium] Magic bar: an optional motivational progress indicator you can show or hide
- [Premium] Choose a theme for your app
Subscriptions:
CaliCalo uses auto-renewing subscriptions. CaliCalo Premium subscription offers features tagged above as premium, like advanced trending and graphs, targets, and theming.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of your purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. 
Read the Privacy Policy and Terms and Use for more information.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00068729:ios.description:
No account registration! No e-mail harvesting! No spam! 
QueryDB has spent over 15 years helping developers remotely query their MySQL databases on iOS. It's not just a desktop port: it handles flakey cellular network connections and delivering your data wherever you are!
• Integrated UI support for parameterized queries
• Optimized to run queries over low quality network connections.
 • Does not maintain persistent connections to your database
 • Automatically windows data requests to prevent client overload when 
querying large tables.
 • Support for MPTCP for seamless network transitions between Wifi and cellular networks (SSH server and routers must also support)
• Query oriented workflow. 
 • Run queries with minimal steps.
 • Run the same queries across different environments (e.g. prod, staging, dev).
 • Support for Siri Shortcuts for both UI and scripting purposes
• Unicode support.
 • Automatically sets to default database charset.
• iCloud support
 • Easily synchronize servers and queries across all your devices.
• CSV export through iOS extensions
 • Easily export data to Numbers, Files, and other sharing extensions that support CSV.
• Premium/Paid support for SSL connections and SSH tunneling
Comprehensive MySQL version support: Versions 4,x, 5.x, and 8.x, Amazon Aurora, Google SQL, MariaDB.
QueryDB was first introduced on iOS 6 and has constantly been revised to keep up with iOS, iPad, MySQL, and SSH revisions. It currently works all the way back to iOS 9 and MySQL 5.x, up through iOS 13 and MySQL 8.x. 
On top of an 13 year record, it continues to offer features absent from others like parameterized queries, Siri shortcuts.
For the past 13 years, we've only charged for Ad removal and SSH support, leaving basics like un-encrypted db access and CSV export available for free. Our hope is to continue offering basic access for free while charging a nominal fee to others who would use it in a professional capacity. However, the increasing combinations of iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, SSH/SSL, and MySQL versions have substantially increased the burden of development, maintenance, and testing. 
To help keep up with the pace of change, we're switching to a one-time fee for all features with support for subscriptions at a later date. As a thank you to all users who purchased the Remove Ads option, they'll all be grandfathered into the new Premium tier (it will use the same in-app purchase product). From this version on, the one-time premium purchase will match the price of the MySQL QueryDB SSH product since they're identical.

Playdek and Looney Labs team up to bring this amazingly fun card game to mobile devices. Fluxx fuses its chaotic and fun game play with offline and online features that fans have come to love in Playdek games!
Featuring New Rule cards that change the rules of the game and Action cards that create chaos. Even the object of winning the game changes during play, as players swap out one Goal card for another.
The Fluxx card game has earned the Mensa Select Award for games that meet Mensa’s high standards of originality, playability and design.
Features:
- Offline and Online play for 2-4 players
- Human and AI opponents
- In-game Chat
- Pass-and-play Multiplayer
- Full asynchronous support for multiplayer online games
- Invite your friends to play online games
- Online player stats
- Tutorial
Recommended for iPhone 6 and later; iPad 5th Generation and later; iPad Mini 2 and later; iPod Touch 6th Generation; iOS 11 and later.
**AN INTERNET CONNECTION AND PLAYDEK ACCOUNT ARE REQUIRED FOR ONLINE PLAY**
Per our Terms of Service, you must be 13 years old or older to use the Playdek online games service.

bluejetty:00162911:ios.description:
Track your period with a simple, ad-free calendar.
Record start and end dates, review past periods, and see your next predicted date at a glance.
No account is needed for everyday tracking. Your records stay on your device unless you choose to use optional cloud backup or data sharing.
Simpluna Plus adds more ways to track and personalize your calendar with a one-time purchase. No subscription.
Open the calendar, tap the start or end date, and your next predicted period is shown on the calendar.
Predictions shown in the app are estimates based on your records.
They are not intended for medical diagnosis or treatment, or for decisions about contraception or pregnancy.
No articles, AI chat, or forums — just your records and predictions.
Over 600,000 downloads!
—————— Features ——————
Simpluna is an app for recording and predicting your period days.
When you launch the app, a calendar appears so you can check your next predicted period and past periods at a glance. By cutting unnecessary features and keeping things as simple as possible, we make sure the app does not get in the way of your daily life.
▶ Easy recording
To record your period, just tap a date on the calendar and press the start or end button. It is intuitive, so there is nothing new to learn.
▶ Notes on each day
If there is anything you want to keep track of, such as how you feel or your physical condition, you can leave it as a note.
▶ Notification before the predicted date
You can receive a notification as your next predicted period approaches. You can specify how many days in advance and at what time you want to be notified.
▶ Register up to 1 year of past data
If you have past period records, you can register them. The available range goes back up to 1 year from when you started using the app. (With Simpluna Plus, you can register up to 10 years.)
▶ Forecast calendar up to 1 year ahead
The forecast calendar lets you look up to 1 year into the future. You can also save future plans as notes and view them together with the predictions.
▶ List of past periods
You can review your past periods as a list.
▶ App lock
You can lock the app with a 4-digit passcode if you do not want others to see it. Face ID is also supported.
▶ Dark mode support
The UI colors automatically switch to match light or dark mode.
▶ Works offline
You can keep using the app even when offline or with a poor signal.
—————— Simpluna Plus (Paid: one-time purchase) ——————
▶ Color themes
16 colors are available.
▶ Ovulation tracking
Predict and manage ovulation, including the window around it.
▶ PMS period display
The PMS period is shown as an underline on the calendar. You can change the number of days for the period.
▶ Pause
Pause predictions during pregnancy, treatment, or other times.
▶ Prediction summary
Show your current cycle day, next period, and ovulation prediction on the home screen.
▶ Customizable input fields
Add custom fields such as symptoms, flow, temperature, or medication.
▶ Customizable notifications
You can freely change the timing and message of notifications.
▶ Pill reminder
Set daily pill reminders, active periods, break periods, and the message.
▶ Widget
Show your next predicted period as a home screen widget.
▶ Past data registration (up to 10 years)
You can register data going back up to 10 years from the day you started using the app.
▶ Health app integration
Auto-sync period dates, import from the Health app, and export.
A 24-hour trial is available before purchase (you will not be charged automatically).
—————— Other one-time purchases ——————
▶ Continuous cloud backup
Continuous cloud backup with a one-time purchase. No monthly or annual fees. Migration and manual backups are free.
▶ Data sharing
Share records and predictions with someone you choose. Includes data backup.
—————— Supported OS ——————
iOS 16.4 or later is required.
Some older iOS versions may not be able to install future updates.

bluejetty:00096633:ios.description:
Scan Ingredients. Compare. Eat Smarter.
With Ellē – Smart Food Scanner, you can scan any grocery product to instantly see how healthy it is. Get a science-backed food score based on ingredients, nutrition, additive risks, organic certifications and processing level—and discover healthier alternatives in seconds.
What Makes Ellē Different?
Smarter Food Scoring, Backed by Scientific Research
Not all food labels tell the whole story. Ellē evaluates products using the latest research on food additives, nutrition, and processing levels to help you:
- Spot harmful ingredients – Know if a product contains additives dangerous to your health.
- See through food marketing – Get a clear, unbiased score based on facts, not marketing.
- Compare & choose better options – Find cleaner, healthier alternatives in seconds.
“Ellē helps you make informed choices—without the guesswork.”
 What You Can Do with Ellē
- Scan Any Barcode – Instantly decode food labels & ingredients.
- Get a Smart Food Score – See how a product scores based on nutritional quality, additive risk, level of processing and whether or not it’s organic. 
- Identify Harmful Additives – Avoid ultra-processed foods and unwanted food additives, such as artificial food colors, nitrites, and sulfates. 
- Compare & Discover Better Alternatives – Find cleaner, healthier swaps in seconds.
- Grocery Shopping Made Easy – Know what’s best for your body—before you buy. 
Smart, Personalized Food Insights
Ellē Overview – Your Food Guide, Tailored to You
When you scan a product, Ellē doesn’t just show a score—she explains what it means for you.
- Too much salt or sugar? Get a heads-up before you buy.
- Contains additives linked to health risks? Ellē flags them.
- Looking for a better option? Get instant recommendations.
- Better-For-You Options, Right at Your Fingertips
- Looking to swap out a pantry staple for something healthier? Ellē makes it easy by recommending the best alternatives—similar in taste, better for your body.
Explore top-rated products across popular categories like cereals, frozen meals, snacks, and more. Whether you’re shopping at home or in-store, Ellē helps you choose better.
“Ellē makes healthy eating simple, science-backed, and completely personalized to you.”
 Why Choose Ellē?
- Unbiased & Science-Backed – Our scoring system is built on research studies published in top academic journals such as Nature, British Medical Journal and more. 
- Personalized for You – Get recommendations that match your lifestyle, from dairy-free to vegetarian to low-sodium.
- Save Time & Eat Healthier – Stop second-guessing food labels—Ellē does the work for you.
Download Ellē now and eat with confidence, every time you shop.
Read about our terms of use here: https://www.elle.ai/terms-of-service
If you have any questions about the Ellē app, or just want to drop in and say hello, contact us at support@elle.ai

bluejetty:00154092:ios.description:
Color Candy Jam: A Colorful Brain-Training Puzzle Adventure!
Step into a vibrant world of puzzles where logic, strategy, and colorful candy blocks come together!
In Color Candy Jam, your mission is simple yet challenging: slide candy blocks to their matching colored doors and clear each level with clever moves. With each puzzle, you’ll train your brain and sharpen your thinking skills in the most delightful way.
Game Features:
Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Move the candy blocks freely, but beware of obstacles! Every move counts, so plan carefully to complete each level.
Unique Puzzle Mechanics: Match colors and use strategic thinking to solve puzzles that grow more complex as you progress.
Smooth & Intuitive Controls: Slide your candy blocks effortlessly for a satisfying and seamless gameplay experience.
Colorful Visuals: Enjoy bright, playful graphics that make each puzzle a joyful challenge.
How to Play:
Slide the candy blocks toward their matching colored doors.
Match all the candy colors correctly to clear the stage.
New obstacles will appear as you advance—use logic and foresight to overcome them!
Tips to Become a Puzzle Master:
Look ahead and plan your moves to avoid getting stuck.
Use each candy’s shape and movement path to your advantage.
Think strategically to clear space and create better opportunities for movement.

bluejetty:00166530:android.description:
Step into a world of creativity and relaxation with Black Color, the ultimate coloring app that celebrates you. Designed to provide a comforting and engaging space, Black Color invites you to unwind, express your artistic side, and enjoy the therapeutic joy of coloring. With a wide variety of themes and designs, every tap of color becomes a journey of self-expression, fun, and mindfulness.
Key Features:
🌈Feel the Warmth❤:From the moment you open the app, you'll feel the welcoming and uplifting vibe. Black Color is crafted to be your personal sanctuary, where creativity flows freely and stress melts away.
🌺Diverse and Fun Designs:Dive into a colorful collection of illustrations that celebrate black history, culture, sports, family, baby, medieval scenes, and characters. Choose inappropriate content like Black Color by Number, Black Girl Coloring, African American Coloring, and Women of Color. Featuring powerful portraits, adorable children, and a diverse range of animals, each design offers a unique way to express your creativity, there’s always something new and exciting to discover.
🎨Color by Number and Free Coloring🖌: Enjoy both traditional black coloring book experiences and color-by-number options like Black Color: Vast collection of exquisite illustrations: from simple animal designs to intricate characters and unique cultural themes, thousands of diverse styles are available for free, allowing you to explore and discover something new every time.
👉Create and Connect🌊:Your art, your rules! Use a vibrant palette to bring each design to life. Whether you’re a seasoned artist or just looking to have fun, you can explore endless combinations and make every piece uniquely yours.
🌞Relax and Unwind📸: Coloring is a proven way to soothe the mind and relax the body. Lose yourself in the calming process of choosing colors and filling in designs. Explore a variety of designs that are perfect for de-stressing, relaxing, and finding your inner calm.
🌸Easy to Use, Hard to Put Down: Our user-friendly interface ensures that everyone, no matter their skill level, can jump right in and start creating. The intuitive controls make coloring effortless and enjoyable.
✨Celebrate Your Creations🖼️:Save and share your colorful masterpieces with friends, family, and the wider community. Spread joy, inspire others, and let your art speak volumes.
🔔Regular Updates and Free Content💭:We keep things fresh and exciting by regularly adding new designs, features, and themes. Our constant updates ensure that there’s always something new to explore, keeping your creativity flowing and making each coloring session feel engaging and unique.
Black Color is your go-to app for blk creativity, color pop, and more, blending the best of adult coloring books, pigment apps, color games, and black girl coloring fun. From Color Breakthrough to Well Women of Color and Tap Color by Number Black People, there’s a unique, expressive experience waiting for you.
Got any feedback? We'd love to hear from you! Reach out to us at mimintgames@gmail.com.

bluejetty:00177169:ios.summary: Push Tower is a simple and easy to learn turn based number strategy battle game. Start your adventure in tiny tower in a small town and use your wits to wage wars and fight, raid and conquer enemy castles along the way. Push mighty crowds o
bluejetty:00177169:ios.description:
Push Tower is a simple and easy to learn turn based number strategy battle game. Start your adventure in tiny tower in a small town and use your wits to wage wars and fight, raid and conquer enemy castles along the way. Push mighty crowds of enemies off each tower floor. If successful, you will gain their power, takeover their towers and get one step closer to defeating the boss king. Collect powerups, treasure chests and new towers along the way to help you defeat your enemies. 
Can you become a hero, conquer enemy castles and push your way to Victory?
How to Play
- Drag and drop your blue character onto tower floors with red enemies
- You must have a higher number than the chosen enemy to push them off and takeover that floor
- When you defeat enemies you gain their power number as your own
- Use powerups and math strategy to raid enemies and takeover each tower
- Be aware of your defense and do not attack enemies with higher power than you
- Conquer all the towers and defeat the king to win the level

bluejetty:00027297:ios.description:
EasyQuit is an App to help you break the habit of drinking alcohol.
It has a "quit slowly" mode, scientific health statistics, money saved, motivational badges and many more features.
---- Motivational Health Section ----
- Countdown timer to watch all aspects of your health improve as a result of your great decision to stop this bad habit of drinking alcohol.
---- Stop Drinking Slowly Mode ----
- You cant quit drinking now because the alcohol dependance is too strong? no problem!
Easy Quit has an entire "Slow Mode" to help you stop drinking slowly.
It will create a customised plan for you to become alcohol free with less pain or stress.
---- High Level of Privacy ----
- No log in, no collection or selling of your sensitive data like email, password or contacts. Your data is saved locally on your phone.
---- Money Statistics ----
- Watch your pockets grow and see how much money you saved by being sober from alcohol.
- Set a nice treat for yourself let the app help you see how long until you reach it. This will motivate you and help you stay without alcohol.
---- Cravings & Trigger Statistics ----
- Pie Chart showing you the breakdown of your top triggers to help you eliminate your cravings fasters (Pro Version).
---- Memory Game ----
- Have an urge to have a drink? Let EasyQuit help you by providing a cool game of Memory with beautiful icons to pass the time until the urge goes away.
---- Badges ----
- Earn up to 100 different badges as rewards and use them as a motivational tool. They can also help you stay strong against the alcohol addiction if you share your progress with your friends through the screenshot option provided by EasyQuit.
---- Themes ----
- Personalize EasyQuit by choosing any of the 28 beautiful themes provided.
---- Relapse Assistant ----
- Let the app help you decide your next step after a relapse by recommending a certain action based on your previous quitting data (Pro Version).
--- Diary ---
- Add your thoughts and moods daily to keep a clear head and remain strong during this journey (Pro Version).
---- Modern Design ----
- Modern & original design consistent with the modern design guidelines.
I hope my sobriety counter app helps you become free from alcohol forever. Don't wait, quit now or use stop slowly mode and let EasyQuit help you become a healthier and happier person :)

Are you looking for a flat or house? We´re convinced the home of your dreams exists, however, it might be tough to find it. That´s why the new Mitula Homes app is available in 41 countries and 15 languages.
The Mitula Homes app offers thousands of listings so as you can search for a flat, house, apartment, attic, duplex, studio, chalet, loft, land, etc.
The Mitula Homes app is very intuitive. If you search for a house for sale or rent you can filter your results by date of listing, and important criteria such as location, price, number of square meters, number of rooms, bathrooms, etc.
What could you do with the Mitula Homes app?
◉ Contact the advertiser directly
◉ Sign up with Mitula Homes and access your saved searches and favourite listings from any device
◉ Discard the listings you´re not interested in to make your search easier
◉ Choose from any of the 15 languages available
◉ Receive emails with info on your favourite searches
◉ Quick access to your recent searches
◉ Receive notifications on your mobile when new homes with your criteria appear
◉ Share listings on social networks or send them via email
◉ View properties that interest you on the map
◉ If you are house-hunting with someone you can see the listings that you have shared. Also from the detail of the listing you will be able to see the location on the map and places of interest nearby as hospitals, education, public transport and supermarkets
◉ Localise homes within your chosen neighbourhood
A designed application to make the search for properties faster and easier.
More info on www.property.mitula.co.uk
