bluejetty:00069253:ios.description:
Majong Solitaire is one of the most classic puzzle games. Match tiles that are identical & clear the board to complete a Majong puzzle. 
Classic Majong is a multiplayer board game, but Majong Solitaire is a single-player match game. 
Majong Solitaire can improve your memory & keep your brain sharp. Our classic puzzle game offers countless levels and challenging puzzle layouts for endless relaxation. 
Free Majong Solitaire Features: 
- Play dozens of unique puzzles 
- Boost your score with special green & blue tiles 
- Use free hints to help you solve each puzzle 
- Enjoy beautiful graphics, animations & music 
- Track your progress with personal statistics 
- Choose to play with the sound & music on or off 
- Play puzzles on both tablet & phone 
- Complete puzzles offline without Wifi 
Play this Majong free puzzle game on iOS & you will see why everyone loves our classic puzzle game. This classic majong game is perfect for those who enjoy match games & puzzles. 
How to Play Majong Solitaire: 
Majong is a board game where you must match Majong tiles that have been discarded from the board. Majong Solitaire is just the reverse: you must match tiles to discard them from the board. Clear every tile to complete the puzzle and move on to the next level. 
- Tap identical tiles that are not blocked to clear them from the board 
- Tiles that are not blocked have an open edge and nothing on top of them 
- Match special blue & green colored tiles to earn more points 
- Use free hints to help you find a match on the board 
- If you have three of the same tile, match the two that unveil the most tiles in the puzzle 
- Clear the board as fast as you can to earn more points 
Majong Solitaire is a puzzle game designed to improve your memory, strategy, & skill. Try different puzzle layouts to sharpen your brain. Other Majong layouts include ziggurat, fotress, dragon, turtle and so many more. Download today & experience them all.

bluejetty:00021874:ios.description:
Voliz is a polling app that helps you create polls or surveys that can be shared easily on WhatsApp. Share them with your Contacts, Groups, Broadcast Lists, or friends and get their opinions in a fast and simple way with WhatsApp messages. The poll creator has to download the app, but voters can directly vote from their WhatsApp.
Voliz uses Official WhatsApp APIs to run the poll or survey and give a seamless voting experience to end-users. It's a simple, superfast, and real-time polling app.
How to create a Poll that can be shared on WhatsApp?
Create a Poll
You can create a poll by adding a question and its answers/options and set up the different settings like Allow Single/Multiple Vote, Public/Private Result, and Poll Ends on, etc.
Share your Poll
Share your poll with a click of a button with your users everywhere. You can share them on WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business, Facebook, or Telegram.
When voters click on a link, they will be redirected to WhatsApp and submit their votes.
Result Privacy
We know the importance of Poll Privacy, so with Voliz, you can set up the result to be visible to,
Me - Only visible to Poll Creator
Everyone - Visible to All
Voters Only - Only Visible to Voters
Public Polls
Voliz has thousands of users from whom you can take their opinions on your next big idea. Create a poll and make it available to everyone, you will start receiving votes from people worldwide.

- Social Voting App

bluejetty:00147048:ios.description:
Why wait for payday when you can be in control today? Dayforce Wallet gives you access to your hard-earned money when you need it – for the freedom to manage your finances on your schedule. Join thousands of other users who get paid their way.
It’s simple – view and access your pay as soon as you earn it in the Dayforce Wallet app and transfer it to a Dayforce Wallet Mastercard® with a few taps of a screen. Use your card to make purchases, pay bills, or withdraw cash. The rest will be paid out on payday.
Here’s why you’ll love it:
All-in-one financial tool
Manage your earnings, set and fund savings goals, and track your spending - all in one place.
Get paid early
Access your pay on-demand¹ and get your regular paycheck deposited directly to your Dayforce Wallet account up to two days before payday.²
Move money easily
Unlock free³ or instant⁴ bank transfers and withdraw cash from over 55,000 fee-free ATMs.⁵
No fees
No fees to get paid on-demand, no minimums, and no interest.⁶
Exclusive perks
Like partner offers and more.
If your employer has activated Dayforce Wallet, download the app to get started and own your payday.
Need help? Call us at 1-800-342-9167
¹ Not all employers choose to offer on-demand pay with Dayforce Wallet. Check with your employer to see if this is available to you. Some blackout dates and limitations may apply based on your employer's pay cycle and configurations. Green Dot Bank does not administer and is not responsible for on-demand pay.
² Early direct deposit availability depends on payor type, timing, payment instructions, and bank fraud prevention measures. As such, early direct deposit availability may vary from pay period to pay period.
³ Limits apply. Subject to your bank’s restrictions and fees. All transfers submitted after 10:00pm PST/1:00am EST will be initiated the next business day.
⁴ Instant Transfers can only be sent to another eligible bank account in your name with a linked Visa-, Mastercard-, or Discover-branded debit card. An Instant Transfer fee of $3.49 per transfer will be charged. Limits apply.
⁵ Fee-free ATM access applies to in-network ATMs only. For out-of-network ATMs and bank tellers, a $2.99 fee will apply, plus any additional fee that the ATM owner or bank may charge. Limits apply. Please see Cardholder Agreement or Deposit Account Agreement for details.
⁶ On-demand pay is free; however, fees may apply to certain card and account transactions. Please see Cardholder Agreement or Deposit Account Agreement for complete list of fees.
Banking services provided by and the Dayforce Wallet Mastercard issued by Green Dot Bank, Member FDIC, pursuant to a license from Mastercard International Incorporated.

- Puzzle games, brain teasers, mechanical challenges, and relaxing logic fun!

Download Bolt Escape 3D now and twist your way to victory!
Don’t just sit there—unscrew it out!

Have you always dreamed of travelling to the 7 New Wonders of the World? Now you can! Join Amber and the girls as they fly around the world in Amber’s Airline – 7 Wonders, a brand new time management game.
In this story game, you’ll do more than assist passengers on the airplane. After being the flight attendant in the air, you’ll help your VIP travelers on the ground. Take care of their luggage, passports and safety. Make sure they have all the information and equipment they need to fully enjoy their dream vacation in the game. Alongside the grandeur of the Great Wall, Chichen Itza, the Taj Mahal, Christ the Redeemer, the Colosseum, Petra and Machu Picchu, drama unfolds within the crew. Amber must rise to the occasion and help her fellow flight attendants.
This game will test your time management skills as you juggle work duties and personal relationships! And speaking of personal relationships… Amber herself faces her biggest emotional struggle ever. It’s not going to be easy. Can you help Amber?

bluejetty:00179775:ios.summary: Teach Me Surgery provides students, doctors, and health professionals with a comprehensive surgical learning platform. Includes an integrated surgical encyclopaedia, 3D models of surgical anatomy and procedures, and a bank of over 1,800 qui
bluejetty:00179775:ios.description:
Teach Me Surgery provides students, doctors, and health professionals with a comprehensive surgical learning platform. Includes an integrated surgical encyclopaedia, 3D models of surgical anatomy and procedures, and a bank of over 1,800 quiz questions – download to get started today!
ABOUT TEACH ME SURGERY:
Teach Me Surgery is a comprehensive, easy-to-read reference for surgery and perioperative care. Each topic provides clear, structured coverage of the key principles of surgery, helping you build the knowledge needed for exams and clinical practice.
Created by a team of surgeons and doctors, Teach Me Surgery covers over 400 surgical topics across a wide range of specialties, with articles individually reviewed and revised by experts in their fields.
Whether you're a medical student, surgical trainee, healthcare professional or simply looking to improve your understanding of surgery, Teach Me Surgery provides the tools you need to learn and consolidate your knowledge.
FEATURES:
SURGICAL ENCYCLOPAEDIA: Over 400 comprehensive articles covering a wide range of surgical topics and specialties.
3D SURGICAL MODELS: Interactive 3D models covering surgical anatomy and surgical procedures.
HD ILLUSTRATIONS: Over 1,000 full-colour, high-definition surgical illustrations and clinical images.
QUESTION BANK: Over 1,800 multiple-choice questions with detailed explanations to test and consolidate your surgical knowledge.
CLINICAL EXAMINATION GUIDES: Easy-to-follow guides covering common clinical examinations and practical assessments.
SUMMARY BOXES: Concise summaries at the end of each article to highlight key points and consolidate your learning.
OFFLINE STORE: Offline access to articles, illustrations and quiz questions, allowing you to learn anytime, anywhere. 
PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP:
Teach Me Surgery offers premium membership via an in-app subscription. Premium membership grants cross-platform, advert-free access to bespoke 3D surgical anatomy models and the full surgical question bank.
You can subscribe quarterly or annually and pay through your iTunes account. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your iTunes Account Settings any time after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. The subscription will renew at the same cost.
See our terms of service here: https://teachmesurgery.com/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00160119:ios.description:
EXERPRISE is the World’s first randomized workout & meal plan generator that uses advanced filtering technology to give you the best workout & meal plan possible within seconds completely customized for you to reach your goals & fit your lifestyle!
WORKOUT GENERATOR:
-Choose the muscle groups you want to work out
-Select the equipment you have
-Pick your workout preference of sets/reps or time intervals
-Decide workout length based on your time availability
-Hit Generate My Workout
-Within seconds, you will get a full optimal workout randomly generated for you based off your customized settings!
MEAL PLAN GENERATOR:
-Input your stats & we will determine your caloric maintenance
-Select your goal to establish your daily total calories
-Choose your macro percentages
-Decide how many meals per day you want to eat
-Hit Generate My Meals
-Within seconds, you will get a full optimal meal plan randomly generated for you based off your customized settings!
EXERPRISE will revolutionize the way you exercise & diet. No more excuses, no more wasted time, just results!
MUSCLE GROUP OPTIONS:
-Dynamic Warm Up Stretching: Upper Body, Lower Body, Low Impact Cardio
-Upper Body: Chest, Back, Traps, Shoulders, Triceps, Biceps, Forearms
-Lower Body: Legs, Calves, Glutes/Hips
-Core: Lower Abs, Middle Abs, Upper Abs, Obliques
-Cardio
-Static Cool Down Stretching: Upper Body, Lower Body
EQUIPMENT OPTIONS:
-Main: Bodyweight, Dumbbell, Barbell, Resistance Band, Kettlebell, Cable, Medicine Ball, Machine
-Extras: Flat Bench, Incline Bench, Decline Bench, Pull Up Bar
WORKOUT SUMMARY:
-Overview of exercises with pictures & videos
-Alternative exercise button to switch things up
-Re-order exercises & muscle groups
-Combine muscle groups
-Form compound & supersets
-Change sets, reps, times, & rest periods
-Undo button to backtrack
-Save the workout
WORKOUT SCREEN:
-Follow along exercise videos
-Follow along timer
-Follow along vocal cues
-Log your weight
-Skip exercises or go back
-Pause the workout
-Showcase the exercise or set that is up next
-You Did It display at the end of the workout with another option to save!
PROGRAMS:
-30 day workout plans
-Randomizer button providing all new exercises following the same program frequency
-Built in progression to guarantee result!
SMART TIMER:
-Stopwatch timer
-Customizable interval timer
-Tabata timer
-Customizable tempo timer
-Save your timers!
EXERCISE LIBRARY:
-Over 1000 exercises in our database
-Home based exercises
-Gym based exercises
-Videos for every exercise
-Progress tracking graphs with detailed workout stats
-Navigational scroller by muscle group
-Search
FOOD LIBRARY:
-Recipes & pictures for every meal
-Nutrition info
-Cooking time
-Ingredients
-Step by step meal prep instructions
-Allergen free options
-Navigational scroller by type of meal
-Search function
MEAL SUMMARY:
-Overview of meals with pictures & recipes
-Alternative meal button to switch things up
-Displays calories, macros, & serving sizes
-Showcases comparisons between total calories & macros generated with goals
-Save the meal plan!
Exerprise integrates with the Health app to access & update workout data.

مدرب ذكي (AI) - مسح الأكل بالصورة - تمارين منزلية - حساب سعرات - خطط دايت مخصصة - تصحيح فوري للوضعيات - وصفات صحية.
تطبيق "مِران" هو تجربة لياقة ثورية تجم
bluejetty:00123526:ios.description:
احصل على أفضل أداء رياضي وصحة متكاملة مع تطبيق مِران، رفيقك الصحي الأول في السعودية:
مدرب ذكي (AI) - مسح الأكل بالصورة - تمارين منزلية - حساب سعرات - خطط دايت مخصصة - تصحيح فوري للوضعيات - وصفات صحية.
تطبيق "مِران" هو تجربة لياقة ثورية تجمع بين قوة الذكاء الاصطناعي، وخطط التمارين الشخصية، والتتبع الغذائي الدقيق، ليقدم لك كل ما تحتاجه لتحقيق أهدافك الصحية والرياضية بكفاءة لا مثيل لها. تمرّن بذكاء أكبر، وليس بجهد أعلى فقط.
مميزات تطبيق مِران:
مدربك الشخصي الذكي (AI Trainer):
تصحيح فوري للوضعيات: يساعدك مدربك الذكي على تحسين وضعيتك أثناء التمرين عبر الكاميرا، لضمان أقصى استفادة وأداء أفضل.
تتبع آلي للتمارين: يقوم المدرب الذكي بعدّ كل تكرار وكل جولة تقوم بها تلقائيًا، ويسجل تقدمك بدقة فائقة.
تحديات ذكاء اصطناعي: اختبر حدود لياقتك مع تحديات فريدة تتكيف مع مستواك وتدفعك للتطور.
تمارين رياضية متنوعة وذكية:
تمارين منزلية: سهلة وفعالة بدون أجهزة لتحقيق وقت لياقة مثالي في أي مكان.
برامج متنوعة: للمبتدئين والمحترفين مع خطوات تمارين واضحة ومدعومة بإرشادات المدرب الذكي.
تمارين حرق الدهون: برامج متقدمة مصممة بالذكاء الاصطناعي لزيادة حرق الدهون وتخسيس الوزن.
خطط موجهة للأهداف: برامج متخصصة لإدارة الوزن، تقوية الجسم، تحسين القوام، وتمارين داعمة تساعدك في فترة التعافي.
تطبيق دايت وتغذية متكامل:
مسح الوجبات بالذكاء الاصطناعي: صوّر صحنك، ومِران يحلّله ويحسب سعراته وعناصره الغذائية فوراً — حتى الأكل السعودي.
مسح باركود المنتجات: امسح أي منتج واحصل على سعراته ومعلوماته الغذائية فوراً.
حساب السعرات الحرارية: تسجيل وجباتك بسهولة مع حاسبة السعرات الحرارية لتتبع دقيق.
دايت: أنظمة غذائية مخصصة لتخسيس الوزن والحفاظ على رشاقتك، تتكيف مع احتياجاتك.
وصفات صحية: مكتبة متجددة من الوصفات اللذيذة ومنخفضة السعرات.
يوميات طعام شاملة: سجل وجباتك (فطور، غداء، عشاء، وسناكات) وراقب تقدمك بسهولة.
سهولة الاستخدام:
تطبيق التمارين: سهل الاستخدام ويحتوي على جدول تمارين واضح ومنظم.
برنامج رياضي: خطط مرنة وفعالة لتحقيق أهدافك، يمكنك بناؤها بنفسك أو الاعتماد على توصيات الذكاء الاصطناعي.
حمّل تطبيق مِران الآن وأطلق العنان لقدراتك مع مدربك الذكي!

bluejetty:00173627:ios.summary: FAITH is committed to serving as a unique and elegant HOLY BIBLE study companion and prayer tool, enhancing your lifestyle focused on pray. You can read scriptures with in-depth interpretation for each Bible verse, listen to the audio bible
bluejetty:00173627:ios.description:
FAITH is committed to serving as a unique and elegant HOLY BIBLE study companion and prayer tool, enhancing your lifestyle focused on pray. You can read scriptures with in-depth interpretation for each Bible verse, listen to the audio bible, receive daily verse to deepen your faith, talk to pastors 24/7, and use our meticulously designed daily prayer and meditation tools to pray and meditate with intention.
STUDY HOLY BIBLE
* FREE Access to multi-language Bible, like KJV,RVR,LUT,LSG,ARC,CUV and more. We are actively adding more Bible versions to support Christians globally and spread the Gospel.
* Biblical Interpretation: Each Bible verse comes with insightful explanation, guiding us to explore God's divine purpose, and study bible & pray efficiently.
* FREE Audio Bible: Listen to audio Bible anytime, empowering your faith journey. A well-designed countdown timer can be set down before sleep.
* Parallel Bible Reading：Freely choose versions of the Bible for side-by-side comparison, beneficial for bilingual learners or those delving deeper into Bible reference.
* Offline Bible Reading: Allows to get closer to God and learn scriptures without internet access.
* Video Share:Easily create personalized scripture videos for free, featuring handpicked images and prayer music in just 1 second, and share the prayer via multiple platforms.
* Search the Holy Bible,and your favorite Biblical Interpretations, Notes, Marks, Bookmarks with keywords.
* Easy reading: Immersive Reading Mode, Color palette, Fonts, etc.
DAILY DEVOTION & PRAY
* Daily Verse: Receive Daily Bible verse to inspire your faith and pray every day.
* Morning & Night Prayer: Receive daily inspiration and engage in prayer through Scripture.
* Devotional: Discover daily devotional crafted by christian pastors worldwide, rooted in bible verses.
* Gospel: Enjoy daily, artistically designed Bible posters that convey the Gospel's message with visual elegance.
* Pray anytime：Set prayer reminders, pray anywhere and pray for whoever. Daily prayer enrichs your faith journey.
TALK TO PASTOR
13 Christian Pastors with different experiences are 24/7 available to answer your questions, including Bible Chat, relationship issues, moral dilemmas, etc.Bible Chat can deepen understanding.
PRAY & MEDITATION
* Write Prayer: Submit your prayer requests to the pastors, receive a personalized prayer, and begin praying immediately.
* Get your Prayer: On Today Page, share your understanding of the scripture or just your emotions today, and you'll get a tailored prayer to start with.
* Payer Tool: Once click 'Start Praying', you'll be directed to a carefully designed prayer tool page. Your prayer will be clearly displayed on the screen, with dozens of prayer music tracks and multiple atmospheric background images for you to choose from.
* Meditation Tool: Click on the blank area of the Prayer page to transform it into a fully immersive interface without any text. The prayer music will play continuously, allowing you to engage in personal prayer or meditation.
Crafted to inspire daily pray moments, FAITH integrates pray with daily verses. Engage in pray focused Bible chat receive guidance to pray and explore pray tools for every part of your day. With Faith, find a holy space to study bible and pray，deepening God connection through each pray!

bluejetty:00087342:ios.name: Wedding Planner & Invitations
bluejetty:00087342:ios.summary: Congratulations on your engagement! One of the happiest stretches of your life is ahead. And one of the busiest. The app takes on the busy part: everything that usually scatters across notes, group chats and spreadsheets lives here instead,
bluejetty:00087342:ios.description:
Congratulations on your engagement! One of the happiest stretches of your life is ahead. And one of the busiest. The app takes on the busy part: everything that usually scatters across notes, group chats and spreadsheets lives here instead, where none of it gets lost.
INVITATIONS AND YOUR WEDDING WEBSITE
Pick a template, add your photos, your names and the running order for the day, and you have a page your guests can open from a link. There is nothing for them to download.
Guests reply inside the invitation: whether they're coming, who they're bringing, what they eat and drink, whether they need a lift and where they're staying. You watch the answers arrive instead of collecting them out of a dozen chats.
If the date or the venue changes, fix it once. Every guest's copy updates itself, and there is nothing to send again.
GUEST LIST
Who's invited, who's said yes, who's declined, all on one screen. Sort guests into groups: family, the groom's friends, the bridesmaids. Everyone gets a card with contact details, dietary notes and a plus-one.
CHECKLIST
A ready-made plan laid out by time: a year out, six months out, a month out, and the wedding day itself. Every task comes with a line on why it matters and when to start it. Edit it freely, because no two weddings are the same.
BUDGET
Costs by category, planned vs actual, marked as paid. At any point you can see what you've spent and what you have left.
SEATING
Arrange the tables, seat your guests, print the place cards. Share the finished plan with your planner and the venue manager, or export it as a PDF.
STYLE AND PALETTE
If you don't have a look yet, build one here. Choose a style, pick your colors, gather ideas on a mood board and see how they sit together.
WEDDING PHOTO ALBUM
Collect your guests' photos in one gallery: put a QR code on the tables, and guests upload straight from their phones with nothing to install. The shots appear in your album as they happen.
BRIDE CHAT
A community of couples planning their weddings right now. Ask questions, recommend vendors and borrow ideas from other couples' experience.
DRINKS CALCULATOR
Work out how many drinks to order for the reception, so you neither overspend nor run dry halfway through the evening.
COUNTDOWN WIDGET
Put a wedding countdown widget on your home screen and watch the days tick down. Pick the background, the colors and the layout.
VENDORS AND VENUE
Keep every vendor in one place: venue, caterer, photographer, florist, band and host. Store contacts, quotes and what you have agreed, and mark who is booked and who you still need to choose.
TOGETHER
Plan as a couple or as a team: both of you, the bridesmaids, your planner. Everyone sees every change straight away.
AND MORE
Wedding day timeline, banquet menu, playlist, guest book and gift list.
SUPPORT
Write to us any time. A real person answers, usually within the hour. And if something is missing, say so: a lot of what is here arrived because a couple asked for it.
WHAT IT COSTS
Start free, no card required. The trial opens everything up. After that, stay on the free version or unlock a paid pack.
It isn't a subscription. No auto-renewal, no repeat charge: you pay once through the App Store, and it lasts the whole engagement plus a month after the wedding.
Download Wedding Planner & Invitations and start today: calmly, without the rush, and actually enjoying it.

bluejetty:00186062:ios.name: Weeklie: Class Timetable
bluejetty:00186062:ios.summary:
Still writing your class schedule in a notebook and forgetting when homework is due?
Weeklie puts your whole week on your phone — and on your Home Screen, your Apple Watch and Siri. Set it up once and it keeps showing the right week on its
bluejetty:00186062:ios.description:
Still writing your class schedule in a notebook and forgetting when homework is due?
Weeklie puts your whole week on your phone — and on your Home Screen, your Apple Watch and Siri. Set it up once and it keeps showing the right week on its own.
With Weeklie you can:
- Keep your class schedule one tap away
- Track homework, due dates and what's already done
- Get reminders before class and before an assignment is due
- Set up alternating weeks — A/B, or any cycle up to 4 weeks
- Attach photos and files to an assignment — snap a picture of the worksheet and it stays with it
- See today's classes in a Home Screen widget, without opening the app
- Check your next class on Apple Watch, or just ask Siri
- Share your schedule with classmates by file or share code
Who Weeklie is for:
- Middle school and high school students
Too much homework to keep straight? Save every assignment with its due date and Weeklie reminds you when it's time to start. It fits any bell schedule, including rotating days and block scheduling.
- College and university students
Weeklie is built for a schedule that changes week to week. Enter your courses, professors and room numbers once, and the app tracks which week you're in. Then share your semester schedule with classmates in a couple of taps.
Why students pick Weeklie:
- Works offline, no account needed — your schedule lives on your device. No sign-up, no email, and nothing stops working when you lose signal.
- Fast to set up — a usable timetable in a few minutes, not a whole evening.
- Alternating weeks done right — up to 4 recurring weeks, so an A/B or four-week rotation stays correct all year.
- A real Home Screen widget — today's classes at a glance, no app to open.
- Reminders that make sense — a heads-up before class starts and before homework is due.
- Apple Watch and Siri — glance at your wrist, or say "What is my next class in Weeklie".
Weeklie replaces the paper planner for school, college and university: class schedule, homework tracker and reminders in one app.
Reminders and homework attachments come with a one-time upgrade — pay once and keep it, no subscription.
Questions or suggestions? Get in touch at: https://weeklytimetable.app

bluejetty:00021342:ios.description:
Lookup flange, pipe, and bolt data in seconds with Flange Bolt Chart.
All data is available offline, lookups are instantaneous. 
Here's just a sample of the available data.
Flange bolting data:
1. Number of bolts
2. Diameter of bolts
3. Length of bolts
4. Wrench size
5. Torque pattern
6. Target torque
Flange dimensions data:
1. Outside diameter of flange
2. Flange thickness
3. Diameter of bolt circle
4. Flange weight
Pipe data:
1. Outside diameter
2. Wall thickness
3. Schedule
4. Weight
5. Weight with liquid
Gasket data:
1. Gasket inside diameter
2. Gasket outside diameter
3. Spiral wound dimensions
4. Type R ring dimensions
And many more fields.
All values are calculated or sourced directly from official standards like ASME B16.5 "Pipe Flanges and Flanged Fittings: NPS 1/2 through NPS 24 Metric/Inch Standard".
Looking up flange, pipe, and bolt data with Flange Bolt Chart is far faster and less error prone than searching through PDF charts and tables. The sole purpose of the tool is to make it as simple as possible for pipefitters, steamfitters, and others working in piping to look up piping information like flange bolt size and torque pattern.
Is there a feature you'd like from Flange Bolt Chart that you don't see? Request it through the app and we'll do our best to add it to the development schedule.
Features of the app:
1. Full offline capability: No internet connection necessary to use. All data is stored locally on your phone. (The app requires minimum storage space overall)
2. Instant data lookups. Just enter the necessary inputs (like nominal pipe size and flange class) and the app instantly populates the correct values for the flange, pipe, or bolt outputs you’re searching for.
3. Flange torque sequence images: Includes the full list of torque sequences in picture form, with the studs numbered.
The information in this app covers, but is not limited to:
(1) flanges with rating class designations 150, 300, 400, 600, 900, and 1500 in sizes NPS 1/2 through NPS 60 and flanges with rating class designation 2500 in sizes NPS 1/2 through NPS 12, with requirements given in U.S. Customary units with diameter of bolts and flange bolt holes expressed in inch units;
(2) flanged fittings with rating class designation 150 and 300 in sizes NPS 1/2 through NPS 60, with requirements given in U.S. Customary units with diameter of bolts and flange bolt holes expressed in inch units;
(3) flanged fittings with rating class designation 400, 600, 900, and 1500 in sizes NPS 1/2 through NPS 60 and flanged fittings with rating class designation 2500 in sizes NPS 1/2 through NPS 12 in U.S. Customary units.
Covers 4 bolt to 60 bolt sequences.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00140578:ios.description:
Start your journey of discovery with the new Shangri-La Circle App – your connection to the world of Shangri-La. It’s your one-stop for daily inspiration, elevated experiences, and endless possibilities to help you live the good life, the way you like it… afterall life isn’t meant to be square.
MORE INSPIRATION
It’s a big world with so much to see and do. Let us point you in the right direction with travel destination ideas, lifestyle inspiration and exclusive offers to get you started. Plan your next getaway, your next bite or next purchase from Shangri-La Boutique, and all with a just a few simple swipes or taps. 
MORE FLEXIBILITY
Pay for your bookings with Cash, Points or both. No complicated conversion rates to calculate. No black out dates. No confusion. You’ll be ready to go in no time.
Check-in to your hotel from anywhere with Mobile Check-in. Never miss a thing by adding your reservation to your Apple Wallet and calendar. View weather forecast and taxi card and request local customer support 24/7 all on the app.
MORE SIMPLICITY
Keep track of your journey with us from anywhere, at any time. Always know how many Points you’ve earned, and with a fixed Points redemption rate of 15 Points to US$1 on Shangri-La Products & Services, you’ll always know how much they’re worth, and how close you are to redeeming wonderful experiences. 
MORE RECOGNITION
We recognise and reward you for every moment you spend with us. Earn towards status upgrades whether you are staying, dining or shopping at over 100 Shangri-La, Kerry, JEN or Traders Hotels & Resorts worldwide. 
MORE PRIVILEGES
You’ll always enjoy something extra as a member. Be the first to get access to exclusive member rates and the best deals, right here on the app. 
MORE FLAVOURS
Explore the diverse and delicious flavours of Shangri-La restaurants around the world and close to home. Search by dish, cuisine, city, restaurant or hotel.

bluejetty:00027498:ios.name: SotoMethod On Demand
bluejetty:00027498:ios.summary: The Soto Method is a mix of cardio and sculpting movements designed to maximize burn and efficiently deliver a full-body workout. We fire up each muscle group with a 60-second isometric hold; then we sustain that burn through a series of dy
bluejetty:00027498:ios.description:
The Soto Method is a mix of cardio and sculpting movements designed to maximize burn and efficiently deliver a full-body workout. We fire up each muscle group with a 60-second isometric hold; then we sustain that burn through a series of dynamic movements. And we move on.
Light it up. Let it burn. Keep going. 
That same isometric hold becomes your active recovery. We optimize your time through intentional transitions: as one muscle recovers, the next one ignites. 
Soto is an inclusive space for people of all backgrounds and fitness levels to build strength and endurance. It is a time-based practice that taps into our mental fortitude. Holding on for just one more second serves as a powerful physical reminder of your agency. It becomes a tangible feeling that you can carry into your life and rekindle when you need it most.
Workouts:
Four new workouts published every Monday
250+ videos available
Workouts ranging from 5 to 45 minutes
No equipment required, but if you want to turn up the burn we use 1-5lbs hand-weights along with resistance bands.
No internet? No problem. Download any video for offline viewing. 
The obsession with Soto is real - see and feel for yourself the difference. You just have to try it. Start your free trial today!
To access all features and content you can subscribe to SotoMethod On Demand on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://sotomethod.vhx.tv/tos
Privacy Policy: https://sotomethod.vhx.tv/privacy

bluejetty:00063615:ios.description:
Get ready for one of the best FPS Non-Stop Action filled sniper shooting games on mobile! Download this offline and free zombie war game now!
Time to gear up and enter the apocalypse wasteland world of Last Hope. Zombies, raiders and vicious deadly enemies roam the wasteland throughout the world. Rescue survivors and kill to stay alive, only you can save the world in this story-driven first-person shooter game.
You and your arsenal of sniper rifles, assault rifles, handguns and a whole lot of epic skills, including grenades and rocket launchers, is what stands between the last survivors and a full-blown pandemic zombie virus outbreak.
Ready yourself, aim in on your target and fire your weapon to prove that you are the best sniper in the shooting games genre. Kill zombies and fight your way through this Non-Stop Action Zombie FPS apocalypse world.
Awesome Features;
- Immersive story-based missions: More than 150+ missions and new ones are added all the time!
- Rich and detailed environments: The city has become your battlefield! In this war you need to fight to protect your friends and family in a large variety of different locations.
- Realistic death and impact animations: See your enemies get blown away and come crashing down on cars, barrels or straight down in the pavement!
- Collect skill cards from valuable crates: More than 25+ skills and new ones added all the time! Rocket launcher, shock bullet, poison grenades, missile strike and power shield just to name a few.
- Upgradeable zombie killing weapons: When the apocalypse is at your doorstep you'll need powerful weapons to stand against it! 
- Kill shot camera: Follow the sniper bullet as it travels towards your kill. Get a close up look at your handiwork as the skilled marksman that you are!
- Ready. Aim. Fire! Easy and intuitive controls: Be the best sniper you can be without the game holding you back!
- Offline Game: Don't stop playing just because the internet went down. Play offline and enjoy this FPS game anytime and anywhere!
If you love shooting games, don't hesitate to download this Non-Stop Action FPS now and play both offline and for free!
We're an Indie game studio that listens to our players and aims to make this the best first-person shooter game possible! We'll continue to update the game and add even more exciting content!

bluejetty:00165244:ios.summary: Elevate your fitness journey with our revolutionary workout tracker app, now enhanced with cutting-edge AI technology to personalize and optimize your training experience. Designed for both fitness aficionados and professional trainers, thi
bluejetty:00165244:ios.description:
Elevate your fitness journey with our revolutionary workout tracker app, now enhanced with cutting-edge AI technology to personalize and optimize your training experience. Designed for both fitness aficionados and professional trainers, this app is your ultimate digital companion, offering intelligent insights and support every step of the way.
Key Features:
- Comprehensive Workout Tracking: Dive into an extensive array of exercises and routines. Whether you're at the gym, home, or outdoors, our app records every rep, set, and cardio session, offering detailed insights into your performance and progress.
- Real-Time Progress Monitoring: Witness your fitness evolution with dynamic tracking. Visualize your advancements through graphs and stats, compare your performance over time, and set new benchmarks to strive for.
- Apple Watch Integration: Experience the convenience of tracking your workouts directly from your wrist. Our app seamlessly syncs with the Apple Watch, ensuring your fitness data is always up-to-date, accessible, and accurate.
- Customizable Workouts: Tailor your training to fit your goals and preferences. With our intuitive interface, you can craft and modify your workout routines, making every session as effective and enjoyable as possible.
- Trainer & Trainee Collaboration: Revolutionize the way you train with a unique sharing feature. Personal trainers can effortlessly create and dispatch workout plans to their trainees, ensuring personalized guidance and motivation. Trainees can receive, execute, and feedback on these plans, fostering a collaborative and supportive training environment.
- AI-Powered Personalization: Experience a training program that adapts to you. Our AI analyzes your performance, goals, and preferences to tailor workout plans that evolve as you progress, ensuring maximum efficiency and engagement.
- Expert Tips & Insights: Elevate your training with valuable insights from fitness experts. Our app provides tips on form, nutrition, and recovery, ensuring you have the knowledge to train smarter and safer.
Why Choose Our Workout Tracker App?
- User-Friendly: Designed with simplicity and efficiency in mind, our app offers an intuitive user experience, making it easy for anyone to start tracking their fitness journey immediately.
- Versatile: Whether you're a seasoned athlete or just embarking on your fitness path, our app adapts to your level and needs, providing the tools and support necessary for every stage of your fitness journey.
- Innovative: Leveraging the latest technology, our app ensures your fitness tracking is precise, insightful, and conducive to achieving your personal best.
- Hyper-Personalized: Beyond generic training plans, our AI understands and adapts to your unique fitness journey, offering a truly personalized experience.
Embark on your fitness journey today with our workout tracker app. Maximize your potential, share your progress, and achieve your fitness goals together. Download now and transform your training experience!
Subscription pricing and terms:
Fleek subscription, "Fleek Pro"
"Fleek Pro" plans:
Monthly: $2.99
Annual: $23.99
Lifetime : $69.99
Payments and Renewal:
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Terms of use: https://fleek-landing.vercel.app/legal/tos
Privacy policy: https://fleek-landing.vercel.app/legal/privacy
- The app requires permission to use HealthKit to show the user's heart rate on apple watch app and write exercise time on apple health.
- Developer email : support@fleek.fit

THE HOME OF WESTERN SPORTS & ENTERTAINMENT
From the first gate to the final buzzer, Cowboy+ brings you closer to the action. Stream the biggest events in professional rodeo live, relive unforgettable moments on demand, and discover the athletes and stories that make Western sports unlike anything else.
LIVE RODEO, ALL YEAR LONG
Catch the biggest events in professional rodeo, including the National Finals Rodeo (NFR), Calgary Stampede, Cheyenne Frontier Days, Pendleton Round-Up, and more. Follow your favorite athletes and experience the excitement of professional rodeo wherever you are.
MISSED THE ACTION? CATCH UP ANYTIME.
From championship performances to unforgettable rides, relive your favorite rodeo moments with an extensive library of event replays and on-demand programming. The action doesn't stop when the event ends.

SEE THE SPORT DIFFERENTLY
Experience a new perspective on rodeo with AI-powered technology that brings real-time data, performance insights, and innovative visual overlays to the action.

A BETTER WAY TO WATCH
Enjoy the rodeo, Originals, and Western entertainment you love with a refreshed Cowboy+ experience, improved reliability, and easy access to live events and on-demand content across your favorite devices.
YOUR RODEO. YOUR WAY.
Whether you're following the road to Vegas or catching up on your favorite athletes, Cowboy+ keeps you connected to the best in Western sports and entertainment.
Download Cowboy+ and get closer to the action.

bluejetty:00149628:ios.description:
CURIOSITY ISN’T JUST FOR CHILDHOOD
Trade mindless scrolling for a few minutes of real curiosity and wonder. The Humane Space helps you turn curiosity into a relaxing daily ritual, with 2,000+ human-made discoveries designed to support greater well-being in just a few minutes a day.
RESEARCH-BACKED PATHWAYS TO WELL-BEING
The Humane Space draws on research-backed practices related to curiosity, awe, lifelong learning, guided visualization, reflection, walking, and nature connection. Research has associated these practices with outcomes such as increased well-being, lower stress, improved mood, creativity, focus, connection, and a greater sense of meaning.
WHAT YOU’LL FIND INSIDE
The Humane Space is designed for different moods, moments, and energy levels. You can read, listen, watch, walk, reflect, or try a short practice depending on what you need that day.
Immerse: Lifelong learning on 600+ topics from fungi to philosophy.
Deep Think: Thoughtful prompts to deepen awareness of yourself, others, and the world.
Lingo: Fascinating stories behind interesting words.
Mind Journeys®: Guided visualizations to ease stress and spark creativity.
Awe Walks: Relaxing guided walks to connect with your environment.
Soundscapes: Original calming audio for sleep, unwinding, focus, and rest.
CULTIVATE A CURIOUS MINDSET FOR EVERYDAY LIFE
Curiosity in Practice offers short guided exercises created with thoughtful guides, artists, writers, scientists, and experts. Each practice helps you see the familiar in a different way, notice more deeply, and bring curiosity into everyday life through simple 2–5 minute prompts.
Explore practices like awakening your creativity with a cartoonist, discovering the alchemy of color with an award-winning artist, connecting with trees alongside an ecologist, or reflecting on your personal myth with a mindfulness expert.
A MORE MEANINGFUL WAY TO SPEND A FEW MINUTES
Start your morning with reflection or discovery. Refresh your mind with a quick, energizing learning experience. Relax at night with soothing soundscapes or guided visualization. Bring curiosity into your morning routine, a walk, or time with friends and family. Fill idle time with something more nourishing than doomscrolling.
100% HUMAN-MADE AND HUMANE
Every discovery is created by real people: writers, artists, researchers, sound composers, voiceover artists, and thoughtful humans. No AI-generated filler. No ads interrupting your experience. No pressure-based engagement. No notification bombardment. No guilt-laden streaks.
Our goal is not to keep you hooked. It’s to give you a calmer, more enriching way to spend a few meaningful minutes each day.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Download The Humane Space and try it for free. Subscribe for unlimited access to our full library of discoveries and practices.
Premium access includes 2,000+ activities, the Daily Discovery, Curiosity in Practice, multimodal formats, curated collections across 600+ topics, and a calming, ad-free experience.
Pricing will be converted to your local currency. Subscriptions automatically renew and are charged to your mobile device’s subscription payment account unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage your subscription anytime in your device settings.
Apple: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Terms of service: https://www.thehumane.space/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.thehumane.space/privacy

Trade mindless scrolling for a few minutes of real curiosity and wonder. The Humane Space helps you turn curiosity into a relaxing daily ritual, with 2,000+ human-made discoveries designed to support greater well-being in just a few minutes a day.

RESEARCH-BACKED PATHWAYS TO WELL-BEING

The Humane Space draws on research-backed practices related to curiosity, awe, lifelong learning, guided visualization, reflection, walking, and nature connection. Research has associated these practices with outcomes such as increased well-being, lower stress, improved mood, creativity, focus, connection, and a greater sense of meaning.

WHAT YOU’LL FIND INSIDE

The Humane Space is designed for different moods, moments, and energy levels. You can read, listen, watch, walk, reflect, or try a short practice depending on what you need that day.

Immerse: Lifelong learning on 600+ topics from fungi to philosophy.
Deep Think: Thoughtful prompts to deepen awareness of yourself, others, and the world.
Lingo: Fascinating stories behind interesting words.
Mind Journeys®: Guided visualizations to ease stress and spark creativity.
Awe Walks: Relaxing guided walks to connect with your environment.
Soundscapes: Original calming audio for sleep, unwinding, focus, and rest.

CULTIVATE A CURIOUS MINDSET FOR EVERYDAY LIFE

Curiosity in Practice offers short guided exercises created with thoughtful guides, artists, writers, scientists, and experts. Each practice helps you see the familiar in a different way, notice more deeply, and bring curiosity into everyday life through simple 2–5 minute prompts.

Explore practices like awakening your creativity with a cartoonist, discovering the alchemy of color with an award-winning artist, connecting with trees alongside an ecologist, or reflecting on your personal myth with a mindfulness expert.

A MORE MEANINGFUL WAY TO SPEND A FEW MINUTES

Start your morning with reflection or discovery. Refresh your mind with a quick, energizing learning experience. Relax at night with soothing soundscapes or guided visualization. Bring curiosity into your morning routine, a walk, or time with friends and family. Fill idle time with something more nourishing than doomscrolling.

100% HUMAN-MADE AND HUMANE

Every discovery is created by real people: writers, artists, researchers, sound composers, voiceover artists, and thoughtful humans. No AI-generated filler. No ads interrupting your experience. No pressure-based engagement. No notification bombardment. No guilt-laden streaks.

Our goal is not to keep you hooked. It’s to give you a calmer, more enriching way to spend a few meaningful minutes each day.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

Download The Humane Space and try it for free. Subscribe for unlimited access to our full library of discoveries and practices.
Premium access includes 2,000+ activities, the Daily Discovery, Curiosity in Practice, multimodal formats, curated collections across 600+ topics, and a calming, ad-free experience.

Pricing will be converted to your local currency. Subscriptions automatically renew and are charged to your mobile device’s subscription payment account unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage your subscription anytime in your device settings.

Apple: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Terms of service: https://www.thehumane.space/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.thehumane.space/privacy

Download The Humane Space and turn curiosity into a daily ritual.

Find the best insurance that fits you with Getsafe! Buy insurance, manage your policies, file claims – it’s easy, fast and 100% digital. Over 500.000 customers already have found their ideal insurance match with Getsafe – now it’s your turn!
Why Getsafe?
Insurance redefined
Get more out of your insurance by being rewarded for what you do to protect yourself. Earn Safepoints to save on your premium payments. 
Top service at fair prices
We offer modern tech, personalised plans and fast support at fair prices. We make sure you’re well protected while also not spending more than you need to. 
All in one app
Binders full of paperwork are not our style: Find and buy insurance, manage policies, make claims and see your important documents – all from your smartphone.
100% in English
No German? No problem! Find insurance, get help, and manage claims all in English.
Flexible and personalised insurance
Things change. Your insurance needs to grow with you. Easily update your insurance anytime or extend your coverage with insurance add-ons for even more protection.
4.8/5 average advisor rating
Don’t want to spend hours comparing insurance? Our insurance experts can help you find the best solution. They’ve got a stellar rating of 4.8/5 from our existing customers! 
Fast support
Whether you’ve got a question or need help when something happens – we’re here for you. File a claim in the app – anytime, anywhere. We’ll handle the rest, so you can get on with your life. Our in-app chat is available 24/7.
Over 500,000 people trust us
We’re the insurer of choice for expats in Germany, and understand the unique challenges that come with living in Germany – and abroad too.
We’re regulated in Germany
Because our insurance is BaFin accredited and compliant, we’re held to high standards.
Tell your friends, get credit
Like Getsafe? Tell your friends and we’ll reward you with €30 in-app credit! Your friends will start with €15.
We’ve got what you need:
 - Liability insurance: A must-have to protect you from costs if you cause accidental damage or injure someone. 
 - Private pension insurance: Close the pension gap and be financially secure in your golden years.
 - Private health insurance: Set yourself up for the best medical care when you need it, personalise your policy and benefit from a wide range of services.
 - Pet Health insurance: Protects pets in the event of illness, injury, surgery or veterinary treatment.
 - Dog liability insurance: Be financially covered for damage caused by your dog.
 - Drone liability insurance: If you want your drone to take flight in Germany, this insurance is mandatory to have. 
 - Legal insurance: Covers the costs in the event of legal issues.
 - Income protection insurance: Protect yourself with a regular monthly income and financial security, even if health issues keep you from continuing in your current job.
 - Children's savings plan: Long-term investment plans to give your kids a head start once they hit adulthood.
 - Household contents insurance: Protects you against risks like fire, water or storm damage, break-ins or robbery.
 - Supplementary dental insurance: Covers expensive dental treatments not covered by public health insurance.
 - Term life insurance: Secure the financial stability of your loved ones in case the worst happens.
Data security
Keeping your data safe and secure is our top priority. Your data is always processed with the utmost care in compliance with data protection laws.

The world
bluejetty:00199994:ios.description:
OldView allows users to view historical images on their device from the exact location the photo was originally taken. It also allows users to contribute images to OldView to share immediately with friends, family and the world.
The world’s earliest surviving photograph was taken in France in 1827. Since then our perpetually changing world has been documented by countless photographs. It wasn’t until 1991 that Kodak unveiled the first commercially available digital camera. Some 164 years of hard-copy photographs.
In the 164 years after the invention of a camera, our world can be said to have dramatically changed more than the 164,000 years before it. bluejetty:00171771:ios.description:
Want to improve your performance in sports and eSports?
Just 3 minutes a day can improve your dynamic vision with simple eye training exercises.
Recommended not only for athletes, but also for students, professionals, and anyone concerned about eye fatigue or aging vision.
TRAIN YOUR EYES – GAIN THE EDGE
Dynamic vision is the key to success.
It determines how quickly and smoothly your eyes can follow moving targets — essential in ball sports like baseball, soccer (football), and tennis, in martial arts that require instant reactions, and in eSports where split-second decisions decide victory.
Dynamic vision depends on the extraocular muscles that move your eyes.
Just like body muscles, they can be strengthened at any age through consistent practice.
This app acts as your personal eye trainer, helping you strengthen eye movement, reaction speed, and focus.
◆ Exercises Included
• Teleportation – Train your eyes to track suddenly appearing objects
• Peripheral Vision – Expand your field of view and peripheral awareness
• Zigzag – Eye movement and diagonal tracking (DVA)
• Tile – Vertical and horizontal tracking (DVA)
• 3D – Kinetic visual acuity training (3D/KVA)
• Flash Memory Test – Improve focus, instantaneous vision, and short-term memory
• MOT Skills ◀NEW (Pro) – Advanced multi-object tracking to improve focus and reaction speed
Speed control is available — from extra-slow for beginners to ultra-fast for experts.
◆ User Voices
- “My reaction time in games improved a lot.” – Apex player, Japan
- “Perfect warm-up before sports practice.” – MtMan820, USA
- “Helps my eyes relax after long hours of screen work.” – Dirkalirk, USA
- “So much content for free. Great for daily basics.” – Tsurutontan37, Japan
◆ Pro Features
Free to start. Unlock full training power with Pro:
• MOT Skills – Master multi-object tracking
• Full Speed Control – From ultra-fast to extra-slow with custom settings
• Change Ball Colors (3D Mode)
• Remove All Ads – Train with zero distractions
• Family Sharing – One purchase covers your whole family
Free trial included — experience all Pro features before subscribing.
◆ Start Today
Consistent training won’t show instant results like muscle workouts,
but progress is guaranteed if you keep going.
Improving dynamic vision and reaction speed is the skill that separates winners from losers.
Use it as a warm-up before matches, for martial arts and ball games,
or as an Aim Trainer for FPS games.
It’s also helpful for improving focus for those who find it hard to concentrate (including ADHD tendencies).
Your personal eye trainer helps you build stronger vision habits – just 3 minutes a day to stay sharp and focused, and ahead.

bluejetty:00169921:ios.summary:
With all the features available today, AiCam is the perfect solution to your home security needs. Our app turns your unused iPhone or iPad into a smart home monitoring system that you can take with you anywhere.
AiCam's advanced machine le
bluejetty:00169921:ios.description:
With all the features available today, AiCam is the perfect solution to your home security needs. Our app turns your unused iPhone or iPad into a smart home monitoring system that you can take with you anywhere.
AiCam's advanced machine learning algorithms detect and recognize relevant objects and events so that you can be sure you'll receive notifications only when necessary. Whether you want to monitor your house for security reasons, keep an eye on the baby, check in on an elderly loved one, or watch over your pets, our app has got you covered.
When it comes to privacy, AiCam takes no chances. All video processing, detection, and recognition work takes place offline on your device so that your data stays private. We don't collect any information from our users, and the app requires an internet connection only if you want to save footage to iCloud or receive push notifications.
AiCam includes all the essential features of a standard surveillance camera and much more, including:
* Smart event detection that recognizes everything from people and animals to movements and sounds.
* Event history that lets you view saved footage by date and type of event.
* Live-streaming that allows you to see what's happening in real-time, trigger manual recordings, and switch between front and back camera.
* Integration with Apple Shortcuts app and Siri, so you can control AiCam with voice commands or schedule-based triggers.
* Powerful notification options that send alerts via push notifications or webhook requests.
Whether you're using AiCam to monitor your home, office, or anything in between, you'll love our app's various customization options. You can change the resolution of recorded videos, set minimum and maximum recording times, and choose whether to save footage locally or on iCloud. Additionally, our low-power mode ensures that the app consumes less energy and protects your battery in the long run.
Download our world-standard smart home monitoring application today and enjoy peace of mind like never before!
---
AiCam's features in detail:
Smart Event Detection:
* AI Image Recognition of Human, Cat, Dog, Bird, Bear, Vehicle
* AI Sound Recognition of Human Voice, Siren, Dog Bark, Baby Cry, Glass Breaking, Cat Meow, Water Running
* Device Motion Detection
* Camera Motion Detection
* Noise Detection
Event History:
* Store video locally on the device or your private iCloud account.
* View histories of detected events.
* Export recorded video to the Files app.
* Automatically remove local copies to save disk space.
* Filter histories by date and event type.
Live-Streaming:
* Stream live camera over Wi-Fi / 3G/ 4G / LTE to other phones or streaming platforms like YouTube, Twitch, ...
* Trigger manual video recording when viewing livestream.
Shortcuts:
* Use the Apple Shortcuts app to control AiCam based on triggers like time schedule or location.
* Turn on/off monitoring mode.
* Open camera using available capture devices (front, back, wide-angle, telephoto).
* Start recording video with a defined duration using any available capture device.
Notification:
* Send smart real-time alerts on event detection.
* Send webhook request on event detection. You can use this feature to trigger any service that supports receiving Webhook a request, like IFTTT or Zapier.
* Send a push notification when the battery level or device's thermal state changed.
Other features:
* Record video in different resolutions: 480p, 720p, 1080p, 4K.
* Tap to focus or tap & hold to lock camera focus.
* Low-power mode to reduce energy usage.
* Support any device orientation.
* Protect each screen with Touch ID/Face ID against unauthorized access.
Privacy Policy: https://www.ai-cam.app/app-privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.ai-cam.app/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00171678:android.name: Phantom Blade: Executioners
bluejetty:00171678:android.summary:
Phantom Blade: Executioners is a fast-paced action game set in the Phantom World, an original world conceptualized by S-GAME.
It features a rich storyline of kungfu adventures, where you dive into a conspiracy that threatens to topple the w
bluejetty:00171678:android.description:
Phantom Blade: Executioners is a fast-paced action game set in the Phantom World, an original world conceptualized by S-GAME.
It features a rich storyline of kungfu adventures, where you dive into a conspiracy that threatens to topple the world, cut down kungfu masters who have succumbed to insanity, and find out the mastermind following a series of seemingly independent incidents. 
Exhilarating, fast combat
Phantom Blade: Executioners celebrates the thrill of kungfu combat with the sheer pace of it. Just like in a good kungfu movie, you will often find yourself facing multiple opponents who just wouldn’t give a break. Dodge, parry, leap out of harm’s way, create an opening to deliver a torrent of lethal blows. Build up an expansive arsenal of kungfu moves and choreograph them into sequences that perfectly fit your own play style with the Combo Chain system, which is introduced to cut the need for excessive button-smashing or memorizing super long move lists. Explore and find your own niche!
Oriental art in modern glory
The stylish visual art of Phantom Blade: Executioners is based on Chinese traditional painting, augmented with modern sharpness and elements of fantasy. “Kungfupunk” is the name we coined for this approach, not unlike steampunk and cyberpunk. All combat animations are carefully crafted by prestigious studios under the leadership of Michael CTY, who had been the art director of Demon’s Souls and the first two titles in the Dark Souls trilogy before joining us to work on Phantom Blade: Executioners. 
Engaging Wuxia storyline
The world is falling apart as kungfu masters, one by one, gain enormous power overnight and somehow turn insane in the process. As you investigate, these seemingly independent cases appear to have a pattern. The clock is ticking. Take down the insane ones before any further damage is done, and stop the spreading of body-engineering technique known as Sha-Chi Mod!
Experience an authentic Chinese Wuxia story full of suspense told in episodes and branching side quests.

bluejetty:00046494:ios.description:
Get stronger, build muscle, lose weight, and stay consistent with FitPal: a simple workout tracker for strength training, gym logging, bodyweight workouts, cardio, and Apple Watch workout summaries.
FitPal helps you record every workout quickly and clearly, whether you train at the gym, at home, or outdoors. Track exercises, sets, weight, reps, volume, 1RM, calories, notes, photos, and body measurements in one focused fitness log.
FitPal is designed around a simple loop: record your training data, understand your progress, and use that data to train better. No unnecessary clutter, no complicated setup, just the tools you need to stay focused on your workouts.
FEATURES:
• Simple, clean, and easy-to-use workout tracking
• Apple Watch support: track workout duration, heart rate, and active calories, then sync summaries to iPhone
• More than 600 exercises, including strength training, bodyweight exercises, cardio, and stretching
• Detailed exercise instructions with animations
• Add custom exercises, cardio exercises, supersets, and your own training movements
• Build and manage your own workout routines
• Advanced workout statistics, including 1RM, total volume, reps, records, and progress trends
• Built-in body measurement tracker for weight and other body stats, with Apple Health support
• Add notes and photos to your workouts
• Cloud backup to keep your fitness data safe
• Supports Metric kg and Imperial lbs units
• Share workouts with friends using the system share sheet
FitPal is built for lifters, gym-goers, and fitness users who want a fast, reliable workout log for strength training, muscle gain, weight loss, body shaping, and long-term progress tracking.

Contact: bossa.lee@gmail.com

bluejetty:00062606:ios.description:
Learn English sayings and play for free with Sayings Master. Sayings Master is a fun and educational game of proverbs for students and native speakers of the most international language of all, English, that seek to practice English in an entertaining and simple way. 
Learning English is now easier and more fun than ever, regardless of your level: if you have a basic level or if you are the head of the English Department at a top school, Sayings Master will help you while you have a good time.
How to play? It’s easy, the game consists of putting the scrambled words in order to form a correct sentence.
If you make a mistake and click the English word in the incorrect order, there is a time penalty.
Once you have completed the sentence, you will receive a score based on how fast you were and your total number of errors.
You can share your knowledge with other players worldwide thanks to online multiplayer mode or with your friends on GameCenter.

bluejetty:00200045:ios.summary:
Learning herbal medicine can be challenging. The vast amount of information involved makes it time‑consuming, and selecting and administering the appropriate herbs can be difficult, even for experienced veterinarians.
This app is designed e
bluejetty:00200045:ios.description:
Learning herbal medicine can be challenging. The vast amount of information involved makes it time‑consuming, and selecting and administering the appropriate herbs can be difficult, even for experienced veterinarians.
This app is designed exclusively for licensed veterinarians who study and use herbal medicine in their daily practice. It provides detailed information on 174 of the most commonly used veterinary herbal formulas and supports efficient, confident clinical decision‑making.
Key Features:
 1. Portable access to 174 herbal formulas formulated specifically for veterinary use
 2. Comprehensive formula details, including ingredients and indications
 3. Quick formula selection using clinical conditions and/or Zang-Fu syndromes
 4. Search formulas using:
 ◦ Western/TCVM clinical indications
 ◦ Formula Name
 ◦ Formula Code 
 5. Thirteen articles about basic knowledge of Chinese Veterinary Medicine. 
This app is authored by Aituan Ma, DVM, PhD, and serves as a practical reference tool for veterinarians integrating herbal medicine into modern clinical practice.

Tu nuevo asistente inteligente Olivia está disponible 24/7 para ayudarte con todo lo que necesites: consulta movimientos, conoce información de productos financieros, levanta aclaraciones o revisa el motivo de rechazo de tu tarjeta.

- Préstamo de Nómina (2)

Retiro sin tarjeta y cobros QR

Designed for both those new to mental health practices and seasoned practitioners, Brain Fit Life offers a customizable experience to fit your lifestyle and brain type. Our goal is to help you build resilience, achieve your personal goals, and enhance your overall mental health.

- Gain expert knowledge from Dr. Amen on how to optimize your brain health.

- Move at your own pace, or receive guided private, secure support from an experienced brain health coach (available with paid subscription).

- Experience the 30-Day Happiness Course, designed to rewire your brain for joy.
- Strengthen your mind with Brain Games designed to enhance memory, problem-solving, and focus.
- Unlock brain-boosting exercises to eliminate Automatic Negative Thoughts (ANTs).
- Enjoy daily meditation, hypnosis, and brain-enhancing music.
- Track your progress and well-being with in-app brain health trackers.

- Science-Based Approach – Programs developed by licensed mental health professionals.

Endless Paper is a creative tool built around a truly infinite canvas. Write handwritten notes, create immersive artworks, explore ideas visually, and connect everyt
bluejetty:00062187:ios.description:
Endless Paper
An infinite canvas for thinking, drawing, and storytelling
Endless Paper is a creative tool built around a truly infinite canvas. Write handwritten notes, create immersive artworks, explore ideas visually, and connect everything in one continuous space.
Deliberately simple yet powerful and incredibly fast, it feels as natural as pen and paper—without the limitations of physical media.
Whether you’re a student organizing notes, an artist exploring large-scale compositions, or a team lead mapping out complex ideas, Endless Paper adapts to the way you think and communicate visually.
HIGHLIGHTS
• A truly infinite canvas
• Ultra-crisp, vector-based drawings at any zoom level
• Move, resize, and duplicate content using a powerful lasso tool
• Convert images into clean, zoomable vectors with vectorization
• Create vast canvases with minimal storage usage
• Export high-resolution images, PDFs, and videos with automatic zoom
• Publish your canvas as an interactive website
• Drag and drop images, PDFs, and even websites from other apps
• Adaptive bullet grid that responds to zoom level
• Bookmarks for fast navigation across large canvases
• Organize multiple canvases in a cohesive gallery with versioning
• Customizable color themes and dark mode
• Broadcast a live view of your canvas to the web
• Unlimited undo and redo
• Continuous autosave with an integrated archiving system
• Designed to minimize errors and cognitive load
• Powered by Fractile, a Metal-accelerated 64-bit vector rendering engine
DRAW BEYOND THE FRAME
Endless Paper enables a new form of long-format visual storytelling. Instead of isolated pages or panels, you create interconnected spaces that unfold through infinite zoom.
Explore canvases by professional artists directly in the app and discover what’s possible when scale is no longer a constraint. Build a lifetime of work into a single evolving universe—without compromising the tactile feeling of traditional drawing and painting.
A SPATIAL WHITEBOARD FOR COMPLEX THINKING
Never run out of space again. More importantly, Endless Paper lets you organize ideas spatially. Zoom into details, then pull back instantly to see the full structure of your work.

Endless Paper

An infinite canvas for thinking, drawing, and storytelling

Endless Paper is a creative tool built around a truly infinite canvas. Write handwritten notes, create immersive artworks, explore ideas visually, and connect everything in one continuous space.

Deliberately simple yet powerful and incredibly fast, it feels as natural as pen and paper—without the limitations of physical media.

Whether you’re a student organizing notes, an artist exploring large-scale compositions, or a team lead mapping out complex ideas, Endless Paper adapts to the way you think and communicate visually.

• Export high-resolution images, PDFs, and videos with automatic zoom

• Drag and drop images, PDFs, and even websites from other apps

• Bookmarks for fast navigation across large canvases
• Organize multiple canvases in a cohesive gallery with versioning
• Customizable color themes and dark mode
• Broadcast a live view of your canvas to the web

bluejetty:00133962:ios.description:
Immerse Yourself in a World of Passion and Suspense with Onmistory!
Welcome to a realm where hearts race, secrets unravel, and mysteries abound. Discover the ultimate destination for literary enthusiasts who crave the intricate dance of love stories and the adrenaline-pumping thrill of detective and thriller novels.
Love Stories to Stir Your Soul:
Embark on a journey through the intricate tapestries of love, where emotions run deep and connections ignite. From sweet romances that warm your heart to forbidden affairs that defy all odds, our vast collection of love story genres will leave you breathless and yearning for more.
Unravel Enigmatic Mysteries:
Are you ready to become the detective you've always admired? Delve into our selection of spine-tingling detective and thriller novels that will test your wits and keep you on the edge of your seat. Follow the clues, piece together the puzzle, and experience the rush of solving intricate mysteries that will leave you guessing until the very last page.
Features That Engage and Captivate:
Curated Collections: Our expertly curated lists bring you the best in love and mystery genres, ensuring you're always discovering fresh narratives that resonate.
Personalized Recommendations: Unearth hidden gems tailored to your preferences, thanks to our cutting-edge recommendation engine that understands your reading inclinations.
Seamless Reading Experience: Dive into stories with a clean, distraction-free reader that allows you to lose yourself in the narrative, page after captivating page.
Offline Access: Don't let anything interrupt your reading pleasure – download your favorites and enjoy them offline, wherever life takes you.
Whether you're a hopeless romantic seeking heartwarming connections or a cunning detective craving mind-bending puzzles, Onmistory is your gateway to an ever-expanding universe of love and intrigue. Elevate your reading experience today and let the stories transport you to realms you've only dreamed of.
Download now and unlock a world where passion and suspense intertwine with every swipe and tap. Your next literary adventure awaits!
Subscription pricing and terms:
Onmistory is free to download and use. If you upgrade to One year subscription, we offer yearly auto-renewing subscription and Lifetime purchase.
Payment is charged to your credit card through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renewal in iTunes Account Settings after purchase, or cancel your subscription at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period.

bluejetty:00028707:ios.description:
Spend Christmas in the glamorous Edwardian era for 25 days of seasonal fun. Now updated for 2025, you can download our digital Advent Calendar and experience the elegance of the 1920s at Christmas! 
Every day you’ll enter our fabulous Edwardian country mansion to discover a new surprise. Relax in the grand drawing-room, stroll through the extensive gardens, and watch the bustle below stairs as the domestic staff prepare the house for Christmas Day. You can also enjoy cosy Christmas games, interactive activities, fascinating books, and more when you download the Jacquie Lawson Advent Calendar!
IN OUR EDWARDIAN CHRISTMAS ADVENT CALENDAR
- Interactive main scene set in an English country estate, c.1910
- A grand drawing-room for you to decorate and enjoy
- Over 30 gifts to unwrap!
- A new animated story or other amusement every day
- 25 animals hidden in the scene, one to find each day
- A variety of books to curl up with
- Loads of fun Christmas games and seasonal activities
COSY CHRISTMAS GAMES
- Our brilliant Teddy Skiing game is back!
- Decorate your Christmas biscuits
- Set the table for a grand Christmas Dinner
- Spend a cosy afternoon with our jigsaw puzzles
- An assortment of memory games
- Two varieties of Patience/Solitaire – Spider and Klondike
- Challenge yourself with our Marble Solitaire game
- Plus, of course our popular Match Three and 10x10 games
FESTIVE ACTIVITIES
- Decorate the Christmas tree in the grand drawing-room
- The original version of our Snowflake Maker is back!
- Fun model train game
- Dress paper dolls in Edwardian costume
- Create your own needlework, wreath, or tapestry
- Make a beautiful flower arrangement
CHRISTMAS BOOKS
- A glimpse into Edwardian Christmas traditions
- A beautiful fine art book
- Fascinating stories behind each of the 25 daily animations
- Mouth-watering recipes from Edwardian times
DOWNLOAD YOUR ADVENT CALENDAR NOW
Here at Jacquie Lawson, we have been creating interactive digital Advent Calendars for 15 years now, and it’s become an unmissable Christmas tradition. Incorporating the wonderful art and music for which our ecards have become famous, it has become an unmissable part of the countdown to Christmas for thousands of families across the world. Download your Advent Calendar now.
WHAT IS AN ADVENT CALENDAR?
The traditional Advent Calendar is printed on cardboard, with little paper windows

bluejetty:00017067:ios.name: Rijksmuseum
bluejetty:00017067:ios.summary:
Free Multimedia Tours: discover more and easily find your way around
-Visit the museum your own way: follow a route or search for the numbers accompanying the works of art. Using interactive floor plans and directions, the app will take you
bluejetty:00017067:ios.description:
Free Multimedia Tours: discover more and easily find your way around
-Visit the museum your own way: follow a route or search for the numbers accompanying the works of art. Using interactive floor plans and directions, the app will take you to the start of the area or tour of your choice. During your tour, the app will take you from stop to stop.
- The tours: perfect for everyone! The aim is to see more. Each work has more layers: a 3D audio introduction clip and an animation that allows you to discover unique and surprising details about the collection. And for a number of works you can access additional commentary by inspiring experts and passionate enthusiasts.
Create your own route
Who knows best what you want to see in the museum? You of course! That is why we have made it even easier for you to create your own route with the app.
Under the For you button in the app you will now find the Make your own route option. This allows you to easily select which works you want to see in the museum. Do you prefer Vermeer, furniture or do you want to see works with cats? Just scroll through the categories and click on the work that you want to see. The app then gives you an ideal route and guides you from artwork to artwork. It is as simple as that!
Search
Find the route to an artwork or the closest toilet, café or shop.
10% discount with the app
Show your Rijksmuseum app in the giftshop and benefit from special offers
Tickets
Easily purchase tickets in the app, save them and scan them at the ticket checkpoint.
Information
By downloading this application you agree to the general terms and conditions which apply to the use of the Rijksmuseum app and the services provided via the app. You can read these on https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en/organisation/terms-and-conditions.
Feedback or questions? 
Send an email to teamonline@rijksmuseum.nl. 
Like the app? Leave a review in the app store. We would love to hear what you think!
Bring your headphones to the museum
If you want to use the app in the museum, be sure to bring your headphones. You can also purchase a headset at the museum for €1.50. 
Sponsor
The app has been made possible by KPN, a main sponsor of the Rijksmuseum.

bluejetty:00086994:ios.description:

No more opening ten tabs to ask: “What can I eat on a low FODMAP diet?”
No more boring restriction meals.
No more feeling like healthy eating has to be stressful.
Greeny brings together gut-friendly recipes, low FODMAP meal plans, mindful wellness tools, and nourishing food ideas designed for real life.
Whether you are starting a FODMAP elimination diet, looking for a 7 day low FODMAP meal plan, building an IBS friendly diet, or searching for healthy recipes that actually taste good, Greeny helps you move from confusion to clarity.
Use Greeny as your everyday low FODMAP diet guide: plan simple meals, explore IBS friendly food ideas, and feel more confident about what to eat during elimination, reintroduction, or long-term gut health support. From gentle breakfasts to satisfying dinners, Greeny helps turn a restrictive diet into something practical, varied, and enjoyable.
Inside Greeny, you can discover delicious recipes for different needs and lifestyles: low FODMAP, gluten-free, dairy-free, vegan, vegetarian, paleo, keto, whole grain, and more. Every recipe is created to make healthy eating feel inspiring, not punishing.
Greeny is especially helpful when you want to:
Find meals that feel safe for sensitive digestion
Create a low FODMAP diet plan without overthinking every ingredient
Explore IBS friendly recipes for breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, and desserts
Build a gentle meal plan for weight loss without crash dieting
Cook healthy food for one person, a family, or guests
Save favorite recipes and return to them quickly
Adjust serving sizes in seconds
Use ingredient replacements when you want to cook with what you already have
Stay inspired with new content and seasonal ideas
Support your mindset with daily affirmations and mindful wellness content
