That is why Greeny is built around a more mindful approach to healthy meal planning. Instead of pushing strict rules or making you feel guilty, Greeny helps you choose meals that support your body and your day.
If you are navigating IBS, bloating, gluten sensitivity, digestive discomfort, or the low FODMAP elimination phase, Greeny can help you feel less alone and more organized. You can explore low FODMAP diet ideas, gut health recipes, FODMAP friendly meals, and practical food inspiration without turning your kitchen into a medical spreadsheet.
If your goal is weight loss, Greeny helps you do it through nourishing recipes, balanced meal plans, and simple habits, not extreme restriction. You can eat food that feels light, satisfying, colorful, and enjoyable.
Greeny is for the person who wants to feel good after eating.
For the person who wants healthy recipes but still wants flavor.
For the person who wants a low FODMAP guide that feels beautiful, simple, and usable.
For the person who wants to take care of their gut without losing joy around food.

Search by ingredients

bluejetty:00087800:ios.description:
Lead your army to victory in Grunt Rush, a tactical strategy game built around fast decisions, smart control, and satisfying growth. Multiply your troops, take control of the map, and conquer enemy territory through nonstop battle.
Game Features:
- Strategic Command & Control: Plan your attacks, choose the right moments to engage, and keep tight control of your army as you push forward. Every move is part of your strategy, and every mistake can cost you the battle.
- Multiplier Tiles & Army Growth: Rush through multiplier tiles to grow your army fast. Turn a small squad into a huge force, then use that advantage to win the next battle and keep your strategy rolling.
- Raid & Conquer Enemy Bases: Deploy your troops, break through defenses, and conquer enemy bases. The better your control, the cleaner your battle wins, and the faster you dominate the map.
- Upgrade Your Army: Unlock and upgrade troops and armored vehicles. Customize your army for each map, adapt your strategy, and keep your control strong as the fights get tougher.
- Diverse Maps & Challenges: Explore new environments and face harder opponents. Change your strategy, maintain control, and conquer every map with smarter battle decisions.
- Offline Play: Enjoy the full game anytime, anywhere. No Wi-Fi? No problem, take control and keep your army moving offline.
Why Play Grunt Rush?
If you like strategy games with constant action, Grunt Rush delivers. Grow your army, take control of the battlefield, and win each battle by making the right calls. Multiply your troops, outplay enemy forces, and conquer bases to progress through increasingly intense levels.
Ready to Take Control?
Download Grunt Rush and jump into a tactical strategy game where your army, your control, and your decisions decide every battle. Build momentum, conquer the map, and prove your strategy under pressure.

bluejetty:00073134:ios.description:
The STIB-MIVB app is all you need to get around Brussels by metro, bus, tram or train. New: you can now purchase your tickets in the app. Click and go with the STIB-MIVB app 
Buy tickets and be on your way immediately
- Your ticket is immediately available in the app. Quick and easy!
- You can buy your tickets whenever and wherever you want. This way, you always have a ticket in your pocket.
- You can purchase Brupass (XL) 1 or 10 journeys via the app. If you take public transport every now and then, buying a 10 journey ticket is a tad cheaper. How nice is that?
Stay tuned
- Keep up to date with the app: you'll find real-time info not only on the STIB-MIVB network, but also on SNCB-NMBS trains and TEC and De Lijn buses. So you always know when to leave!
- Save your favourite lines and stops and find your way around the app and Brussels even more easily. 
Find the route that suits you best
- Plan your journey from A to Z and choose your own departure date and time.
- The interactive map also indicates De Lijn, SNCB-NMBS and TEC stops with real-time departure times. Never miss a connection again.
- The shortest route, with the fewest connections or the least amount of walking? You're in control of your preferences.
Reload and consult your MOBIB card
- Connect your MOBIB card to the app and see how many journeys you have left or how long your season ticket is still valid.
- Whether you have a season ticket or a ticket, you can simply reload your MOBIB card via the app. Please note that it will take at least 24 hours before your ticket or season ticket is available on your MOBIB card.
Travel smoothly
- Would you like to know in advance whether the escalator or lift is working? Via the "Info" tab, you can see in real time how accessible the station is.
- For buses and tram lines 7 and 9, the app tells you the degree to which a stop is accessible.
Download the STIB-MIVB app now and enjoy worry-free travel in and around Brussels!

bluejetty:00092526:ios.description:
fsbt1View is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with fsbt1View:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the fsbt1View app, you must be enrolled as a First State Bank & Trust Co Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00089491:ios.name: Nova Polkadot Wallet
bluejetty:00089491:ios.summary: Nova Wallet is next gen application for Polkadot and Kusama ecosystem. Nova aims to provide user-friendly access to Polkadot features, such as token transfers, staking, contribution to the parachain crowdloans. Nova prioritizes quality firs
bluejetty:00089491:ios.description:
Nova Wallet is next gen application for Polkadot and Kusama ecosystem. Nova aims to provide user-friendly access to Polkadot features, such as token transfers, staking, contribution to the parachain crowdloans. Nova prioritizes quality first, thus the app provides maximized security and performance for the users.
Nova Wallet is a decentralized and self-custodial app, therefore nobody has access to users' data (including accounts) except users themselves. Make sure to backup your account and store it privately, and never share it with anyone.
Participate in crowdloans of Polkadot and Kusama with no limits.
Nova Wallet supports the following tokens of the Polkadot ecosystem:
- Polkadot (DOT)
- Kusama (KSM)
- Moonriver (MOVR)
- Moonbeam (GLMR)
- Karura (KAR)
- Acala (ACA)
- Shiden (SDN)
- Astar (ASTR)
- Phala, Khala (PHA)
- KILT, KILT Spritnet (KILT)
- Bifrost (BNC)
- Calamari (KMA)
- Altair (AIR)
- Basilisk (BSX)
- Parallel Heiko (HKO)
- Parallel (PARA)
- QUARTZ (QTZ)
- Bit.Country Pioneer (NEER)
- Edgeware (EDG)
- Remark (RMRK)
- Karura USD (kUSD)
- Acala USD (aUSD)
- Kintsugi (KINT)
- Kintsugi Bitcoin (kBTC)
... and more, shaping a total of 50+ tokens of Polkadot & Kusama ecosystem supported
The app supports the dynamic addition of tokens, so as soon as there will be new network & token launched, it will be automatically added to your Nova Wallet
Nova Wallet supports Staking for:
- Polkadot (DOT)
- Kusama (KSM)
Nova Wallet is a community-oriented app without any restrictions or limits to the users. 
Join the Nova Wallet community!

bluejetty:00145728:ios.description:
RG Digital ES é o aplicativo oficial de identidade digital do Instituto de Identificação da Polícia Civil do Estado do Espírito Santo.
Agora você pode ter o seu RG Digital do Espírito Santo sempre disponível no seu dispositivo celular. RG Digital ES é um aplicativo gratuito que proporciona maior privacidade de dados, segurança e praticidade ao se identificar.
IMPORTANTE:
Para utilizar o RG Digital ES, verifique se a sua carteira de identidade possui Código QR na parte interna (disponível no RG impresso emitido a partir de 02/2014).
A versão digital através do RG Digital ES é válida em todo o território nacional e possui o mesmo valor jurídico da versão impressa.
Para a sua segurança, este aplicativo não pode ser utilizado em dois ou mais dispositivos ao mesmo tempo.
Confira os benefícios de se identificar no seu dia a dia através da versão digital:
Acesso ao seu RG Digital, independentemente de conectividade à internet, após a conclusão da primeira validação do documento;
Armazenamento e transporte das suas informações de identificação com maior segurança por meio de proteção biométrica e senha;
A versão digital dispensa cópia autenticada em cartório, uma vez que é válida assim como o documento impresso;
Identidade digital na palma da sua mão através do dispositivo celular para ter acesso a serviços de instituições públicas e privadas;
Inclusão e gerenciamento de documentos de identificação de filhos e dependentes no aplicativo;
Possibilidade de compartilhar cópia segura, assinada digitalmente com certificado digital, compatível e adequado aos padrões ICP-Brasil.
COMO UTILIZAR O RG DIGITAL:
Passo 1: Instale o aplicativo RG Digital ES no seu dispositivo celular. Para o primeiro acesso, é necessário ter em mãos a versão impressa emitida após fevereiro de 2014.
Passo 2: Identifique o Código QR na parte interna do seu RG impresso e siga as instruções para validação do código e verificação biométrica do seu rosto.
Passo 3: Pronto! Agora é só aguardar a confirmação dos seus dados.
Em poucos minutos, o seu RG Digital estará disponível no seu dispositivo celular para maior praticidade e segurança.
O RG Digital ES é um aplicativo oficial do Instituto de Identificação da Polícia Civil do Estado do Espírito Santo desenvolvido através da prestação de serviço pela empresa Valid.
Copyright: @VALID

Take green screen photos at up to 12 megapixel and video at UHD 4K resolution.  Edit video or photos already shot on green screen or blue screen with our video timeline editor. bluejetty:00140597:ios.name: Dustbunny: Emotions to Plants
bluejetty:00140597:ios.summary: Dustbunny is more than just an idle game; it’s a warm and relaxing journey that guides you in reconnecting with your repressed emotions. In this whimsical world, your emotions manifest as adorable creatures called Emotibuns, who love to hid
bluejetty:00140597:ios.description:
Dustbunny is more than just an idle game; it’s a warm and relaxing journey that guides you in reconnecting with your repressed emotions. In this whimsical world, your emotions manifest as adorable creatures called Emotibuns, who love to hide and need your help to express themselves. By catching these shy creatures, you can grow them into beautiful plants—some of which are extremely rare! Engage in fun interactions like watering, pest control, and even singing to your plants. Enjoy relaxing mini-games, such as catching bubbles in your bubble tea, all while transforming your room into a safe space where you may encounter your inner child.
There was always a void inside your mind, like a sinkhole. One day, you woke up inside the void. 
You find yourself in a dusty, abandoned room, greeted by a friendly bunny who seems to hold the keys to the secrets of the room.
There are some things you can do in this room.
⁕ Catch your repressed emotions ⁕
As you explore the dusty room, keep an eye out for Emotibuns—shy creatures that disguise themselves as dust bunnies. They represent your repressed emotions, such as sadness, anger, anxiety, loneliness, and emptiness. These creatures are quick, so stay alert! Once you catch and name an Emotibun, it will express its emotion and sprout into a unique plant, complete with an ID card to log your journey of care and growth.
⁕ Love your plants & yourself ⁕
What’s your love language? With over 20 ways to nurture your plants, you can use Care Cards for basic tasks like watering and pest control, as well as more personal actions like singing and writing to them. Each plant is one-of-a-kind, growing dynamically to communicate with you—it sparkles when healthy, droops when sick, and might even jump out of its pot! As you learn to care for your plants, remember to extend that love to yourself, too.
⁕ Collect rare plants ⁕
Each Emotibun transforms into a unique plant species, ranging from common varieties to the elusive unicorn plant. Challenge yourself to collect all the plants in the Plant Index, and discover rare genetic mutations called variegation that create unique leaf patterns. Advanced players can unlock abilities to create one-of-a-kind hybrid plants.
⁕ Befriend Empathy ⁕
You’ll be guided by Empathy, a friendly, winged bunny! Empathy offers daily affirmations and shares wisdom about emotions and self-love to help you on your journey.
⁕ Get cozy with nostalgic objects ⁕
Every object in your room is interactive! Enjoy mini-games with nostalgic items like bubble tea, plushies, and cup noodles. Some will help you relax, while others might surprise you!
⁕ Decorate your dream room ⁕
The in-game shop updates daily with adorable decor and furniture options. From Ghibli-inspired cottagecore to mid-century modern styles, create your dream room and share it with our community!
⁕ Complete your narrative ⁕
Uncover the story behind the room and the five emotions as you progress, leading you to discover your inner child.
Key Features
⁕ Name your Emotibuns and grow them into plants using over 20 care cards.
⁕ Experience unique plant growth—no two plants look the same, as they grow procedurally in 3D.
⁕ Collect over 30 popular and rare plants, including hybrid varieties.
⁕ Craft yummy treats for Emotibuns and compost for your plants, all from dust.
⁕ Interactive objects provide gentle focus and tactile stimulation for stress relief.
⁕ Journal your journey with stickers and Polaroid photos.
If you enjoy cute, cozy, and relaxing games like Animal Crossing, Stardew Valley, Unpacking, Cats & Soup, Hello Kitty Island Adventure, or other simulation games focused on farming, pets, plants, and mental health, you’ll fall in love with Dustbunny.
Questions? Contact us at info@dustbunnygame.com

With great power comes great fun! Defeat deadly enemies with the powers of a super hero. Lift, burn, freeze opponents who try to get in your way. No one will stop you from obtaining justice. Your team of heroes are here to save the day.
Solve challenging puzzles with unique abilities. Each level is carefully designed to maximize your abilities. Uses powers of control, fire, wind, ice, speed and much more! The Super league was formed to save the world. Use your skills, deadly accuracy and precision to keep the bad guys at bay! Whether it is a spy, agent, zombie, lumberjack, alien, or an evil mastermind they are all here to take over the world and only a SUPER can take them down and save the world.

So many enemies and levels for you to solve with your quick wit and big brain. Unlock new characters with new special abilities for a whole new take on new levels. How smart are you? Can you solve all the puzzles? 
3. New Challenges Await
New levels, new characters, secret missions. There are so many things you can do with The Superhero League. All you need to do is be part of the team.

Only the smartest and quickest can solve all the puzzles! You will need more than just accuracy to make it through. Speed, timing, cleverness and patience are all things you will need to become the ultimate hero. Can you get three stars on every level?

Are you the best out there? Help the heroes to defeat the villains and save the world! New recruits will be available. It’s all for you to control.
6. Wield awesome powers
Do you burn like a Phoenix. Can you manipulate time like the Void? Let it go by freezing enemies. This is the most unique puzzle experience you can play.

Four mod
bluejetty:00200025:ios.description:
Photograph star trails or stunning smooth waterfalls. Capture a meteor mid-streak or traffic with light trails. And clear, detailed photos where there’s barely any light at all. One-time purchase, no subscription.
ASTROPHOTOGRAPHY
Four modes that automatically set the camera up for you.
- Star Trails: watch the stars draw circles overhead
- Meteors: automatic capture of shooting stars
- ISS: the International Space Station passing over
- Stars: starry skies and the Milky Way
- New in version 10: Aurora, a time-lapse mode for the Northern and Southern Lights
LONG EXPOSURE
Hold the shutter open for seconds or minutes and movement becomes light.
- Long Exposure: motion blur, or a cleaner shot when you hold still
- Light Trails: traffic at night, fireworks, light painting

LOW LIGHT

- Light Boost
- Noise Reduction
- Night Mode video and timelapse
HANDHELD

MANUAL CONTROL
- Swipe to adjust exposure, ISO, focus and white balance
- Camera Control on iPhone 16 and later
- Zoom to 16x
- Black and white mode
Also includes an interval programmer, self-timer, and an Apple Watch app with live preview and remote control.

Hairdresser game is an interesting educational game in which you will manage his own beauty salon for the same young beauties. Each model in your salon desperately needs the help of a professional stylist. After visiting your salon they will become real princesses. Help the girls become real beauties: wear them, select hair colors, apply them full make-up to create a compelling image.

bluejetty:00144496:ios.description:
We have completely redeveloped the app. We have listened to feedback and have built an app that we are extremely proud of.
Here are some of the features we worked hard on: 
1. Offline capabilities. 
-Sightings will load offline.
-Pins on the map will load offline.
2. Push notifications
-You can set to get alerts of new sightings for all the parks you are interested in.
3. Light on data
-We have worked on making the app light on data, especially when you are in the park and using your data, and not using wifi.
Latest Sightings is an app where visitors to the app's supported nature safari parks (view list of parks at end of description) can share their wildlife sightings, in realtime, with other visitors in the game reserve and also to users world wide.
The app is a service to visitors on safari. This utility app notifies you of sightings in your area, so that you can go and check them out for yourself in real life. 
You never have to drive around the whole day seeing nothing, you can now see the magnificent big 5, such as the lion and leopard, everyday on your safari.
This is also the perfect app for wildlife lovers. Latest Sightings allows users to get their daily dose of nature, whether they are in the game park or not.

bluejetty:00121902:ios.description:
تطبيق إذاعات علوم القرآن الكريم وترجماته هو أحد التطبيقات التي طورتها لجنة الدعوة الإلكترونية التابعة لجمعية النجاة الخيرية بدولة الكويت.
أهداف التطبيق:
1- نشر القرآن الكريم إلى أكبر شريحة من الجمهور بمختلف ثقافاته؛
2- زيادة ارتباط المسلمين والمهتدين الجدد بالقرآن الكريم عن طريق الاستماع إليه في أي أماكن يذهبون إليها.
3- تعرف غير المسلمين على تعاليم القرآن الكريم السمحة من خلال ترجمة معانيه بلغاتهم.
الجمهور المستهدف:
1- غير المسلمين
2- المسلمين الجدد
3- المسلمين
ترجمات الإذاعات:
الإنجليزية والفرنسية والإسبانية والبرتغالية والألمانية والروسية والرومانية والبوسنية والصينية والكورية والفيتنامية والكردية والهندية والفلبينية والمالايالم والتلغو والتايلاندية واليونانية والسنهالية والبنغالية والألبانية والإندونيسية والكشميرية والإيغورية والأمازيغية ولغة الكانادا والمجرية والأورومية والتاميلية والأردية والصومالية والنيجيرية والمالاوية والفارسية والأمهرية ولغة اليوربا، إلخ.
بالإضافة إلى إذاعات بأصوات مشاهير القراء وإذاعات للقراءات المختلفة والفتاوى والتفسير.
https://quran-uni.com
الجوائز:
1- جائزة القمة المعلوماتية برعاية اليونيسكو -2016
2- المركز الأول في مجال الاحتواء الإلكتروني جائزة الكويت الإلكترونية التي تقدمها مؤسسة الكويت للتقدم العلمي – الدورة السادسة 2015-2016.
3- وسام الإبداع – المركز الثاني كأفضل تطبيق للأجهزة الذكية عن تطبيق إذاعات القرآن الكريم (مؤتمر الإبداع التقني في العمل الخيري، البحرين 2016)
4- أفضل موقع لخدمة القرآن الكريم في مبادرة "نون" بالتعاون مع برنامج "بالقرآن اهتديت" للشيخ فهد الكندري (موسم 2016)
Quran Radios is one of the Apps developed by the E-Da`wah Committee (EDC), owned by the Al-Najat Charity Society, Kuwait.
Objectives:
1- Spreading the Qur’an among as large audience as possible,
2- Cementing the relationship of Muslims and new Muslims with the Qur’an through listening to it anywhere they may go, and
3- Acquainting Non-Muslims with the tolerant teachings of the Qur’an through the translation of its meanings into their mother languages.
Available translations:
Arabic recitation by famous recisters, English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Russian, Romanian, Bosnian, Chinese, Korean, Vietnamese, Kurdish, Hindi, Tagalog, Malayalam, Telugu, Thai, Greek, Sinhalese, Bengali, Albanian, Indonesian, Kashmiri, Uyghur, Tamazight, Kannada, Hungarian, Oromo, Tamil, Urdu, Somali, Nigerian, Malay, Amharic, Yoruba, Persian, and more.
This is in addition to radios for the exegesis (tafsir) of the Qur’an by Al-Sharawi, Al-Sa`di (Arabic and Russian), Tafsir in Fulani, Tafsir in Amharic and one radio for the Fatwas of Ibn `Uthaymin.
Target Audience:
1- Non-Muslims
2- New Muslims
3- Muslims
https://quran-uni.com
Awards:
1. World Summit Award -2016
2. First Prize in Kuwait e-Content Award (Kuwait Foundation for the Advancement of Sciences) - 2015-2016 – E-Inclusion Category
3. Legion of Innovation (Charity Technology Innovation- Bahrain 2016)
4. Best Site Prize for serving the Quran – 2016

bluejetty:00123858:ios.name: DRAGON QUEST IV
bluejetty:00123858:ios.summary:
********************
Dragon Quest IV, the first instalment in the Zenithian Trilogy, is now out on mobile devices!
This epic adventure, unfolding over five unique chapters, each focusing on a different cast of characters, can now be enjoyed
bluejetty:00123858:ios.description:
********************
Dragon Quest IV, the first instalment in the Zenithian Trilogy, is now out on mobile devices!
This epic adventure, unfolding over five unique chapters, each focusing on a different cast of characters, can now be enjoyed on your iPhone, iPod touch or iPad! 
Experience the full epic game with over 40 hours of gameplay in one standalone package!
Download it once, and there’s nothing else to buy, and nothing else to download!
*In-game text is available in English only. 
********************
◆ Story
In the far-flung corners of the world, our heroes’ stories are about to unfold... 
Chapter 1: Ragnar McRyan and the Case of the Missing Children
Starring Ragnar McRyan, noble knight of bonnie Burland.
Chapter 2: Alena and the Journey to the Tourney
Starring Tsarevna Alena, tomboy princess, Kiryl the priest, her devoted follower, and Borya, the cantankerous conjurer who has watched over Alena since childhood.
Chapter 3: Torneko and the Extravagant Excavation
Starring Torneko Taloon, a weapon merchant chasing his lifelong dream.
Chapter 4: Meena and Maya and the Mahabala Mystery
Starring a pair of gifted sisters —Maya, the most alluring dancer in the entire world, and her fortune-telling sibling Meena—who will stop at nothing to avenge their father’s death.
Chapter 5: The Chosen
Starring a youthful hero destined to deliver the world from disaster.
At long last, the Chosen Ones, inseparably bound together by the thread of fate, set off to face their ultimate enemy!
◆ Game Features
・Party Talk
Chat with your loyal companions any time you like during your adventure!
They’ll tell you all kinds of interesting things, depending on where you are in the story, and what heroic feats you have accomplished!
・360-Degree Views
Rotate your viewpoint in towns and villages through a full 360 degrees to make sure you don’t miss a thing!
・Wagon Quest!
Once you have the wagon, you can take a team of up to ten companions around with you on your adventure, and swap them in and out of your party at will!
・AI Battles
Tired of giving orders? Your faithful companions can be instructed to fight automatically!
Use the various tactics at your disposal to see off even the toughest enemies with ease!
・The Casino
The old series favourite is back! Will you make a killing at the casino?
Try your luck at three fantastic games: slot machines, poker and monster battles!
・Chapter 6?
Experience an extra chapter past the ending and explore a challenging bonus dungeon. 
--------------------
[Supported Operating Systems]
iOS11.0 and above.
[Supported Devices]
iPhone 5S/iPod touch (6th Generation)/iPad (5th Generation) and above.

Crystal of Atlan is a Magicpunk MMO Action RPG where you can immerse yourself in a Magicpunk world, to combat, to build your skills, and to uncover the secrets with the team. 
Embark on a wondrous journey of Magic and Machinery!
- THE NEW
bluejetty:00116362:android.description:
Crystal of Atlan is a Magicpunk MMO Action RPG where you can immerse yourself in a Magicpunk world, to combat, to build your skills, and to uncover the secrets with the team. 
Embark on a wondrous journey of Magic and Machinery!
- THE NEW CLASS "INVENTOR" IS NOW AVAILABLE
Following the footsteps of a mysterious "mentor," the adorable Jodi has arrived at the City of Magitech! With her trusty wrench and a mind full of dreams, she is ready to leave her mark on this world! Empirical Innovation vs Rhapsodic Creativity! The brand-new base class "Inventor" is now available for pre-registration! Launching together with her class branches "Empirica" and "Rhapsodia" in March!
- LV.70 NOW AVAILABLE—BEGIN THE SANDSTORM JOURNEY
As Yudora goes AWOL, a series of events unfolds, revealing the secrets of the passed-down treasure known as the Kraken Key. Act now, before it's too late! New adventure stories and exploration areas await! Come experience the brand-new Lv.70 "Floating Settlement" story!
- 10+ CLASSES TO CHOOSE, COMBOS OF YOUR OWN
Five main classes, 15 class changes to choose from. All unlocked from the start, each with over 20 skill combinations, providing ample room for players to experiment.
- REFRESHING AIR COMBOS TO UNLOCK A NEW COMBAT STYLE
In addition to the X/Y axis focus of mainstream 3D games, you can experience combat on the Z-axis, offering a refined aerial combat experience that innovates the traditional MMORPG combat style.
- CHALLENGING TEAM BATTLES
You can experience various multiplayer elements, including co-op dungeons and a guild fleet system, allowing you to connect with like-minded friends. 
- THRILLING FAIR PVP SHOWDOWNS
Enjoy competitive PvP with 3v3 and 1v1 modes, where everything from attributes to skill damage/cooldowns is perfectly balanced. In this arena, it's all about skill to claim victory.
- A UNIQUE MAGICPUNK WORLD
Embark on an epic journey through a fantastical world where magic and technology intertwine. As a free-spirited adventurer, uncover the secrets of ancient Atlan ruins and confront powerful factions

bluejetty:00065503:ios.description:
The Anova family of precision cookers allows everyone to cook like a pro! Paired with the Anova Culinary app, now perfectly cooked restaurant quality meals are as easy as the touch of a button.
Browse the largest collection of sous vide recipes by Michelin star chefs and home cooks just like you. Then simply connect your cooker to the app and start, stop, and monitor your cook right from your mobile phone. Feeling inspired? Create and share your own recipes and go viral on the ‘gram. Whatever your pleasure, the Anova Culinary app is the place for everything sous vide. 
FEATURES
========
• LARGEST COLLECTION OF SOUS VIDE RECIPES: Access sous vide recipes created by Michelin star chefs and home cooks just like you.
• COOK FROM AFAR: Start, stop, change the temperature, set the timer, and monitor your cooking status from just about anywhere, as long as your device is within Wi-Fi range.
• RECIPE DISCOVERY: Cook recipes by James Beard Award-winning chefs, food editors, celebrity chefs, and more.
• GUIDED COOKING: Follow the step-by-step instructions and click start to start cooking.
• COOK NOTIFICATIONS: Stay up-to-date on your cooking status without getting tied to the kitchen.
• RECIPE SHARING: Share your recipe with friends directly through the app.
• TIME AND TEMP GUIDES: Learn the basics with our simple sous vide guides.
• MANUAL CONTROL: Customize your cook settings with manual time and temperature control.
• RECIPE COLLECTIONS: A series of new and appetizing recipe collections that are sure to keep you cooking.
• RECIPE CREATION: Easily create and save your own personal sous vide recipe. 
• FAVORITES: Have a recipe or two that you love? Mark it as a favorite for quick and easy access.
• PERSONAL PROFILE: Create your personal profile and see a history of all the meals you’ve cooked. 
Try all the features free for 14 days. Options in-app for monthly or yearly subscription terms.
Payment will be charged to the iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal cost will be identified. Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00039168:ios.description:
Vezet is your local service for ordering taxis.
Ride easy with us! Ordering a taxi in the app is simple and affordable. Just enter your address and destination, and choose a service class. The app shows right away when the taxi will arrive and the price, no more surprises!
Order a taxi online in the Vezet app. It's also easy to do more than just request a ride:
— add multiple addresses for the same ride
— enter the building entrance number or place where pickup is easiest
— see where your taxi is in real time on the map
— call the driver if you need
— rate the ride and leave feedback at the end
— add your favorite addresses to order taxis even faster and more conveniently
— pay for rides by card or in cash
Choose from two convenient service classes:
— the Vezet budget service class is a convenient daily alternative to public transport to get from or to work
— the Express service class costs more, but the car arrives faster, perfect for if you're late for a meeting or the airport
Choose the service class most convenient for you and save on taxis.
Vezet is available in more than 470 cities in Russia. If you love traveling, Vezet is there for you in Moscow, St. Petersburg, Yekaterinburg, Rostov-on-Don, Samara, Nizhny Novgorod, Kazan, Novosibirsk and dozens of other cities. Now you don't have to plan your time around public transport schedules. Just download the Vezet app and get riding.

bluejetty:00138595:ios.name: onX Fish: GPS Fishing Maps
bluejetty:00138595:ios.summary: Discover new lakes, what’s in them, and how to get there for your next day of fishing. onX Fish combines lake-specific species data, bathymetric maps, and GPS navigation in one intuitive fishing App. Find new spots and identify top-producin
bluejetty:00138595:ios.description:
Discover new lakes, what’s in them, and how to get there for your next day of fishing. onX Fish combines lake-specific species data, bathymetric maps, and GPS navigation in one intuitive fishing App. Find new spots and identify top-producing lakes with ease.
onX Fish currently covers 13 states: Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan, Illinois, North Dakota, South Dakota, Indiana, Ohio, Iowa, Missouri, Kansas, Nebraska, and Montana. By blending the best in accurate satellite imagery with map tools that reference up-to-date fisheries data, onX Fish gives you the confidence to explore new opportunities.
Fish better water faster with species, “high abundance,” “trophy potential,” “keeper potential,” or high “stocking effort” filters. Know what to expect with Fishing Area Insights and hourly Weather at your fingertips. View regulations to keep yourself informed on new lakes and territories.
Check public and private property lines and lake access points before you arrive. Review 3D topo lake maps, check maximum depth, and mark points of interest with Waypoints. Navigate to Waypoints and public access sites hands-free by connecting the App to Apple CarPlay.
Download Offline Maps and know how to get back to your access points after dark, even without cell service. Use Tracker to retrace your route and easily organize past trips.
A successful day on the water starts with a plan. Cast beyond the familiar with onX Fish.
onX Fish Features:
▶ How can I find new lakes to fish with onX Fish?
Identify local fishing spots with Lake Finder. Review top fish species and size distribution survey data per lake. Filter lakes quickly by species, abundance, trophy or keeper potential, and high stocking effort. Tap on lakes to view fishery information, like lake features and seasonality.
▶ How can I plan my next fishing trip?
View historical species data, hourly weather forecasts, and barometric pressure to determine the best times to fish. Compare CPUE (Catch Per Unit Effort) data and species stocking history. Gain insights on lake structures, bottoms, cover, boat ramps, and public access points.
▶ What type of GPS and offline navigation features does onX Fish have?
With onX Fish’s built-in GPS and Route Builder, you can easily navigate on and off the water. Navigate to your next spot hands-free by connecting to Apple CarPlay. Build routes and download Offline Maps to access the details you need without cell coverage.
▶ How can I view land access info and fishing regulations?
Use land ownership Map Layers to know where you can fish legally. Review state-specific and special fishing regulations per lake. Find info on Access and Amenities at your lake of choice. Locate boat ramps and set Waypoints to save access points before heading out.
▶ What type of Map Layers does onX Fish have?
Find productive waters, view conditions, and see motorized trails with Map Layers. Turn on Fishing Areas to view hotspots with species, seasonal movement, and vegetation info. Forecast conditions with Precipitation Radar, Wind Forecast, and Active Wildfire Layers.
Download onX Fish to access the most complete fishing App that offers species, size, and CPUE data with detailed lake maps and GPS navigation.
▶ Free Trial: Start a free 7-day trial when you install the App.
▶ Free Version (No subscription required): Explore the Lake Finder, GPS navigation, offline maps, map layers, and aerial imagery at no cost.
▶ onX Fish Midwest ($34.99/year)—Full access to:
• Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan, Illinois, North Dakota, South Dakota, Indiana, Ohio, Iowa, Missouri, Kansas, Nebraska, and Montana
• Fish species details, distribution, insights, and stocking history
• Detailed lake maps and fishing areas
• Private lands and landownership info
• Recent satellite imagery
▶ Terms of Use: https://www.onxmaps.com/tou
▶ Privacy Policy: https://www.onxmaps.com/privacy-policy
▶ Feedback: Have a problem or want to request new features? Contact us at support@onxmaps.com

Hey! Welcome to the new Southern Bank Personal Mobile Banking App. This is a new app for Southern Bank customers with new features and benefits. Before launching the app, make sure you have a personal online banking profile at https://www.southernbank.com/personal/mobile. This will sync all your data and keep your accounts up to date.
Enhanced Debit Card Controls: Turn your debit card on and off with the tap of a button. Control your transactions by geography, purchase amount, transaction types, and more.
Zelle®: Send money with Zelle®, one of the most widely accepted direct payment networks in the world that provides a fast, safe and easy way to send money simply and securely to almost anyone in minutes.
Personal Finance Tools: A variety of tools to help you better manage your money. Make budgeting easy with Budget Bubbles. Review your spending habits and transactions. Set your financial goals and see how long it will take you to achieve them.
Account Controls: Deposit checks, transfer money between accounts, pay bills, receive instant real-time alerts for account activity, and view your account balance, all from the home screen.
Stay in touch: You can locate a branch or ATM, contact our customer care team, and share our app with friends and family.
And so much more.
Contact us at 1-855-ASK-SBANK (1-855-275-7226) if you have any questions about the Southern Bank Mobile App or the Online Banking enrollment process. Thank you for choosing Southern Bank, where our interest is You.
All features may not be available in the tablet application.

bluejetty:00114701:ios.description:
Whale Solitaire: Ocean Action
Save the ocean, card by card.
Whale Solitaire: Ocean Action is a fresh take on the classic card game experience—a perfect blend of strategy and purpose. Set amidst the vast blue ocean, every move you make brings you one step closer to protecting these gentle sea creatures.
Innovative Gameplay
The familiar card layout gets a fresh look. Cards are arranged at the top of the screen, with a flip area below revealing one card at a time. Match adjacent cards to clear the board and progress through each challenge. Collect all the cards and you're the winner.
Challenging Difficulty
We hope that through progressively more challenging gameplay, we'll keep the game engaging and constantly striving for a challenge. By overcoming obstacles, we'll learn more about the ocean and understand this most complex of ecosystems.
Protect Whales
This isn't just a card game; it's a call to action. Through gameplay and storytelling, Whale Solitaire encourages players to appreciate the beauty of marine life and understand the importance of ocean conservation.
Calm, Beautiful, and Meaningful
Immerse yourself in soothing ocean visuals and gentle music, relaxing your mind and body while inspiring a sense of responsibility for the planet.
Play. Relax. Protect.
Discover a new way to enjoy a card game—and help save the ocean in the process.

bluejetty:00028883:ios.description:
An Idle RPG where you can have endless fun collecting and advancing heroes and weapons. 
Create your own army to save the land and go from a Pawn to a King.
Meet characters with powerful auras from the webtoon and web novel in the game! 
I've come back to the day I lost my arm, 24 years ago. 
This time, I will do anything to save my friends who were maimed and killed 24 years ago! 
With my knowledge! With my experience! With my power! 
The Idle RPG that's more exciting than any other, 'From Pawn to King'!
Easy and intuitive controls. Simple to understand. A game that anyone can play!!!
Immerse yourself and have fun, wherever you might be in these busy times. Just leave the game to run by itself and kick back!!! 
Explore and discover mysterious Dungeons. Go on expeditions far and wide in search of hidden Heroes!! 
Various bosses, dungeons, free daily draws, free Hero draws, and even free Weapon draws!! 
Easy and simple Idle RPG: From Pawn to King!!
▶ Enhance Heroes through nurturing them!
Easy and simple controls! Intuitive advancement system.
Heroes and weapons stack up like crazy by themselves!
Collect warriors, hero characters, and weapons!
▶ Raid content : Breathtaking battles with powerful bosses will push you to your limit!
Daily Raid and Elite Raid!! Powerful bosses await you!
Breathtaking battles with powerful rulers like Skull King, Ancient Colossus Golem, Scion of Dragon, and Knight of Steel! 
Each ruler uses unique, and extremely powerful, skills!
Special rewards await you upon defeating a powerful ruler.
▶ Combie Mine materials & powerful artifact accessories.
The mining won't stop even when you're away. You can synthesize powerful Artifacts using mined materials.
Collect artifact accessories to become all powerful and defeat the enemies.
▶ Heroes grow stronger by obtaining Gold and EXP Scrolls, even while you're away!
IDLE system that means you'll continuously advance even while offline!
You can go from a Pawn to a King by simply playing 10 minutes a day.
Deploy and strengthen heroes strategically to make your army stronger. 
▶ Go from a Pawn to a King.
Reincarnated Chris had a dream of becoming a King. 
Break through your limits by using promotions. Unlock hero and weapon level restrictions to become a King.
Promotion matches help you go from a Pawn to a King!
▶ Build an army worthy of a King by collecting heroes! (Build a mighty army!) 
Lind, Digo, Ax, Halken Ludwig, Tekil... Reunite with Chris's precious companions from the original story! 
Fallmoon Knights of Wolves, Ancine Lisones, and even Bandit Jarmun! Recruit even hostile heroes as your companions!
Many cool heroes from the original webtoon and web novel!
▶ The game will regularly receive continuous updates.
New stages, heroes, and weapons will be added from the webtoon series. 
Please stay tuned for the new content!
- Advance your heroes quickly using high-speed mode.
- Fight a different 'Boss' in each stage! 
- Use the breath taking skills of the support heroes!
- Complete various quests everyday to receive rewards!
- The longer you leave your heroes idle, the stronger they become. Collect heroes and aim to be number 1 in the rankings. 
This is a fun and highly addictive Idle RPG. 
One who leads other knights into battle, overpowers the enemy and unites all with their charisma. 
One who is born with a virtue and strength that appeals to the masses.
The world calls such people Kings.
-From Pawn to King

apple-itunes:528748182.name: NWS Weather: Deep Weather
apple-itunes:528748182.description:
The most accurate, reliable, in-depth reasoning and details behind your local weather forecast, straight from the experts at NOAA/NWS.
Deep Weather provides the deep, detailed meteorological reasoning behind your forecast, along with the various factors that are likely to influence it. Knowing this deeper weather information arms you with the knowledge to anticipate weather changes and adjust your plans accordingly.
Deep Weather respects your privacy. Deep Weather doesn't track or store your location information, or any other data about you. (See privacy disclosure below). Deep Weather has no ads that distract and clutter up your weather information. Rather it relies on optional Pro subscriptions from our loyal users to pay the bills.
Deep Weather provides you with a deeper understanding of your weather forecast by giving you weather details not commonly found in other apps in a convenient, easy-to-read package. 
Deep Weather automatically compiles an easy-to-read version of the most recent National Weather Service Area Forecast Discussion, advisories and warnings for your location. 
The National Weather Service Area Forecast Discussions provide detailed information and background about the weather patterns and observations that are part of the most recent forecast model. They represent the "Story behind the weather story," a glimpse behind the scenes of your current forecast, and provide lots of weather forecast detail not found anywhere else.
Included sections:
Aviation Weather
Fire Weather
Climatology
Marine Weather
Beach Forecast
Watches, Warnings
Short Term Forecast
Long Term Forecast
To help provide a more visual picture, Deep Weather also provides easy access to a curated list of the most up-to-date weather graphics: National Forecast Chart, Surface Analysis, IR Satellite, Current Radar, Pacific and Atlantic Ocean surface analysis, 500mb graphical forecasts and more.
For Pro subscribers/owners, Deep Weather includes live animated radar rendered from National Weather Service source data.
In addition, Deep Weather provides localized 7-day extended forecasts from the National Weather Service for any location in the United States and its territories.
Deep Weather provides great value in helping you anticipate and adjust to changes in the weather that you might not have been aware of if limited to other weather sources. By understanding the factors and assumptions that are part of the official forecast and how changes in those factors could affect the outcome, you are armed with a much deeper and more flexible understanding of the weather around you. This is highly valuable in aviation, sailing, long distance hiking and any other outdoor endeavor where changes in the weather can have great impact.
Use the map view to select any National Weather Service Forecast Office and receive the latest forecast discussion for that area. 
The discussion is broken up into sections for you, and the text itself formatted in a much more easily read format than the raw original.
These discussions and weather graphics are amended and updated several times per day, so you can follow how the weather forecast is changing in real time, as well as gain a deeper understanding of the thought that goes into forming the forecast.
